articleTitle: Cost Analysis of Power Engineering Based on Improved Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Enhancing power engineering management mostly depends on raising the precision of power engineering cost forecast. Nevertheless, many variables and limited data influence the price of electric power engineering. As a result, it is crucial to forecast electric power project costs precisely in high-dimensional and small-sample scenarios. The duplicate indices are successfully removed when the data is mined using the random forest method (RF). The accuracy and stability of the cost forecast for power projects are increased when the support vector machine (SVM) model is optimized using the wolf pack algorithm (WPA), which successfully addresses the issues of SVM overfitting and readily slipping into local optimality. It has been shown via case analysis and model comparison that the suggested approach performs better regarding predictions.

articleTitle: Power System Cycle Impact Data Based on Electric Internal Combustion Engines
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Nowadays, some companies are turning their attention to Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) of automobiles in order to control energy consumption, reduce production costs, and improve production efficiency. This article intended to take a Chinese brand of pure electric vehicles (EVs) and internal combustion engine vehicles (ICEVs) as the research objects. By comparing the life cycles of the two driving modes, the environmental effect characteristics at different stages of the full life cycle were obtained, and the key factors that have a significant impact on the environment were identified. Given that the main focus of this study is to compare the environmental effects of fuel vehicles and electric vehicles, in addition to the composition of electricity consumption in the Chinese power grid, all relevant data on upstream raw materials and energy production processes were sourced from GaBi. This article intended to supplement the Chinese LCA database by improving it based on it. In the calculation of comprehensive environmental effects, it was assumed that all environmental influencing factors were equal, and the weights of each factor were equal. In the stage of obtaining raw materials, the normalized result of eutrophication was 0.57. In the production and manufacturing stage, the normalization result of acidification was 0.5. This article helped guide designers to optimize design and reduce the impact of vehicles on the environment.

articleTitle: Algorithm Design and Intelligent Analysis for Optimizing Reservoir Development Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the continuous progress of oilfield exploration and development technology, traditional development planning techniques have gradually shown limitations in the face of increasingly diverse displacement methods and complex reservoir types. It is difficult to efficiently integrate and optimize the workload deployment of various technical fields and multiple measures, thereby restricting the improvement of oilfield development efficiency and economic benefits. In this context, the rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI), especially machine learning (ML) technology, has brought revolutionary changes to the field of oil and gas exploration and development. This article innovatively proposes an ML based optimization algorithm for reservoir development strategy, which deeply integrates advanced technologies such as big data analysis and deep learning (DL). It can accurately analyze reservoir geological characteristics, fluid dynamic changes, and historical production data. By constructing complex models to simulate reservoir responses under different development schemes, intelligent optimization of development strategies can be achieved. The experimental results show that the algorithm can not only significantly improve the accuracy and efficiency of development planning, but also effectively reduce development costs, providing strong technical support for the sustainable development of oil fields.

articleTitle: Research on Algorithm Design and Control Strategies for Complex Systems Based on Mathematical Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The study of algorithm design and control strategies based on mathematical models has become particularly important in the current context of increasing complex systems. The aim of this study is to explore how mathematical models can be used to design efficient algorithms and apply them to the control of complex systems. First, we provide an overview of relevant mathematical models and basic concepts and discuss their importance in algorithm design. We then delve into the design methods of deterministic, stochastic, and heuristic algorithms, and provide examples of practical applications of these methods. We then explore several commonly used control strategies for complex systems, including feedback control mechanisms, adaptive control strategies, and predictive control models. Through specific case studies, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the practical application of these strategies in industrial, environmental, and technological systems. The research results show that the algorithms designed based on mathematical models have significant advantages in complex system control and can significantly improve the stability and efficiency of the system. Finally, we summarize the main findings of the study and look ahead to possible directions for future research, suggesting further applications and developments in different fields.

articleTitle: The Fault Environment Feature Recognition Method for Dancing of Overhead Transmission Lines based on Dynamic Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In this paper, for the problem of inaccurate identification of dangerous characteristics of transmission line galloping, a joint algorithm of rough set and ant colony is proposed, and the identification of damping, frequency and other indexes by the algorithm is analyzed. At the same time, set the threshold, weight and other constraints to avoid the problem of local extremum in the calculation. The proposed algorithm in judging the galloping frequency, vibration mode and damping ratio is $\mathbf{9 5. 8 \%}, \mathbf{9 3. 3} \%$ and $\mathbf{9 6. 1 \%}$ respectively, and the calculation time is $\mathbf{1 0. 5} \mathbf{s}, \mathbf{1 2. 7 s}$ and 11.2 s respectively, indicating that the hazard feature recognition method is acceptable. The simulation results show that the hazard feature recognition model constructed in this paper can realize multi-channel modal analysis, and the analysis results are better than a single ant colony algorithm, and the calculation accuracy is higher. Therefore, in the multi-channel modal state, rough set combined with ant colony algorithm can solve the problem of dangerous feature identification of transmission line galloping.

articleTitle: Design of Vulnerability and Attack Detection System of Industrial Control System Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the improved genetic algorithm is used to summarize various information of industrial automatic control system. By exploring the attack detection design direction, the execution conditions of industrial control system are studied, and the vulnerabilities of the system are detected. The maximum and minimum value of the attribute value are calculated and estimated by using the stage search of the attribute of the industrial control system, so as to find the threshold value belonging to the detection design. And the attribute value group is controlled, so that the attack detection points can be counted efficiently and accurately, and the vulnerabilities of the industrial control system can be optimized and upgraded. It was found that the maximum vulnerability passing rate of the industrial control system reached 0.05, the minimum vulnerability triggering anomaly was 55 times, and the detection design quantity of the industrial control system was increased by 92.53% and 185.03%, respectively. Industrial control system design incorporating improved genetic algorithms can improve the efficiency and quality of industrial processes, reduce operational risks and provide accurate data and reporting.

articleTitle: Algorithm Design and Application of Multi-Modal Large Model in Intelligent Sorting of Image Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Multi-modal large model shows great application potential because it can fuse and process various types of data. In the field of intelligent sorting of image data, traditional methods are often limited by manual operation or simple automatic identification system, and it is difficult to deal with complex and changeable image data, which leads to limited accuracy and efficiency of sorting. In this paper, a multi-modal algorithm for intelligent sorting of image data is designed in detail. This algorithm effectively improves the accuracy and robustness of feature extraction through innovative text and image modal feature extraction methods combined with feature fusion strategy based on attention mechanism. In the part of algorithm implementation, this paper adopts the text feature extraction method based on Transformer and the improved Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to extract image features, and designs a feature fusion method based on attention mechanism to realize the deep fusion of text and image modal features. Subsequently, a simple fully connected layer is constructed as the decision-making layer, and the weight and bias are optimized by back propagation algorithm to minimize the classification error. In the experimental part, this paper uses a sample data set with $\mathbf{1 0, 0 0 0}$ text descriptions and corresponding images, and verifies the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm by comparing the performance indicators of different categories. The experimental results show that the algorithm has achieved high accuracy and recall in books, electronic products, clothing and other categories, which is significantly better than the traditional sorting methods based on rules, support vector machines (SVM) and CNN. The application algorithm of multi-modal large model in intelligent image data sorting proposed in this paper not only improves the accuracy and efficiency of sorting, but also provides useful reference for the application of multi-modal large model in wider fields.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Vision-Based Optoelectronic Target Tracking Algorithm in Command and Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of modern war and security monitoring needs, the command and control system has more and more strict requirements on the precision and real-time of target tracking technology. The photoelectric target tracking algorithm based on computer vision has been widely used in command and control system because of its efficient and accurate features. In this paper, the basic principle of photoelectric target tracking algorithm and its application in command and control system are discussed in depth, focusing on analyzing the selection and realization methods of different algorithms and their effects in practical application. Through the comparative analysis of several typical algorithms, this paper reveals the potential of optoelectronic target tracking algorithms in enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of command and control systems, and points out the challenges faced by the current technology and the future development direction. The results show that with the development of emerging technologies and the continuous optimization of algorithms, optoelectronic target tracking will play an increasingly important role in command and control systems.

articleTitle: Research on low-power microprocessor design and optimization technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In modern electronic systems, the energy efficiency of microprocessors has become an important factor in determining their performance and application scope. With the rapid development of mobile devices, Internet of Things (IoT) and portable electronics, low-power microprocessor design has become particularly important. The aim of this paper is to explore low-power microprocessor design and optimization techniques, focusing on how to effectively reduce power consumption without significantly affecting performance. We begin with an overview of the fundamentals and major challenges of low-power design, followed by an in-depth analysis of a variety of optimization techniques at the architectural level, circuit level, and algorithmic and software levels. This paper demonstrates the effects and tradeoffs of these techniques in practical applications through specific case studies, and provides an outlook on future trends and research directions in low-power microprocessor design. It provides a theoretical foundation and practical guidance for realizing more efficient and energy-saving microprocessor design, which has important academic value and application prospects.

articleTitle: Analysis of Similar Words in English Movie Lines Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Film is a very important art form that has received increasing attention from the public since its emergence. These movies all include their own movie lines, some of which are even more deeply ingrained in people’s hearts and have gained popularity among audiences of different ages. In order to help movie enthusiasts and researchers understand the similarity of these movie lines, this paper proposes a machine learning based method for analyzing similarc words in English movie lines. The first step of this plan is to obtain the original English dialogue data of the movie waiting for analysis. This article takes the dialogue of the movie “Avatar” as an example; Next is the visualization of the basic information of these movie lines, including analysis of keywords, word frequency; The third step is to use Word2Vec, a machine learning algorithm, to deeply explore the information contained in movie dialogue. The Word2Vec model is trained using all the dialogue data from the movie “Avatar”. The entire process data is displayed using visual charts, and the similarity between the first five words closest to “sooner” is preliminarily tested; Finally, two sets of other vocabulary tests were given, and the prediction results for similar words were good, which can be widely used.

articleTitle: Automatic Irony detection for Chinese social media based on BERT-GDPCNN-ATTN model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Due to the diversity and complexity of irony as a linguistic phenomenon, irony detection has always been a challenging research field in text sentiment analysis, which helps to identify ironic tones and accurately judge the sentiment of the text. In this paper, we propose the BERT-GDPCNN-ATTN model for Chinese irony detection in Sina Weibo. In our model, we adopt the strategy of stacked embedding, using multiple Transformer-based Chinese pretrained models to generate diversified sentence embeddings and document embeddings, and combine them with enhanced Gate DPCNN to learn long-range dependencies within Chinese texts. We also incorporate attention mechanism to more effectively represent Chinese context and better capture the irony tendencies within it. Meanwhile, we find that the traditional binary classification of irony and non-irony is not sufficient to distinguish various types of irony well. Thus, we design another Chinese sub-dataset for four-class classification. This paper first discusses the research status quo of irony detection in the field of NLP and outlines various existing irony detection models.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment Framework for Intelligent Transmission and Distribution Systems Based on Runtime Validation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: How to effectively manage the transmission and distribution system and reduce potential risks is a thought-provoking issue. In response to the above issues, this project plans to build an intelligent risk assessment system for transmission networks based on runtime verification. The framework includes steps such as data collection, data preprocessing, feature extraction, modeling, and risk assessment. Through empirical research on real intelligent transmission and distribution system data, we find that the intelligent risk assessment framework based on runtime verification has significant advantages compared to traditional systems. The risk prediction model adopted in our study exhibited a relatively promising result for the prediction of possible risks in power system. According to our analysis results, the performance of the model is around 96 %-100 % in terms of accuracy, the calculation time of the system is greatly reduced, and the false alarm rate is reduced. Moreover, the system has a high real-time feedback and adjustment capability and a high real-time operation efficiency of the algorithms and models. Considering the complexity of risk management in power transmission and distribution systems, an intelligent risk prediction system based on Runtime Verification was developed in our work. The developed framework integrates data collection, data processing, feature extraction, and model building and has better performance with respect to accuracy, efficiency, and real-time capability; compared to traditional methods. The development of our study has contributed to a novel risk mitigation strategy for transmission and distribution system risk management.

Author Keywords: Risk assessment of transmission and distribution systems

articleTitle: Big Data Analysis and Intelligent Prediction Technology Based on Intelligent Digital Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The increasing complexity of power system structure and the continuous access of new energy sources put forward higher requirements for real-time monitoring, fault diagnosis and optimal scheduling of power system. The whole main design of this study is to build an advanced intelligent forecasting model to improve the operation efficiency and reliability of power system. Through the analysis of massive data of power system, data patterns and laws are obtained, which lays a scientific foundation for optimal operation and intelligent decision-making of power system. Considering the superior characteristics of long-term and short-term neural network in processing time series data, it is selected as the core model. The research process is divided into big data preprocessing, feature extraction, intelligent prediction model establishment and parameter optimization. Pretreatment of big data can ensure the high quality and accuracy of data, and some feature selection is used to select more meaningful features for prediction. Using long-term and short-term neural networks to build an intelligent prediction model, the performance of the model is optimized by adjusting the parameters of the model. The data results show that the predicted energy efficiency can reach 95%, the load forecasting accuracy is $\mathbf{7 5. 5 \%} \sim \mathbf{9 4. 6} \%$, and the frequency deviation can reach 2 Hz. The above results show that the long-term and short-term neural network model has high energy efficiency, high precision load forecasting and system stability, and can be well applied to intelligent digital power systems, providing strong technical support for intelligent operation and maintenance of power grids.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-based Transformer Station Construction Safety Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The construction safety of transformer stations is an important issue in the power industry, and traditional safety inspection methods suffer from high labor costs and low efficiency. The construction safety detection system for transformer stations based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) has attracted widespread attention in recent years, but there is still relatively little comprehensive summary of its research methods and results. This study elaborates on the construction of a CNN-based transformer station construction safety detection system and conducts a deep comparison with traditional SVM models. Through the analysis of research literature, it was found that CNN can effectively distinguish between safe and dangerous behaviors by learning image features and contextual relationships, improving the accuracy of detection. The parallel computing and GPU acceleration capabilities of CNN significantly shorten the detection time and improve the real-time performance of detection.

articleTitle: Research on Bi-directional Cooperative Optimal Scheduling of Novel Power System Source and Load Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the transformation of energy structure and the increase of power demand, novel power system faces the challenge of fluctuation and uncertainty of renewable energy. To enhance the efficiency, stability, and cost-effectiveness of the system, this study introduces the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm. The goal is to achieve optimal bi-directional cooperative scheduling of both the source and load. In this paper, IEEE33-node power grid is selected as the experimental framework, and a power system model including distributed generation and various loads is constructed. The objective of the optimization is to reduce the overall operating cost of the system, which includes power purchase cost, distributed power supply operating cost, load reduction cost and load transfer compensation cost. PSO algorithm uses mixed coding method to deal with decision variables such as distributed power output, load shedding and load transfer, and designs reasonable fitness function and updating strategy. The simulation results demonstrate that the optimized scheduling scheme significantly smooths the output curve of distributed power sources, effectively lowers the system’s total operating costs, and ensures stable operation and reliable power supply. Compared to the Genetic Algorithm (GA) and Ant Colony Algorithm (ACO), the PSO algorithm can identify the near-optimal solution in fewer iterations, exhibiting strong global search capabilities and faster convergence. This study not only verifies the effectiveness and superiority of PSO algorithm in the bi-directional cooperative optimal scheduling of source and load, but also provides theoretical support and technical reference for the economic operation and stable power supply of novel power system.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning-Based Dynamic Scheduling Algorithm for User-Side Multi-Source Data in Digital Electrical Rooms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the increasing complexity and dynamics of digital electrical rooms, effective management of diverse data sources faces significant challenges. In this study, a dynamic scheduling algorithm based on reinforcement learning for user-side multi-source data in digital powerhouses is proposed, aiming to optimize resource allocation and improve system performance. The algorithm utilizes reinforcement learning techniques to adaptively adjust scheduling strategies based on real-time environmental feedback. We outline the framework and implementation of the algorithm, highlighting its potential to cope with the dynamic nature of digital powerhouses and effectively utilize multi-source data. Through comprehensive experiments and analysis, we demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed algorithm in various scenarios. Our findings emphasize the potential role of reinforcement learning in enhancing the efficiency and reliability of digital electrical room management systems.

articleTitle: Analysis of English Sentence Dependency Syntax Based on Python
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous deepening of globalization, there have been more and more international learning, cooperation, and other forms of communication that cannot be separated from the support of english. Therefore, English has become very important as an internationally recognized means of communication, and as a result, more and more people are learning English. In order to provide assistance for English learners to deepen their understanding of English sentence dependency syntax, this study proposes a Python based English sentence dependency syntax analysis method. Firstly, the natural language processing module of Python is used to segment three example sentences and obtain key word information in the sentences; Then perform part of speech tagging to indicate the properties of words in the sentence; Then annotate the named entity, identify and extract the named entity; The next step is word vector analysis, which represents words mathematically; The final step is sentence dependency syntax analysis, which displays the dependency relationships between words within the sentence through visual images and tables after processing. After the above 5 steps, the dependency syntax of English sentences can be analyzed, which is efficient, accurate, and can help quickly analyze dependency relationships.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Standardized Billing Models in Heterogeneous Computing Power Transactions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of heterogeneous computing technology, heterogeneous computing power trading has become a new research and application hotspot. This article proposes a standardized billing model aimed at standardizing the billing process in heterogeneous computing power transactions, improving the efficiency of computing power utilization and fairness of transactions. This model comprehensively considers the characteristics of heterogeneous computing power, task requirements, market prices, and other factors. By designing reasonable billing algorithms and standardized billing interfaces, it achieves accurate measurement and flexible billing of heterogeneous computing power.

articleTitle: Edge Deployment and Real-time Warning: Architecture Design and Optimization of Action Recognition Systems in Power Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In contemporary society, economic growth and scientific advancements serve as relentless catalysts for ongoing innovation across multiple industries. Notably, the technology sector’s extensive adoption of avant-garde technologies hinges on steadfast and dependable power supply. As the power grid expands and its intelligence level advances, stricter demands arise for real-time safety alerts concerning power grid equipment operating environments. To tackle this, the present article introduces an action recognition system integrating edge deployment and real-time alerts. Leveraging the prowess of deep learning (DL) technology, this system monitors and issues real-time warnings for power grid equipment operating environments using DL models. By embracing edge deployment, it stations computing resources and data processing capabilities directly at power grid equipment sites, significantly enhancing the immediacy and precision of early warnings. Experimental findings reveal that, when compared to conventional centralized monitoring systems, this system boasts superior real-time performance and reduced latency, thereby offering a more robust safeguard for the secure operation of power grid equipment.

articleTitle: Construction of an Artificial Intelligence Standard Knowledge Computing Engine System for Power Grid Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The artificial intelligence standard knowledge computing engine system for grid equipment construction was applied to realize the functions of real-time monitoring, fault diagnosis, predictive analysis and optimization decision-making for grid equipment. The approach starts with overall system engineering, starting with grid equipment data acquisition and initial processing, followed by feature extraction and model training. In terms of model selection, according to the features and requirements of power grid equipment, suitable artificial intelligence models and algorithms were selected. The model was optimized, and the model parameters were adjusted in the study. Ultimately, an artificial intelligence standard knowledge computing engine system was built to realize the analysis and decision support of power grid equipment. Through the analysis and prediction of grid equipment data, the system could accurately identify the equipment faults, states and behaviors; and provide timely decision support.

articleTitle: Digital Design of Power Supply based on Three-level Regulation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Although the traditional voltage and current dual loop control strategy can basically meet the control requirements of the power supply to a certain extent, it has a current limiting or voltage limiting effect, which can cause the output power to be less than the rated power. Therefore, based on the analysis of the original voltage and current dual loop control strategy, this article adopts a three-level control strategy, aiming to enable the power supply to output at a constant rated power. Firstly, the main hardware of the power supply was designed with the TMS320F240 DSP intelligent chip as the core. Then, the soft switching technology of the power supply was studied through PSPICE simulation analysis. The results showed that the coupling calculation method can effectively achieve the digitalization of the three-level regulation of the power supply, providing reference research for the future digitalization of high-power power supplies.

articleTitle: A Three-phase Unified AC Power Quality Control Device
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This article studies the design method of inverter power circuit for three-phase unified AC power quality control device, and designs IGBT buffer circuit and driving circuit, as well as the DC link overvoltage protection and inverter AC side overcurrent protection circuit of the entire system. Finally, the joint amplitude waveform and joint experimental waveform of the entire experimental device were presented. Simulation and experimental research results showed that the three-phase unified AC power quality regulation device can achieve the functions of eliminating load reactive power and harmonic current, and bi-directional adjustment of load voltage. The designed experimental system can meet the design requirements, and the control method of separately controlling the series voltage regulation link and the parallel active filtering link is reasonable. The results show that the detection method is effective. And experimental research was conducted on the designed parallel active filter, and the results showed that it can effectively eliminate load harmonics and reactive currents, and can meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: Blockchain-based New Power System Plant-grid Coordination Sunshine Service and Scheduling Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Scheduling technology is essential in the coordination of new power systems, but the traditional power system still has problems such as low accuracy of supply and demand matching and long dispatch response time when carrying out grid-plant cooperative scheduling. The purpose of this paper is to use blockchain technology to optimize the scheduling technology and scheduling strategy in the new type of power system plant-grid coordination, so as to make it better to meet the latest demand for power system scheduling, and to ensure the stable and reliable operation of the power system. A distributed consensus mechanism is first applied in this paper to solve the insertion problem faced by centralized scheduling, and uses a Bloom filter to design a distributed power source peer-to-peer transaction mechanism; then, combining the immutability and traceability of blockchain, a new collaborative scheduling mechanism for power systems was designed; then the role of blockchain in promoting market-oriented operation of the power system was elaborated. Finally, the effectiveness of applying blockchain technology to the new type of power system grid coordination sunshine service and scheduling technology was verified. Through empirical research, it has been found that when the matching time of power supply and demand reaches 25 hours, the accuracy of traditional methods for matching is only 81.57%, while the method proposed in this paper can achieve ${9 0. 6 3 \%}$. At the same time, the dispatch response time of the power system under the method proposed in this paper is significantly shorter than that of the power system under traditional methods. The study proves the value of the application of blockchain technology on the new power system plant-grid cooperative scheduling, which provides more methods to guarantee the stable operation of the power system and promote the better development of the power market.

articleTitle: Development of Intelligent Fault Diagnosis and Predictive Maintenance Algorithm in Photovoltaic Power Generation System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the global awareness of renewable energy and environmental protection rising, photovoltaic power generation system (PPGS), as an important part of clean energy, its stable operation and fault management has become a research hotspot. Aiming at the problem of fault diagnosis and predictive maintenance in PPGS, this paper proposes an intelligent fault diagnosis and predictive maintenance algorithm based on deep learning and time series analysis technology. By monitoring the operation data of key equipment in PPGS in real time, the algorithm uses features extraction techniques such as wavelet transform (WT) and deep neural network (DNN) model to automatically learn the deep-level features in the data, thus realizing accurate fault prediction and health status assessment of photovoltaic inverter. In order to quantitatively evaluate the health status of inverter, this study constructs the health status index (HSI) based on the output of deep learning model, and uses ARIMA model to predict the trend of HSI, so as to warn the possible faults in advance. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively reflect the health state changes of the inverter, which provides strong support for preventive maintenance. This algorithm is superior to the comparison algorithm in the accuracy and timeliness of fault prediction, and has high feasibility and practical application value.

articleTitle: Research on the Range and Location of Faults in Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: A quick fault identification and ranging concept that combines segment positioning and traveling wave methods is suggested in light of the shortcomings of the existing popular fault location methods in distribution networks, which lack precision and insufficient real-time performance. This technique combines the traveling wave approach with the switching function to accomplish fault localization and ranging. It does this by measuring the fault traveling wave propagation time and using the distribution network fault current data that the FTU collects. This approach can properly estimate and pinpoint the fault site in the early stage of the problem, as demonstrated by calculation examples and simulation analysis. It also has strong real-time performance.

articleTitle: Design of Remote Monitoring and Maintenance System for Electrical and Electronic Equipment Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the wide application of electrical and electronic equipment in industrial automation, smart home and other fields, its stable operation is very important to ensure production efficiency and convenience of life. However, the traditional on-site monitoring and maintenance methods have been difficult to meet the actual needs, so this study aims to design an efficient and convenient remote monitoring and maintenance solution. This research focuses on the design of remote monitoring and maintenance system for electrical and electronic equipment based on Internet of Things (IoT) technology. The system design adopts hierarchical architecture, including data acquisition layer, data transmission layer, data processing layer and application layer. By monitoring the running state of electrical and electronic equipment in real time, the system can predict the equipment failure and take corresponding maintenance measures, thus prolonging the service life of the equipment and improving the running reliability. In terms of hardware implementation, the system selects sensors and actuators with high precision and quick response to ensure accurate measurement of key parameters of equipment and remote control. In terms of software implementation, the system development environment is based on Windows 10 operating system, using Visual Studio 2022 as the development tool, adopting. NET 6 framework at the back end, adopting React framework at the front end and MySQL as the database. Through system testing and analysis, it is verified that the system performs well under normal load and high load, and has good stability and scalability. The remote monitoring and maintenance system of electrical and electronic equipment based on IoT designed in this study will bring revolutionary changes to the management of electrical and electronic equipment, improve the reliability and service life of equipment, and contribute to the sustainable development of enterprises and the scientific and technological progress of society.

articleTitle: Research on Deep Learning Algorithm Optimization for Data Classification and Grading in the Power Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The research on the optimization of deep learning algorithms for data classification and grading in the power industry aims to address the challenges posed by the complexity and diversity of power industry data, and to improve the accuracy of data classification and grading through deep learning algorithms. The research adopts Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) as the basic algorithm, and proposes a deep learning classification model tailored to the characteristics of power industry data - PowerData-CNN. This model incorporates various innovative improvements based on traditional CNN, including the introduction of multiscale convolution kernels to capture feature information at different scales, and the addition of attention modules after the convolutional layers to enhance the model’s focus on important features. Additionally, the research adopts a strategy of dynamically adjusting the learning rate to adapt to the large and unevenly distributed nature of power industry data. Experimental results show that the optimized PowerData-CNN model achieves an accuracy of up to 0.95 in power industry data classification tasks, significantly outperforming traditional machine learning algorithms and other deep learning models.

articleTitle: Research on Medical Equipment Operation State Monitoring and Early Warning Technology of Failure
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of medical technology, medical devices play a crucial role in clinical diagnosis and treatment. However, malfunctioning of medical equipment may lead to serious medical accidents and affect the health and safety of patients. Therefore, how to effectively monitor the operation status of medical devices and realize early warning of failures has become an urgent problem. This study is dedicated to exploring and developing advanced monitoring techniques and early warning systems to improve the reliability and safety of medical equipment. This paper firstly reviews the existing medical device monitoring technologies and their limitations, and then explores the application of sensor technology, data acquisition and processing, machine learning and artificial intelligence in medical device monitoring, and analyzes the integration of remote monitoring and Internet of Things (IoT) technologies. Subsequently, the paper describes the construction method of the early warning system for failures, including the establishment of warning models, data analysis and prediction techniques. Through specific case studies, the paper demonstrates the practical application effects of these technologies. Finally, the paper discusses the challenges that may be faced during the implementation of these technologies and looks forward to the future development direction. The study shows that the combination of advanced monitoring technologies and intelligent warning systems can significantly improve the operational efficiency and safety of medical devices and provide strong support for the medical industry.

articleTitle: Application of High Reliability 5G Slice in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The purpose of this article is to discuss the application of highly reliable 5 G slicing technology in smart grid, and put forward a set of effective algorithm strategies to realize the efficient operation of smart grid. In order to achieve this goal, this article designs a slicing resource allocation algorithm based on multi-objective optimization to optimize the communication requirements of each service in smart grid. Furthermore, a slicing fault prediction and recovery algorithm based on machine learning is proposed to improve the reliability and stability of power grid communication. The results show that, compared with the traditional methods, the algorithm proposed in this article has a lower packet loss rate under different malicious nodes, and shows higher operating efficiency when dealing with large-scale power grid information. Through the application of optimization strategy, the overall energy consumption rate of power grid system has been significantly reduced. These results verify the superiority and practicability of the algorithm in smart grid communication. The application strategy of highly reliable 5G slicing technology proposed in this article provides a new solution to the communication problem of smart grid, and is expected to promote the optimization of power grid system.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Detection and Maintenance Algorithms in Road Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid progress of the times and the vigorous development of the economy, China has achieved historic achievements in road construction that have attracted worldwide attention. However, with the increase of road service life and traffic flow, the problem of road surface diseases is gradually becoming prominent. These diseases not only affect driving safety, but also increase the cost of road maintenance. In this context, achieving high-quality inspection and maintenance management of road engineering is particularly important. This article proposes a road engineering disease automatic detection and maintenance algorithm based on deep learning (DL), aiming to achieve accurate recognition, rapid positioning, and intelligent repair of road surface diseases through advanced DL technology. This algorithm adopts the DL model, and through training and learning a large amount of road surface image data, it can automatically identify different types of road surface diseases and accurately label their positions and degrees. The experimental results show that the algorithm has high accuracy and stability in road surface disease detection, and can effectively help road maintenance personnel detect and handle road surface diseases in a timely manner, improving the efficiency and quality of road maintenance.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Clustering Improvement Algorithm in Cost Evaluation of Power Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: China’seconomy has been strengthening steadily in recent years, leading to a fast expansion of the domestic power system and a progressive increase in national power grid firms’ development projects. As a result, the price of power engineering has grown to be a significant element in project building. If the project cost is too low, it won’t be easy to ensure project quality and will impede the advancement of power engineering. One way to evaluate the cost of power production in power engineering is to use the particle swarm clustering technique. In this instance, engineers compute the overall production capacity of each source using data from several sources, including weather, wind speed, solar radiation, etc. After classifying them into many groups based on their potential, the engineer applies a formula to get the average value of each group. This formula computes the average value of various factors the engineer knows, including efficiency and maximum power production per unit area.

articleTitle: Research on Student Behavior Pattern Recognition and Personalized Management Based on Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This study focuses on student behavior pattern recognition and personalized management based on intelligent algorithm, aiming at realizing personalized education with the opportunity of the rapid development of educational informatization and promoting students’ all-round development. In this study, an intelligent algorithm based on integrated learning is adopted, and three models, decision tree, random forest and Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM), are combined to deeply analyze the collected online learning records of students. In the data preprocessing stage, data quality and algorithm processing efficiency are improved by data cleaning, missing value processing, single heat coding and Z-score standardization. After algorithm design and optimization, this study successfully realized the accurate identification of students’ behavior patterns, and applied it to personalized management practice. The research results show that the intelligent algorithm based on integrated learning has achieved remarkable results in identifying students’ behavior patterns, and the recognition accuracy rate is as high as ${9 5. 8 \%}$, which is obviously superior to other similar research methods. In addition, this study also reveals the relationship between different students’ behavior patterns and academic performance, which provides strong data support for personalized management. The research on student behavior pattern recognition and personalized management based on intelligent algorithm not only improves the accuracy and stability of student behavior pattern recognition, but also provides an effective means for personalized management in the field of education.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Decision System for Information and Communication Network Attacks and Protection Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This article aims to design and implement an AI (Artificial intelligence)-based intelligent decision-making system for information and communication network attack and protection, so as to improve the intelligent level of network security protection. In terms of methods, this article uses CNN (Convective Neural Networks) to detect and classify attacks, and combines with the protection strategy library to realize the intelligent protection strategy selection. Through CNN, the system can accurately detect and classify various network attacks, including but not limited to denial of service attacks and botnet activities. Furthermore, the system is equipped with a comprehensive protection strategy library, which can intelligently select and implement the corresponding protection strategy according to the attack detection results, thus realizing fast and effective network security protection. The experimental results show that the system can accurately detect and classify network attacks, and at the same time intelligently choose appropriate protection strategies according to the detection results. Compared with other network security protection methods, this system shows higher detection and protection efficiency. This research provides a new intelligent protection scheme for the field of network security, which is helpful to improve the overall level of network security.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Green Supply Chain Management System for the Power Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: For a long time, the leading cadres of Chinese enterprises generally have the idea of “emphasizing production but not logistics”, and the development of logistics management is relatively lagging behind. With the implementation of China’s “plant-grid separation and competitive bidding for Internet access”, the competition among power producers has become increasingly intense, and power producers are facing serious challenges. To win in the fierce power market, it is necessary to continuously adopt new technologies in the production process, upgrade the original equipment, improve the safe operation coefficient of the equipment, and make it work better. The most important thing is to put people in the first place, improve the management level of the enterprise, plug the loopholes in the management, and gain benefits from the management. The concepts of “logistics is the third source of profit of an enterprise” and “logistics level reflects the overall operation level of an enterprise” are gradually recognized by the decision-making level of electric power companies. Logistics is the main body of the company’s operating profit, it can bring huge direct and indirect benefits to the enterprise. This paper discusses the design and implementation of a green supply chain management system for the power industry. Through the results of a user satisfaction survey, the paperemphasizes the user acceptance of the system’s ease of use and environmental benefits, but also suggests room for improvement in the system’s responsiveness. These findings provide guidance for the further application and development of green supply chain management systems in the power industry in the future.

articleTitle: Intelligent Decision System of Financial Robot Based on Computer Artificial Intelligence and Automatic Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and artificial intelligence technology, financial robots have gradually become a popular technology for enterprise financial management by virtue of their strong analog operation and automation advantages, which can greatly improve the work quality and efficiency of financial personnel and enhance the efficiency and accuracy of financial management. This paper deeply studies the basic concepts and technical characteristics of financial robots, and takes the financial center of a company as an example to further analyze the necessity, application effect evaluation and optimization measures of financial robots on the basis of artificial intelligence and automatic control, so as to comprehensively improve the operation and management level of enterprise financial system.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Detection and Self-healing Technology in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart grid technology, the stability and reliability of power system become more and more important. This study focuses on fault detection and self-healing technology in smart grid, aiming at improving the security and self-healing ability of power grid through advanced technical means. Firstly, this paper proposesa new fault detection method, which combines wavelet transform and machine learning technology to realize accurate and rapid identification of potential faults. Secondly, aiming at the self-healing technology, this paper designs a self-healing strategy based on multi-agent system, which can monitor the state of power grid in real time and automatically trigger selfhealing actions to restore the normal operation of power grid. The experimental results show that theproposed fault detection method has high sensitivity and accuracy, and the self-healing strategy can effectively ensure the stability of power supply in non-fault areas. This study not only provides a new technical path for fault detection and self-healing of smart grid, but also provides strong support for the safe and stable operation of power system, which has significant theoretical value and practical significance.

articleTitle: Simulation of Intrusion Response Model for Industrial Control Network Based on Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In order to respond more effectively to the increasingly complex network security threats, in order to improve the network security of industrial control systems, and to provide a more powerful network defense mechanism for industrial control systems. In this paper, an industrial control network intrusion response model is designed based on the fuzzy clustering algorithm. Firstly, by generalizing the intrusion feature set with a certain degree of similarity, the intrusion feature library matrix is established after standardization. Then, categorizing the set of intrusion features, creating a fuzzy matrix to determine the similarity between the matrices, and realizing the overall framework construction of the model according to the conditions of intrusion response determination, the design of industrial control network intrusion response model based on fuzzy clustering algorithm is completed. Through simulation, the risk factor of portscan attack reaches 0.830, which is higher than the threshold value of 0.4. At $12 \mathrm{~s}-20 \mathrm{~s}$, along with the increasing intensity of the attack, the network traffic and CPU utilization are increasing. The validation shows that the fuzzy algorithm successfully reduces the network traffic and decreases the CPU utilization.

articleTitle: Algorithm for User Profile Construction on New Media Platforms Driven by Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to develop and verify a user portrait construction algorithm based on new media platform, which combines advanced artificial intelligence technology. With the rapid development of new media, users are faced with massive information and content, so the demand for personalized service and recommendation is increasing. As a core technology, user portrait construction can capture users’ interests, characteristics and behaviors from multi-source data, and provide support for personalized recommendation, advertising positioning and other applications. Through a series of experiments, this study deeply verified the effectiveness of the proposed AI-based user portrait construction algorithm and feature engineering strategy. The experimental results show that appropriate feature engineering methods and models play a key role in the high-quality construction of user portraits. These findings provide strong support for the new media platform to realize more personalized and intelligent user experience and service. This study not only emphasizes the core role of feature engineering in the construction of user portraits based on AI, but also pays attention to the importance of data quality and privacy protection. Through the experimental verification, it provides practical guidance and profound insights for the construction of user portraits in the new media field, and shows the potential of the algorithm in improving the accuracy and efficiency of user portraits.

articleTitle: Integrated Algorithm for Electronic Power Management and Three-Level LLC Topology in the Field of Electrical Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of new energy sources such as new energy and electric vehicles in the world’s energy composition, there is an urgent need to develop efficient and low-cost power converters. In response to the above issues, this paper intends to study a power management method based on the three-level LLC (Inductor Capacitor) structure to achieve dynamic response and stability of the system during efficient energy conversion. The optimization method for the operation status of power electronic converters based on intelligent control strategies is suitable for complex loads and unstable power grid environments. By comparing the performance of the LLC converter in multiple operating states, the advantages of this method in energy conservation, stability, and other aspects were verified. The integrated algorithm achieved a 5% efficiency improvement under different load conditions, demonstrating its effectiveness and stability over a wide range of loads. The research results show that the integrated control strategy adopted can not only improve the work efficiency of the system, reduce the heat loss of the system, but also strengthen the resistance to external disturbances, thereby improving the comprehensive reliability and economy of the power grid. Meanwhile, the research findings of this paper will also promote the widespread application of power electronic devices in industries, power grids, and other fields. The implementation of this paper will provide technical support for the sustainable development of China’s power industry.

articleTitle: Software Defect Prediction Model Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: At present, under the background of the vigorous development of Internet technology and the era of the Internet of Everything, the diversification and complexity of software application scenarios are growing at an unprecedented rate. Although this trend has greatly enriched the user experience, it is also accompanied by the problem of frequent software failures. Software defects, as the key factor to weaken software reliability, are increasingly attracting extensive attention from the industry and academia. The software defect prediction model based on deep learning (DL) proposed in this article is a cutting-edge exploration in this field. This model fully utilizes the powerful ability of DL in processing large-scale and high-dimensional data, and can automatically learn complex features and patterns from historical data of software projects, achieving accurate prediction of software defects. The experimental results show that compared with traditional prediction methods, this model exhibits significant advantages in key indicators such as prediction accuracy and recall rate, effectively improving the comprehensiveness and accuracy of software defect prediction, and providing strong technical support for software testing and quality assurance work.

articleTitle: Research on Abnormal Detection and Intelligent Diagnosis Algorithm of Reservoir Test Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As an important basis for evaluating oilfield conditions, predicting productivity and formulating development strategies, the accuracy and reliability of reservoir test data are very important. However, the abnormal test data caused by many factors, if not detected and processed in time, will seriously affect the oilfield production decision, and even bring security risks and economic losses. Aiming at the problem of abnormal detection and intelligent diagnosis of reservoir test data, this study puts forward a solution that comprehensively uses statistics, machine learning and deep learning technology. In the design of anomaly detection algorithm, this study proposes an anomaly detection algorithm based on ensemble learning and adaptive threshold. By combining basic learners such as decision tree and support vector machine (SVM), and using Boosting integrated learning strategy and adaptive threshold mechanism, the algorithm significantly improves the accuracy and stability of anomaly detection. The experimental results show that, compared with the single decision tree and SVM algorithm, the ensemble learning algorithm in this study performs better in accuracy, recall and F1 score, reaching $0.95,0.92$ and 0.93 respectively. Further, this study designed an intelligent diagnosis algorithm, combined with abnormal detection results and other related data, such as equipment maintenance records, operation logs, etc., and built a classification model by using the Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM) to realize accurate diagnosis of abnormal causes. The intelligent diagnosis model not only provides targeted solution suggestions, but also improves the accuracy and efficiency of diagnosis through continuous optimization and feedback mechanism. This study not only improves the accuracy and reliability of reservoir test data, but also provides scientific decision support for oilfield staff, effectively improving the production efficiency and economic benefits of the oilfield.

articleTitle: Design of Industrial Automation Network Based on TSN and 5G Slice
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a new industrial automation network design scheme combining time-sensitive network (TSN) and 5G slicing technology is proposed. This scheme aims to solve the shortcomings of traditional network technology in real-time, reliability and flexibility, so as to meet the needs of modern industrial production. By constructing a network architecture consisting of data acquisition layer, data transmission layer, data processing and control layer, application and service layer and management and security layer, the design can ensure the accuracy and real-time performance of data acquisition, and meet different business requirements through 5 G slicing technology, such as real-time control, monitoring data upload, remote maintenance and so on. In addition, the scheme also adopts intelligent traffic scheduling algorithm and end-to-end security measures to improve the efficiency and security of data transmission. The experimental results show that the design scheme is superior to the traditional network scheme in real-time, reliability and security, especially in the high load and complex network environment, showing higher stability and efficiency. Therefore, this scheme provides an efficient, stable and safe network communication solution for the industrial automation field.

articleTitle: Simulation of Virtual Market Model of Tourism Industry Based on Generative Adversarial Networks Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This study explores the feasibility and effectiveness of applying Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) algorithm to simulate virtual market models in the tourism industry. Against the backdrop of sustained global economic growth and booming tourism industry, the complexity and variability of the tourism market pose challenges to policy formulation, market analysis, and strategy formulation. In order to predict the market dynamics more accurately and optimize the allocation of resources, this study uses GAN algorithm to build a virtual market model of tourism industry. By introducing the structure of Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks (cGAN), the model can receive additional conditional information, such as seasons, holidays, etc., thus generating market data matching specific conditions. The experimental results show that the cGAN model can successfully simulate the price fluctuation, consumer behavior and market trend of the tourism market, and provide an accurate forecast of tourism sales and consumer purchase decisions. In addition, cGAN model also reveals the comprehensive influence of seasons, holidays, promotional activities and economic policies on tourism sales.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Data Mining and Analysis in Aviation Technology Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In this study, the application and value of data mining and analysis are deeply discussed in the field of aviation technology management. Through the comprehensive application of advanced data mining technology and analysis methods, a large number of data in aviation industry are comprehensively analyzed. The research results show that data mining and analysis has a significant application effect in aviation technology management, which can effectively predict flight failures, optimize route planning and improve customer satisfaction, thus providing strong support for the safe operation and business development of airlines. This study also puts forward the technical popularization and practical guidance scheme, including strengthening personnel training, establishing data sharing mechanism and perfecting relevant laws and regulations, so as to promote the wide application of data mining and analysis technology in aviation field. Generally speaking, this study provides an important theoretical and practical basis for the application of data mining and analysis in aviation technology management, and is expected to promote the continuous innovation and development of aviation industry.

articleTitle: Intelligent Evaluation System of Power Grid External Information Based on Hierarchical Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As the external environment faced by power grid enterprises is becoming increasingly complex and volatile, the collection, analysis and utilization of external intelligence information is of great importance to key business activities such as decision-making, risk management and market forecasting. However, how to effectively evaluate the importance of external intelligence information has become an urgent problem. First, a scientific and reasonable evaluation index system is established. Then, the weights of these indicators were assigned based on the hierarchical analysis method. Finally, the degree of importance of information was evaluated through the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. Through the combination of qualitative and quantitative methods, a structured decision support tool is provided for power grid enterprises, which helps them to understand more clearly the degree of influence of different information on enterprise decision-making. The results of the study show that the hierarchical analysis method and the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method show good suitability in the evaluation of the importance of external intelligence information in power grid enterprises. The application of this evaluation method can help promote the systematization and standardization of the intelligence work of power grid enterprises and provide a complete evaluation system of the importance of intelligence information for enterprises.

articleTitle: Pattern Recognition and Prevention Algorithm of Complex Network Attack Based on Genetic Optimization Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Traditional means of security protection are unable to cope with complex and changeable network attacks. In order to improve the recognition ability of complex network attack patterns, this paper introduces genetic algorithm (GA)to optimize the weights and thresholds of neural networks. In this paper, a model based on multi-layer feedforward neural network (MFNN) is constructed, and the parameters of the neural network are optimized by using the global search and optimization characteristics of GA. GA improves the convergence speed and global search ability by adjusting thecrossover rate and mutation rate adaptively and adopting the strategy of multi-population co-evolution. The experimental part uses KDD Cup 1999 network intrusion detection data set, and carries out data cleaning, feature selection and data normalization. The experimental results show that the recognition accuracy of the neural network model optimizedby GA has been significantly improved, and the recognition accuracy of normal traffic has reached 90.0%, and the recognition accuracy of attack patterns such as DoS, U2R, R2L and Probe has also been improved to 85.0%, 75%, 80.0% and 90.0% respectively. Finally, based on the identification results, this paper puts forward corresponding prevention strategies, including traffic filtering, distributed defense, system update and patchmanagement, minimum authority principle, network isolation, security authentication and intrusion prevention system (IPS), which provide strong support for improving network security and stability. This study not only has theoretical value, but also has urgent practical needs, which provides an effective solution to deal with complex and changeable network attacks.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Green and Low Carbon Benefits and Collaborative Optimization of Electrical Carbon Coupling in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As society develops and progresses and people’s concept of life changes, the demand for low carbon and green living is becoming increasingly strong. Starting from the evaluation of green and low carbon benefits, this article studied the coupling and synergy of electrical carbon in the power system, and comprehensively considered its role in economic, environmental, and social benefits to comprehensively evaluate green and low carbon projects. The shadow price method was used to create a carbon emission assessment method, and the indicators that affect carbon emissions were studied. At the same time, the coupling phenomenon of electrical carbon in the power system was studied, and a two-stage system optimization model was constructed, providing a decision-making basis for policy-making. This article selected three scenarios to study the equilibrium of the electricity market in these three scenarios. It was found that under the background of green and low carbon benefit evaluation, the total income of scenarios $1-3$ was higher than before the experiment by 20134.9 yuan, 31267.2 yuan, and 39448.6 yuan, respectively. Studying the relationship between power generation and carbon emissions in the power system can achieve low carbon and efficient operation of the power system, providing theoretical and practical support for the promotion of green and low carbon.

articleTitle: Algorithm Optimization and Fraud Feature Mining in Audit Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In the analysis of audit data, algorithm optimization and fraud feature mining are important means to improve audit efficiency and accuracy. In this paper, an improved K-means clustering algorithm based on density (DBK-means) is proposed. By calculating the density of data points, the initial centroid is selected, the weighted distance measurement method is introduced, and the position and quantity of centroid are dynamically adjusted to adapt to the actual distribution of data. The experimental results show that the DBK-means algorithm is superior to the traditional K means algorithm in accuracy and recall, and it can find the hidden structure and grouping in data more accurately. In addition, this paper also combines association rule mining and anomaly detection technology to mine a series of financial indicators or transaction patterns that are highly related to fraud, such as accounts receivable turnover rate and inventory turnover rate. These fraud characteristics help auditors to identify and prevent fraud more effectively.

articleTitle: Intelligent Decision-Making Algorithm in the Steering Guidance System of Railway Locomotive Crew Based on Domain-specific Language
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Railway transportation, as an important mode of transportation, requires the flight attendants to make complex control decisions according to the real-time situation in order to ensure the safety and operation efficiency of the train. The traditional operation guidance system is often limited by fixed rules and strategies, and cannot adapt to the complex and changeable transportation environment, so it is necessary to introduce intelligent decision-making algorithm to improve the intelligent level of the system. The purpose of this paper is to study the design and application of intelligent decision-making algorithm in the steering guidance system of railway locomotive crew based on specific domain language. In this paper, firstly, the intelligent decision-making algorithms in the field of railway transportation are summarized and analyzed, and the application and advantages of DQL (Deep Q-Learning) algorithm in intelligent transportation system are emphatically introduced. Then, according to the characteristics and requirements of the steering guidance system for railway locomotive crew, the design scheme of intelligent decision algorithm based on DQL is put forward, and the principle and implementation method of the algorithm are introduced in detail. Through experiments and results analysis, this paper verifies the effectiveness and feasibility of intelligent decision-making algorithm based on DQL in the steering guidance system of railway locomotive crew. Compared with the traditional algorithm, DQL algorithm can achieve more efficient and accurate decision-making, and has better adaptability and stability. In this paper, the intelligent decision-making algorithm in the operation and guidance system of railway locomotive crew based on special domain language is deeply studied and discussed, which provides important theoretical support and technical guidance for the intelligent development of railway transportation.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of Communication Signal Processing Algorithm Based on Cognitive Radio
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This article aims to propose an effective solution to the problem of signal anomaly identification in wireless communication networks. Therefore, a communication signal processing algorithm based on Cognitive Radio (CR) is designed and implemented, and it is optimized with Differential Evolution (DE) algorithm to improve the recognition accuracy and data recovery ability of abnormal signals. The effectiveness and superiority of this method are verified by collecting a large number of wireless communication network signal data for experimental test. The experimental results show that this method can maintain high recognition accuracy and effectively identify and filter out abnormal signals in the network when dealing with a large number of signal data. Furthermore, this method also shows strong ability in error data repair, which can restore the original data more effectively. In addition, the energy efficiency simulation experiment shows that the proposed algorithm has higher detection rate and energy efficiency ratio than the traditional algorithm. Finally, through the signal coverage performance test, the advantages of this method in wireless communication network signal coverage are further verified.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Digital Twin Technology in Optimal Control of Distributed New Energy System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the transformation of global energy structure and the increasing demand for sustainable development, distributed new energy system (DNES) has attracted much attention because of its flexibility, high efficiency and environmental protection. However, the complexity of the system and changeable environmental conditions bring great challenges to its optimal control.
