In order to meet these challenges, this paper introduces the digital twin (DT) technology, which aims to monitor and predict the running state of the system in real time by constructing an accurate digital model of the system, and then put forward an optimal control strategy. Firstly, a multi-dimensional, multi-spatial and multi-scale DT model is constructed, which integrates time dimension, space dimension and energy dimension, and can fully reflect the dynamic change and energy flow of DNES. The model covers the start/stop time of equipment, the distance between equipment, energy generation, energy consumption and energy storage, etc., and is modeled from micro, meso and macro scales to ensure the accuracy and comprehensiveness of the model. In order to realize the real-time performance of DT model, this paper designs an efficient data acquisition and transmission system based on advanced sensors and 5G communication technology, which ensures the real-time performance and accuracy of all data in the system. On this basis, the DT model can monitor the running state of the system in real time, and find and diagnose the problems in the system in time through synchronous comparison with the actual data. Through the simulation analysis of DT model and the formulation of optimal control strategy, this paper puts forward an optimal control scheme for DNES. Taking the distributed wind power generation system as an example, the research shows that the power generation efficiency of the system can be significantly improved and energy consumption can be reduced by adjusting the control strategies such as fan speed and blade angle. After optimization, the energy consumption of the system is reduced by more than 20% in each month, which shows the remarkable effect of DT technology in improving the operation efficiency and stability of DNES.

articleTitle: Application and Research on Fusion Model and XGBoost Based on Linear Regression and Gray Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a NEVC Dataset is constructed using 11 index data selected through principal component analysis and data transformation. Correlation analysis is performed based on Spearman correlation coefficients to test the significance of the metrics and build a ridge regression model for exploring the degree of influence of different factors. Forecasting is conducted using a fusion model of linear regression and gray prediction as well as a machine learning-based XGBoost model. Granger causality test is employed to analyze the impact of various influencing factors on the industry, draw conclusions, and predict future trends.

articleTitle: Optimization and Application of Machining Process Based on Intelligent Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the intensification of manufacturing competition and the diversification of customer demand, the machining industry is facing unprecedented challenges. In order to improve production efficiency, reduce costs and meet the requirements of high-quality products, technological innovation and process optimization are urgently needed in the industry. By analyzing the principle of intelligent control algorithm and its application in machining, this paper puts forward an intelligent control strategy combining fuzzy control and neural network to realize real-time monitoring and dynamic parameter adjustment of machining process. This study introduces the proposed optimization scheme in detail, including the design of fuzzy controller, the construction of neural network model and their fusion application in machining parameter adjustment. The experimental design is based on a precision mechanical parts processing factory. By monitoring cutting force, temperature, vibration and other data in real time, the machining parameters such as cutting speed, feed rate and cutting depth are dynamically adjusted by intelligent control algorithm to optimize the machining process. The experimental results show that the optimization scheme of machining process based on intelligent control algorithm has achieved remarkable results in improving machining accuracy, efficiency and stability. Compared with the traditional machining mode, the intelligent control mode is superior in reducing the dimensional deviation of bearing sleeve, improving machining accuracy and product consistency. At the same time, the intelligent control mode improves the production efficiency, reduces the production cost and enhances the competitiveness of enterprises by reducing the overall processing time. This study not only verifies the effectiveness of intelligent control algorithm in machining, but also provides new ideas and methods for the continuous innovation and development of machining industry.

articleTitle: Algorithm of Robot Visual Perception and Environment Interaction Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, the visual perception and environmental interaction of robot technology in complex and changeable environment has become a research hotspot. In this paper, an algorithm of robot visual perception and environment interaction based on deep learning is proposed, aiming at solving the limitations of traditional methods in dealing with complex and dynamic scenes. The algorithm uses pre-trained ResNet as feature extractor, combined with YOLO7 target detection algorithm, and realizes fast and accurate detection and recognition of objects in the image. The detected targets are classified by softmax function, and the scene is deeply understood by using conditional random field (CRF) technology, which improves the robot’s overall ability to grasp the environment. In the aspect of path planning, the algorithm uses reinforcement learning technology and continuously optimizes the decision-making strategy through Q-learning method, thus realizing the autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance of the robot in the dynamic environment. Experimental results show that this algorithm has high accuracy and robustness in complex scenes such as multiple similar objects recognition, illumination change recognition and partial occlusion recognition, and the path planning accuracy is better than Dijkstra algorithm, and the overall performance is better than other deep learning algorithms (Faster R-CNN, SSD, YOLOv5). This study not only verifies the effectiveness of the robot visual perception and environment interaction algorithm based on deep learning, but also provides new ideas and methods for the future development of robot technology.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Computing Simulation Platform for Future Network Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of cloud computing, Internet of Things (IoT), big data and AI technologies, the research of future network architecture is facing new challenges and opportunities. In order to meet the simulation requirements of future network architecture research for high performance, high fidelity and high scalability, this paper designs and implements an intelligent computing simulation platform for future network architecture. Combining cloud computing, big data analysis and AI technology, the platform aims to provide a powerful, flexible and realistic network simulation environment to support researchers’ research, development and testing of network protocols, algorithms and system performance. The platform adopts modular design, including front-end, back-end and database, which ensures the efficient cooperation of the system and the smooth flow of data. The core functions of the platform include network modeling, simulation execution, data analysis and visual display. The platform also integrates intelligent technologies such as cloud computing, big data analysis and AI, which significantly improves the fidelity and efficiency of simulation. Through the system test, the excellent performance of the platform in simulation accuracy, response time and stability is verified. The platform provides a powerful, efficient and realistic simulation environment for the future research and development of network architecture, which is of great significance for promoting the development and innovation of network technology in the future.

articleTitle: Dimension Reduction Algorithm of Power and Government-Enterprise Data Fusion Based on Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the high-dimensional characteristics of electric power and government-enterprise data, this paper proposes a data fusion dimension reduction algorithm based on principal component analysis (PCA). This method aims to extract the main components from the data by PCA technology, so as to reduce the dimension of the data, while retaining key information, which is convenient for subsequent data processing and analysis. On this basis, K-Means clustering algorithm is further applied to cluster the data after dimensionality reduction to identify different electricity consumption behaviors or enterprise types. The experimental results show that the algorithm can effectively reduce the dimension of electric power and government-enterprise data, and reveal the potential structure and pattern in the data. The distribution of data points in two-dimensional space is observed by clustering, which provides powerful data support and decision-making basis for power enterprises and government agencies. This study not only improves the efficiency of data processing, but also provides new ideas and methods for data mining and analysis in related fields.

articleTitle: Optimization and Management Strategies of Electric Two Wheeled Vehicle Battery Exchange Network Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore artificial intelligence based methods for optimizing and managing the battery swapping network of electric two wheeled vehicles. With the rapid expansion of the electric two wheeled vehicle market, the effective layout and management strategy of battery swapping stations have become the key to improving energy efficiency and user satisfaction. This article proposes a solution based on the GA-CNN (Genetic Algorithm based Convolutional Neural Network) fusion algorithm by analyzing the challenges faced by current battery swapping networks. The algorithm used in this study can not only optimize the layout of the exchange station, but also adjust management strategies in real-time to respond to changes in demand. Four experiments were designed during the experimental phase to evaluate the optimization and management strategies of the electric two wheeled vehicle battery swapping network based on the GA-CNN optimization model. In the first demand prediction evaluation experiment, the mean squared error (MSE) based on the GA-CNN model was 2.8. In the experiment of optimizing the layout of swapping stations, a GA-CNN strategy was used to achieve a coverage rate of $\mathbf{9 5 \%}$, while reducing the average arrival time of users to the nearest swapping station to 5 minutes. In the efficiency experiment of the battery swapping network, the processing capacity of the battery swapping station reached 60 times per hour based on the GA-CNN optimization strategy. The average waiting time for users was only 5 minutes. In the final real-time adjustment strategy response capability experiment, based on the GA-CNN optimization strategy, the service satisfaction rate reached 98% with a response time of 15 minutes, and the change in operating costs was only 5%. From the above experimental conclusions, it can be seen that the GA-CNN optimization model has shown significant advantages in key aspects such as demand prediction, site layout optimization, operational efficiency improvement, and real-time adjustment response ability of electric two wheeled vehicle battery swapping networks, reflecting the potential of the GA-CNN model as an effective battery swapping network management strategy.

Author Keywords: Electric Two Wheeled Vehicle Battery Swapping Network

articleTitle: Prediction Algorithm of Dance Movement Rhythm and Coordination Based on Time Series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Dance, an art form expressed through the human body, demands exceptional flexibility, posture, and movement coordination from its performers. Coordination stands as a pivotal aesthetic aspect of dance and a fundamental skill for dancers. The rich diversity of dance styles reflects the socio-cultural and historical backgrounds of various ethnic groups, offering distinct perspectives on life. In this study, we integrate a practical approach with theoretical analysis to investigate dance movement rhythm and coordination using time series data from dance training sessions. By employing advanced algorithms, we conducted an in-depth analysis focused on rotational stability and the center of gravity. Experimental results indicate that our algorithm consistently achieved a rotational stability score fluctuating around 9.09 points, with a similar performance in center of gravity tests, scoring approximately 9.25 points. In comparison, other techniques like Deep Learning (DL) and Genetic Algorithms (GA) exhibited a wider score range and lower overall scores. This underscores the superiority of our proposed algorithm in predicting dance movement rhythm and coordination. Mastering this technique is paramount for dance students seeking to enhance their future performances.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis and Prediction Technology of Digital Power Grid Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the increasing complexity and scale of power system, traditional fault diagnosis and prediction methods are facing many challenges. Therefore, this study uses big data analysis technology to mine hidden information and patterns in massive operation data to achieve more accurate fault diagnosis and prediction. Firstly, this study uses data mining technology to extract fault-related features from complex power grid operation data. Secondly, support vector machine (SVM) and random forest (RF) supervised learning algorithm are used for fault diagnosis. In addition, by integrating several basic learners (SVM and RF), the final fault diagnosis and prediction results are obtained by voting. This integrated learning strategy can improve the generalization ability and stability of the model. The experimental results show that the fault diagnosis and prediction model based on ensemble learning proposed in this study is superior to other commonly used methods in accuracy, recall and F1 score. Especially when dealing with complex and uncertain power grid faults, this method shows higher robustness and accuracy. This study not only puts forward an effective fault diagnosis and prediction method for digital power grid, but also overcomes the limitations of traditional methods through big data analysis technology, which provides strong support for the stable operation of power grid system.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality Technology and Algorithm Application in Intelligent Combat Training Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, intelligent combat training simulation system has become an important part of modern military training, which provides a brand-new training method for military personnel through highly simulated virtual environment. Virtual reality (VR) technology builds an immersive and interactive virtual battlefield environment based on computer graphics, human-computer interaction and sensing technology, which significantly enhances the reality and effect of training. Trainers can get a realistic battlefield experience through head-mounted displays and other equipment, so as to pay more attention to the training itself and improve their combat capability and ability to cope with complex battlefield environment. Algorithms play a vital role in the intelligent combat training simulation system, especially the application of AI and machine learning algorithms, which enable the system to intelligently adjust the training difficulty, simulate the behavior of the enemy and realize personalized training experience. By analyzing the behavior and performance of trainers, the algorithm dynamically adjusts the training content and generates a more realistic and changeable battlefield situation, which is helpful to improve the decision-making level and coping ability of trainers. In addition, the system can provide more personalized training suggestions for trainers and optimize the training effect through data mining and analysis. Taking “God of War Simulation Training System” as an example, this paper analyzes the application of VR technology and algorithm in intelligent combat training simulation system in detail. Through highly integrated VR technology and advanced algorithms, the system provides military personnel with a variety of environmental models, including urban street fighting and mountain fighting, which significantly enhances the sense of reality and urgency of training. At the same time, the system also integrates machine learning algorithm, which enables the enemy AI to intelligently adjust tactics and strategies according to the battlefield situation, and provides trainers with a more challenging battle experience. In the future, with the continuous progress of technology, the application of VR technology and algorithm in intelligent combat training simulation system will be more extensive and in-depth, bringing revolutionary changes to military training.

articleTitle: ECG Signal Classification Algorithm Based on Improved VGG Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Efficient, accurate, and fast classification of ECG signals has always been a key focus in the field of ECG diagnosis. This paper presents an algorithm for ECG signal classification that enhances the VGG network. The traditional VGG network is improved for different categories by optimizing the connection layer structure. Additionally, depth separable convolution is introduced to reduce model parameters and improve training efficiency. Since ECG signals contain a significant amount of temporal feature information, a long short-term memory network model is incorporated to capture temporal correlations within the data. Four classifications are then implemented using softmax. Experimental results demonstrate that the enhanced model achieves a classification accuracy of $\mathbf{9 3. 6 \%}$.

articleTitle: Multi-source Information Data Fusion Method between Heterogeneous Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This study strives to tackle the complexities of merging multi-source data on diverse platforms and introduces a novel data fusion approach leveraging deep learning (DL). Data from various sources is seamlessly amalgamated via preprocessing techniques including data purification, format conversion, and normalization. The study employs an attention-based fusion mechanism that adaptively learns and assigns importance to features from each data source. Experimental results indicate that our method outperforms alternative approaches in terms of precision, F1 score, and other metrics, demonstrating excellent performance and stability. Notably, our accuracy and F1 score exceed $90 \%$, with a mean squared error (MSE) of approximately 4.11. This innovative approach paves the way for multi-source data fusion on heterogeneous platforms and holds promise for broad application across multiple domains. Future directions encompass assessing the method’s real-world performance, bolstering data security, seeking efficient model training techniques, and broadening its applicability.

articleTitle: Integrated Application of BIM Technology and Data Mining Algorithms in Substation Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This study explores the integrated application of BIM (Building Information Modeling) technology and data mining algorithms in substation engineering. Through the introduction of BIM technology, the information management of the whole life cycle of substation projects can be realized, so as to improve the efficiency and quality of design, construction and operation and maintenance. At the same time, the application of data mining algorithms can extract valuable information from a large amount of engineering data, providing a scientific basis for engineering decision-making. This paper first analyzes the current situation and advantages of the application of BIM technology in substation engineering, and then introduces the specific application of data mining algorithms in engineering data processing and analysis. Then, this paper proposes the integrated application method of BIM technology and data mining algorithm, and verifies its effectiveness through specific cases. The study shows that the integrated application of BIM technology and data mining algorithms can significantly improve the intelligent level of substation engineering, optimize resource allocation, improve engineering management efficiency, and provide an important reference for the future construction of smart grid.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of an Intelligent Question Answering System Integrates Natural Language Processing and Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, intelligent question answering system (QAS) has become an important tool for users to obtain information. This paper aims to design an intelligent QAS which integrates naturallanguage processing (NLP) and knowledge graph (KG), and optimize its performance. By effectively combining NLP with KG technology, the system can accurately understand the semantic information of users’ questions and provide users with accurate and comprehensive answers with the support of KG. Firstly, this paper introduces the development background and technical challenges of intelligent QAS, especially the important role of NLP and KG in the system. Thenthe architecture design of the system is described in detail, including input layer, processing layer and output layer, and the main functions and technical realization of each layer are introduced. In the aspect of system optimization, this paper puts forward query pruning strategy based on heuristic rules, caching mechanism and semantic understanding ability improvement strategy based on BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) model, anddesigns a set of regular updating and maintenance mechanism of KG. Through the experimental verification of two public data sets, WikiQA and TREC QA, the system shows high accuracy and recall rate, which proves the reliability and effectiveness of the intelligent QAS designed in this paper in practical application. This research not only enriches the theoretical basis of intelligent QAS, but also provides new ideas and methods for practical application in related fields.

articleTitle: Intelligent Standardization Method for Multidimensional Information System Logs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of socioeconomic level and the rapid growth of information technology, the application of multidimensional information systems (IS) in various industries is becoming increasingly widespread, and the generated log data is also becoming increasingly large and complex. These log data contain critical information about system operation, which is of great significance for system management, monitoring, and troubleshooting. However, the massive amount of log data also poses significant challenges to the management and analysis of logs. To address this issue, this paper proposes a multidimensional IS log intelligent normalization method based on artificial intelligence (AI). This method combines machine learning (ML) and data mining (DM) techniques to transform log data in multidimensional IS into a unified, readable, and analyzable format, thus achieving effective utilization of log data. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this article can significantly improve the availability and analysis efficiency of log data, provide strong support for system monitoring and troubleshooting, and also provide valuable data support for business decision-making.

articleTitle: Competitive Model Analysis Based on Volterra Prey-Predator Model and Multisubjective Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In this paper, we analyzed the lamprey ecosystem based on the Volterra predation-prey model and the multispecies ecological model. Initially, a Volterra predationprey model was developed to select specific organisms as food and predators to adapt to the larger ecosystem. Considering sex differences in predation rates and vulnerability, MATLAB was used to construct dynamic growth equations. The parameters were varied to explore their effects on the model. Finally, we modeled the effects of parameter changes on the system. And we tested the stability of the ecosystem based on the eigenvalues of the Jacobi matrix. In conclusion, the sex ratio of lamprey affects the stability and resource dependence of the ecosystem to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Algorithm Development for Prediction and Control of Pollutant Emissions in Chemical Production
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of chemical production, the negative impacts of pollutant emissions on the environment are becoming more and more serious, and the prediction and control of pollutant emissions in chemical production has become a key issue in the field of environmental protection. The purpose of this paper is to develop an efficient pollutant emission prediction and control algorithm, through data acquisition and processing, model construction and optimization, combined with real-time monitoring and feedback mechanisms, to achieve effective prediction and control of pollutant emissions in the chemical production process. Firstly, this paper introduces in detail the main pollutant sources and their emission characteristics in chemical production; secondly, a pollutant emission prediction model based on multiple algorithms (such as linear regression, neural network and support vector machine) is proposed, and the model is trained and validated by actual data; finally, a set of pollutant emission control strategies based on the prediction results is designed, and its validity is verified in a typical case. The results show that the algorithm can significantly improve the accuracy of pollutant emission prediction and effectively reduce the pollutant emissions in chemical production, providing important technical support for environmental protection.

articleTitle: Optimization of Power Grid Maintenance Cost Management Based on Intelligent Fuzzy Algorithm and Standard Operation Cost Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The maintenance and operation costs account for half of the controllable costs of power grid enterprises. With the increasing investment in power grid construction year by year, the operation and maintenance costs show a continuous upward trend, making it urgent to reasonably control the maintenance costs. Currently, the commonly used method for power grid maintenance cost accounting is the full cost method based on quotas, which has unclear cost allocation and is difficult to control activities with high costs. This article proposes a comprehensive evaluation of power grid maintenance based on intelligent fuzzy algorithm, considering various factors of the power grid to determine the maintenance plan. Moreover, the standard operation cost management theory is applied to the power grid maintenance cost management. The power grid maintenance standard operation cost management system and management process are detailed, providing a reference for power grid enterprises to reduce costs and improve efficiency.

articleTitle: Intelligent Algorithm Evaluation and Optimization of the Impact of Exercise Training on Cognitive Function
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Physical exercise, as a widely advocated activity that promotes the healthy development of the human body, has a profound impact not only on enhancing physical fitness and improving physical fitness, but also extends to actively promoting cognitive function in the human body. Based on in-depth research and analysis of biological principles, this article systematically explores the multidimensional effects of exercise training on human cognitive function. To further maximize the effectiveness of sports training, this paper innovatively proposes an intelligent evaluation system for sports training based on big data analysis. The system integrates advanced sensor technology, artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms, and machine learning (ML) methods to monitor and record various physiological indicators and behavioral data during exercise training in real time, and then conduct in-depth analysis and personalized evaluation. The experimental results show that the system can not only accurately identify the training status and effectiveness of athletes, but also provide customized training suggestions and feedback based on individual differences, effectively improving the scientificity and efficiency of sports training.

articleTitle: Annual Academic Achievement Level Prediction Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the continuous development and progress of machine learning related technologies, this technology is increasingly being used by people from all walks of life to solve various problems encountered in the industry. This paper combines machine learning technology with the field of student management in this application context, and proposes a machine learning based annual academic achievement level prediction method. The method first uses the academic achievements exported from the academic administration system as the data source; Then use visual charts to preliminarily visualize the raw data, try to observe the data, and draw simple conclusions; Next, the machine learning model (using the random forest algorithm in this article) was trained, validated, and tested using the training set, validation set, and test set of the data. The optimal model parameter was found to be 17 decision trees, and the model scored 1.0 in the training set, 0.8667 in the validation set, and 1.0 in the test set; Finally, through actual testing, it was found that the model accurately predicted the results for the new samples obtained, and it can be widely used in the future.

articleTitle: Energy Consumption Optimization Method for Intelligent IoT Buildings Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As an important symbol of modern urban development, intelligent buildings have increasingly become a bottleneck restricting sustainable development due to their high energy consumption. This not only leads to huge economic costs, but also exacerbates environmental burdens, resulting in a large amount of waste of non renewable resources. Faced with this challenge, the rapid development of Internet of Things (IoT) technology is like a clear current, bringing unprecedented opportunities for energy management in smart buildings. This technological innovation has laid a solid foundation for achieving seamless integration and data sharing among various systems within the building. In order to further explore the potential of IoT, this article innovatively proposes an intelligent IoT building energy consumption optimization method based on big data analysis. This method collects and integrates massive data generated by various systems within the building, uses advanced big data analysis techniques to deeply explore the hidden patterns and patterns behind the data, and accurately identifies peak energy consumption periods, inefficient operation links, and potential energy-saving spaces. The experimental results show that this method not only effectively reduces the overall energy consumption of buildings, but also significantly improves energy efficiency, opening up a new path for the green and low-carbon development of smart buildings.

articleTitle: Small Radius Curve Negotiation Performance Analysis of Electromagnetic Suspension (EMS) High-Speed Maglev Train
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: TheEMS (Electromagnetic Suspension) high-speed maglev train employs electromagnetic force as the primary means for both levitation and guidance The safety and comfort when the train transitions from a straight line to a small radius curve need in-depth research. Taking a small radius curve of 400 m as an example, this paper first theoretically calculates the curve and transition curve lengths, cross slope angles, and the safe passing speed of the train. Considering the intricate active suspension and guidance control system, a precise dynamic model of the EMS high-speed maglev train is constructed, calibrated with theoretical line condition parameters for enhanced academic rigor. The kinematic posture and vibrational responses of the car-body, secondary suspension, suspension frame, and associated components are comprehensively simulated and analyzed, with a critical evaluation of the train’s curve traversal performance. The results show that, according to the theoretical calculation of R 400 m small radius curve parameters, when the train passes at the speed of $88.64 \mathrm{~km} / \mathrm{h}$, the roll angels of the car-body and suspension frame are within the safe range, the fluctuation of levitation gap is not exceed 4 $\mathbf{m m}$, and the fluctuation of guidance gap is close to $\mathbf{6} \mathbf{~ m m}$.

articleTitle: Data Processing Technology of UAV Tilt Photogrammetry Based on Multi-source Geographic Information
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of UAV technology, UAV tilt photogrammetry has become one of the important means to obtain geographic information data. However, due to the challenges of diverse geographic information data sources and inconsistent data quality, how to effectively integrate multi-source geographic information data has become a key issue. Aiming at this problem, this study proposes an image fusion method based on deep learning, aiming at improving the fusion quality and processing efficiency of geographic information data. Firstly, the basic principle and data acquisition process of UAV tilt photogrammetry are introduced, including aircraft selection, route planning, selection of photographic equipment and sensors. Then, the methods and technologies of multi-source geographic information fusion are discussed, including data preprocessing, feature extraction, data registration and image fusion. Then, the specific implementation steps and algorithms of the image fusion method based on deep learning adopted in this paper are expounded. Through the verification on experimental data sets, the advantages of the proposed method are demonstrated, including fusion effect, model performance and processing efficiency. Finally, the research results are summarized and analyzed, and the significance and application prospect of this method in the fusion of multi-source geographic information are pointed out.

articleTitle: Simulation of a Novel Wide-area Source-load Interaction Scheduling Model for Power Systems Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The traditional genetic algorithm in path planning has slow convergence speed, easy to premature and poor path quality. An improved genetic algorithm for path planning is proposed to improve both the crossover operator and the variation operator of the algorithm, and the heuristic crossover operator with adaptive strategy adjusted variation operator is designed to obtain the optimal solution. Path planning algorithm based on viewable view with improved genetic algorithm. The objective function of effectiveness is constructed and the optimal scheduling model of electronic warfare resources is established, and then the optimal scheduling plan of resources using the improved genetic algorithm model is utilized. The coordinates of the main point of the image are closer to the reference value, which can better alleviate the phenomenon of premature convergence and stagnation and improve the calibration accuracy.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis of CPI Based on Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In recent decades, with the vigorous development of the national economy, the living standards of residents have also risen, and various types of consumption have emerged. In order to study the consumption situation of residents, the government has proposed the Consumer Price Index (CPI) as an indicator to reflect changes in their consumption and service levels. In order to better study the Consumer Price Index, this paper proposes a predictive analysis method for CPI based on machine learning algorithms. The first stage of this research method involves data visualization, which includes two small steps: data preparation explanation and chart visualization. This stage mainly provides initial basis for subsequent modeling; The second stage is the highlight of machine learning (random forest) algorithm modeling, which uses the monthly indices of national, city, and rural levels to train the model separately, with scores of $0.9927,0.9936$, and 0.9919 respectively, and draws the best fitting line; The third stage is for the model to predict the new data for the next month. Through the verification of the entire process mentioned above, the model in this article has good predictive performance and can effectively help solve the problem of CPI prediction.

articleTitle: Power System Visualization Enhancement Technology Guided by Force-oriented Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In response to the problems of a large number of congested areas, chaotic power lines, and low visualization level in the topology diagram of the power system, this article focuses on the force-oriented algorithm and explores its application in the field of power system visualization. The aim is to enhance the visualization effect of the power system by optimizing layout, improving readability, and aesthetics. Firstly, the force-oriented algorithm is used to construct the power grid model of the power system, calculating the number of iterations of the force-oriented algorithm and the local density of the grid model. Finally, the balance of the power lines in the power grid system is found through attraction and repulsion, avoiding overlap between power stations and other lines, and achieving optimization of power line routing between power stations. The experiment showed that the congested areas in the power system topology map were reduced by 65.4%, and duplicate elements were reduced to 0%. The results indicate that this method can effectively improve the visualization effect of power topology maps for large-scale power systems, while adhering to the true geographical location of power elements. It greatly enhances the interaction between the power system and humans, as well as the visualization of the power system.

articleTitle: Development of IC Scheduling Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: IC integrated circuits are the core component of modern electronic products, and their production process is complex and precise. Therefore, popularizing human knowledge of IC integrated circuits and introducing the concept of integrated circuit scheduling can effectively promote industrial automation and reduce labor costs. Making scientific decisions is extremely important and requires further exploration. This system adopts a front-end and back-end separation development mode, with Vue used for front-end development, which is used to build user interfaces and single page applications, and send requests to the back-end to obtain data and perform operations; The backend is developed using Spring Boot, which is used to build Java application frameworks, handle requests sent by the frontend, retrieve data from the database, execute business logic, and return results to the frontend. This combination approach can more flexibly and efficiently build modern web applications. The system also uses sorting algorithms and collaborative filtering algorithms, among which the sorting algorithm can prioritize each added task based on the user’s selection, based on hardware input parameters, and process the process according to the priority order. This can more efficiently complete the processing process and provide users with a platform and application reference for learning integrated circuit related knowledge and communication.

articleTitle: Intelligent Energy Meter Data Analysis and Anomaly Detection Combined with Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the exponential growth of population and the widespread use of electronic and electrical equipment in daily life, energy production and management are facing unprecedented challenges. Smart energy meters (SMs) are an indispensable part of modern power systems (EPS), and their accuracy and reliability are crucial for the stable operation of the power system. However, due to the fact that SM is usually deployed on the user side, the operating environment is complex and variable, and there is currently a lack of effective technical management methods, which has led to an increasing demand for real-time monitoring and anomaly detection of SM operation status. To effectively address this challenge, this article proposes a SM data analysis and anomaly detection system that combines big data technology and deep learning (DL). The system collects massive data generated by SM during operation, and uses big data technology for preprocessing, analysis, and mining to obtain comprehensive information on the operating status of electricity meters. At the same time, combined with the DL algorithm, the system can automatically learn and recognize the normal and abnormal behavior patterns of the electricity meter, thereby achieving accurate anomaly detection. The experimental results show that the system can accurately analyze the operating status of SM and effectively detect abnormal behavior.

articleTitle: Application of AI in capturing and rendering animated character movements
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Animation is essentially a product of the integration of art and technology. The application and development of technology determines the efficiency and effect of animation production to a large extent. This article divides the development history of animation production into the hand-painted era, the three-dimensional era and the AIGC era according to the different levels of technology application and development. It focuses on analyzing the impact of AIGC on the current animation industry and teaching, and believes that although AI has improved the efficiency of animation production, can assist creators to quickly generate creative ideas and enrich animation details, but there are still many limitations in practical applications. In the entire animation creation process, human creativity and artistic understanding are always irreplaceable core parts.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Water Conservancy Project Construction Schedule Control Based on Multi-objective Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The construction of water conservancy and hydropower projects is highly complex and systematic, significantly contributing to China’s economic growth and social advancement. Within these projects, managing the construction timeline is a crucial aspect of the organizational design, requiring adherence to specific steps and procedures throughout the building process. Control the progress, cost and quality of the project through the process of overall conception, scheme selection, organization and implementation. Considering some uncertain factors in the construction process, this paper studies the construction schedule optimization and control principles of large-scale water conservancy projects, and gives the corresponding optimization and control methods and advanced technical means. Create maximum economic benefits on the premise of ensuring smooth progress and qualified quality. This paper will briefly introduce the application of multi eye algorithm in the uniqueness of optimizing the construction progress of hydraulic engineering is only for reference.

articleTitle: Advanced Feature Extraction Algorithms for Deep Learning in Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Image recognition is an important research direction in the field of modern computer vision (CV), and extracting image features is its core step, and its efficiency directly determines the speed and accuracy of the entire image recognition. In recent years, deep learning (DL) technology has made significant breakthroughs in the field of CV, especially in image classification tasks, thanks to its powerful feature representation ability. Among them, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), as an important branch of DL, have achieved commendable results in image recognition and classification tasks with their unique convolution and pooling operations. This article proposes a CNN algorithm based on the combination of attention mechanism (Attention-CNN), aiming to improve the efficiency and accuracy of image feature extraction. The attention mechanism can guide the network to pay more attention to key regions in the image during the feature extraction process, thereby extracting more representative and robust advanced features. The experimental results show that compared with traditional CNN algorithms, our algorithm has improved image recognition accuracy and feature extraction efficiency.

articleTitle: Application of Cloud Computing in Power Grid Dispatch System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The power grid dispatch system, a pivotal component in smart grid advancement, directly influences the stability and reliability of the entire power grid through its operational efficiency and intelligence. Given the escalating electricity demand and the growing complexity of power grid structures, conventional dispatch systems are inadequate for modern management. Consequently, a multi-regional and collaborative computing model has emerged as a novel trend in power grid dispatch development, with cloud computing technology offering robust support. By leveraging cloud computing platforms, the dispatch system can centralize the processing and analysis of data from multiple regions, enhancing the understanding of grid operations and informing scientific decision-making. This article explores the integration of cloud computing in power grid dispatch systems and presents a design for a cloud-based dispatch system. This system facilitates real-time data collection, transmission, storage, and processing via a cloud platform, while enabling joint scheduling and collaborative computing across regions. Experimental results highlight its exceptional performance in data processing, real-time control, and intelligence, providing substantial technical backing for the power grid dispatch system.

articleTitle: Design of Real-time Monitoring and Management System for Digital Power Grid Equipment Based on Intelligent Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a design scheme of real-time monitoring and management system for digital power grid equipment based on intelligent analysis is proposed. The system aims to monitor the running state of power grid equipment in real time, and use intelligent analysis technology to deeply mine the data, so as to realize the prediction and early warning of equipment faults, thus providing a strong guarantee for the safe and stable operation of power grid. The core of the system design is to build an efficient and stable realtime monitoring and management framework for the running state of power grid equipment, including data acquisition layer, data transmission layer, data processing layer and application layer. In the aspect of intelligent analysis algorithm, the system adopts a mixed model, which combines the advantages of traditional statistical methods, machine learning and deep learning to improve the sensitivity and accuracy of anomaly detection. The performance test of the system shows that the system can stably receive and process the data transmission rate, and ensure the timely processing of real-time data. The average accuracy rate of the algorithm is over $\mathbf{9 5 \%}$, which shows high reliability. In addition, the system runs continuously for more than 100 hours, during which there is no crash or performance degradation, which proves the stability of the system. The security test results show that the system can effectively resist common network attacks and protect the integrity of data and services.

articleTitle: Research on Clustering and Pattern Mining Technology for Power Business Mapping Analysis of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern power system and the increasing scale of power grid, the operation and management of power business are facing many challenges. Especially in the era of big data, how to extract valuable information from massive power grid data to optimize the operation and management of power business has become a research hotspot. In this paper, an improved K-means clustering algorithm-Weighted K-means (WK-means) and Weighted Sequential Pattern Mining (WSPM) is proposed to deeply analyze the mapping relationship of power services in power grid. WK-means algorithm improves the accuracy and robustness of clustering by introducing the weight of data points; WSPM method can identify frequent sequence patterns in power grid data more accurately by considering the weights of elements in the sequence. The experimental results show that WK-means algorithm can successfully cluster power grid data into different load periods, while WSPM method can effectively mine frequent sequence patterns of power load, equipment status and other characteristics. These research results provide valuable reference information for optimal dispatching, equipment maintenance and demand forecasting of power grid, and have important application prospects.

articleTitle: Efficient, Reliable, and Scalable Distributed Data Processing Based on Hadoop
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid growth of information technology and the intelligent upgrading of terminal devices, the amount of data in modern society is showing an explosive growth trend. These data are not only large-scale, but also structurally diverse. This data characteristic poses significant challenges to traditional data processing and storage methods. Although traditional distributed database and data warehouse technologies can to some extent cope with large-scale data processing, efficiency and flexibility are still limited when dealing with unstructured and massive data. In this context, the emergence of Hadoop and Map Reduce technologies has provided new solutions for large-scale data processing. Hadoop has become one of the mainstream technologies for handling big data due to its simple programming model, good scalability, and powerful fault tolerance. This article designs a distributed data processing system based on Hadoop, which fully utilizes the efficiency, high reliability, and high scalability of Hadoop, aiming to meet the needs of large-scale data processing. The experimental results show that the system in this paper has demonstrated excellent performance and stability in practical applications, and can process massive data, providing an effective solution for large-scale data processing.

articleTitle: Electronic Information Intelligent Decision and Control Technology Integrating Big Data and Intelligent Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As the Internet of Things (IoT) and artificial intelligence (AI) technologies are rapidly developing, intelligent decision-making and control systems have become a very important part of many fields, including electronic information. This article proposes an electronic information intelligent decision-making and control technology that integrates big data analysis and intelligent algorithms, aiming to better build intelligent decision-making and control systems. By proposing a BP (Back propagation) neural network based on genetic algorithm optimization, this paper analyzes the optimization process of this algorithm model and constructs a complete intelligent decision-making and control system structure based on big data and intelligent algorithms. Moreover, through multidimensional comparative experiments, this article demonstrates the effectiveness and universality of our method. In the final application test in smart home systems, taking the failure rate as an example, the average failure rate of the experimental group was 4.36%, and the average failure rate of the control group was 5.71%. Therefore, this study found that the integration of big data and intelligent algorithms could effectively build electronic information intelligent decision-making and control systems.

articleTitle: Construction of College English Teaching Quality Evaluation Model Based on RBF Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the acceleration of globalization and the internationalization of education, the importance of College English teaching quality evaluation (CETQE) has become increasingly prominent. Traditional methods, such as questionnaire survey and students’ grading, are simple and easy to implement, but they are easily influenced by subjective factors, so it is difficult to comprehensively and objectively reflect the teaching quality. For this reason, this paper introduces RBF neural network (RBFNN), which uses its powerful nonlinear mapping ability and adaptability to simulate and capture the complex relationships in TQE. Firstly, principal Component Analysis (PCA) is employed to identify the crucial TQE indicators across various dimensions, such as instructional content, pedagogical approaches, interactions between educators and students, and educational outcomes, thereby ensuring both the thoroughness and precision of the assessment. Subsequently, a RBFNN architecture is devised, comprising an input layer, a concealed layer, and an output layer. The input layer incorporates five handpicked evaluative metrics, the hidden layer utilizes the Gaussian function as its activation mechanism, with its core vector and breadth parameters being initialized via the K-means clustering technique. Conversely, the output layer ascertains the teaching quality score through a process of linear amalgamation. Empirical findings demonstrate that the TQE model, grounded in RBFNN, markedly outperforms conventional models like linear regression and decision trees in terms of precision and recall. Within a dataset of 103 instances, the RBFNN model’s accuracy on the testing set attains 90%, while the recollection rates for superior and substandard instructional categories stand at 85% and 80% respectively. In addition, by comparing with the expert evaluation results, the identification value of RBFNN model is close to the expert evaluation score, which verifies its effectiveness and reliability. The TQE model based on RBFNN constructed in this paper not only provides TQE with more scientific and objective methods and tools, but also provides new ideas for future research in related fields.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Digital Power Grid Monitoring and Intelligent Analysis System Based on Internet of Things Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a digital power grid monitoring and intelligent analysis system based on the Internet of Things (IoT) platform, aiming at improving the security and operation efficiency of the power grid by monitoring the power grid status in real time and intelligently analyzing the data. The system design follows the typical architecture of IoT, including perception layer, network layer, platform layer and application layer. The sensing layer is responsible for collecting power grid state data, the network layer is responsible for data transmission, the platform layer is responsible for data storage, processing and analysis, and the application layer provides services to users. The system realizes accurate collection, efficient transmission and intelligent processing of power grid data, which provides strong support for the sustainable development of power industry.

articleTitle: Intelligent Radio Spectrum Management and Dynamic Spectrum Allocation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the surge in wireless communication services, spectrum resources have grown scarce, posing a significant hindrance to the industry’s expansion. Traditional static spectrum allocation falls short in addressing the escalating demands from communication terminals, particularly under conditions of fluctuating network loads and intricate communication environments. Consequently, exploring intelligent radio spectrum management and dynamic allocation algorithms carries substantial practical importance and application potential. This paper introduces an intelligent radio spectrum management and dynamic allocation approach leveraging deep learning (DL). This approach utilizes a DL model to perceive and forecast the wireless environment in real-time, enabling dynamic adjustments to spectrum resource allocation based on real-time factors like network load and communication quality. By analyzing vast historical data, the DL model identifies patterns and trends in spectrum usage, thereby facilitating precise decision-making for allocation. Experimental results indicate that, in contrast to conventional static methods, this algorithm exhibits greater flexibility and adaptability, effectively navigating complex, evolving wireless landscapes and diverse communication requirements.

articleTitle: Smart Urban and Rural Planning Decision Support System Based on GIS and Geographic Information Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The operation mode of BD (big data) is closely related to everything in people’s daily life. Smart city has clearly become the target form of China’s new urbanization development, and BD plays a vital role in the development of smart city. Based on BD and cloud computing in smart cities, fast and low-cost data acquisition, processing, analysis and value extraction are possible. This paper combines GIS (Geographic Information System) technology with geographic information BD, and puts forward the general idea of smart urban and rural planning DSS (decision support system) based on GIS and geographic information BD. The system is an integrated DSS system with component GIS software and geographic information BD as the core, which ensures the method integration and information integration of smart urban and rural planning DSS. In the system security test, login authentication and interface data acquisition are tested, and both of them pass the test cases. In the interface test, the test results are all within the time range acceptable to users, and the expected results are achieved.

articleTitle: The Practice and Application of Edge Deployment Technology in Power Scene Action Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This article aims to discuss the application and practice of edge deployment technology in power scene action recognition system. In order to realize the intelligent upgrade of EPS and improve the real-time and accuracy of motion recognition, this article constructs a power scene motion recognition system based on edge deployment technology, and carries out system simulation experiments. Research methods include system requirements analysis, overall architecture design, deployment strategy formulation of edge computing nodes, selection and optimization of motion recognition algorithm, and design of data transmission and storage scheme. The experimental results show that the system has obvious advantages in real-time, accuracy and stability, and can meet the actual needs of electric power system (EPS) better than the previous centralized deployment scheme. It is concluded that edge deployment technology has great application potential in power scene action recognition, which is expected to provide strong support for the security and intelligent upgrade of EPS.

articleTitle: Real-time monitoring and quality evaluation of medium and high temperature Daqu fermentation process by computer vision technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Daqu, as a traditional solid-state fermentation product, plays an important role in brewing, seasoning and other industries, and its fermentation process has an important impact on the flavor, quality, production efficiency and cost control of the product. Traditional monitoring methods rely on manual observation and laboratory detection, which are time-consuming and labor-consuming, and it is difficult to realize real-time monitoring and accurate evaluation. In this study, an image acquisition system for the fermentation process of medium and high temperature Daqu was designed and implemented. The industrial camera was used, combined with wide dynamic range technology and high temperature resistance to ensure high quality and real-time image acquisition. Then, through image preprocessing technology, including denoising, enhancement and normalization, the image quality is improved, which is convenient for subsequent feature extraction and recognition. In the aspect of feature extraction and selection, this study combined the characteristics of Daqu fermentation process, extracted key features such as color and texture, and used HSV color space and gray level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) to quantify the features. Based on these characteristics, this study constructs a fermentation state identification and quality evaluation model that integrates deep learning technology and traditional machine learning algorithm. The model can automatically extract useful features from image data and make accurate classification and prediction. The experimental results show that the model designed in this study has achieved high accuracy and recall in real-time monitoring and quality evaluation of medium-high temperature Daqu fermentation process. The experimental results show that the model performs best in the middle stage of fermentation, but it also shows good performance in the early and late stage of fermentation. The successful application of this model not only brought technological innovation to Daqu production industry, but also laid a solid foundation for the wider application of computer vision technology in traditional solid-state fermentation industry.

articleTitle: Edge Detection and Feature Extraction Techniques in Image Processing of Dangerous Rock Bodies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In this article, edge detection and feature extraction technology in image processing of dangerous rock mass are studied. The purpose of this study is to propose an effective method to accurately extract the edges and features in the image of dangerous rock mass, and then provide technical support for monitoring and early warning of rock mass state. Therefore, this article adopts a method based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and realizes the edge detection and feature extraction of dangerous rock image by designing an appropriate CNN model structure. The results show that the proposed method has significantly improved the recognition accuracy and computational efficiency compared with the traditional methods. The algorithm can automatically learn and extract the high-level features in the image of dangerous rock mass without complicated artificial feature engineering, and can meet the requirements of real-time monitoring in practical application. The edge detection and feature extraction technology of dangerous rock image based on CNN provides new ideas and means for dangerous rock monitoring, which is expected to play a greater role in practical application and provide strong support for ensuring people’s lives and property safety.

Author Keywords: Image processing of dangerous rock mass

articleTitle: Application and Optimization Algorithms of Multi-Party Secure Computing in Information Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid growth of information technology (IT), the amount of data generated by various industries in modern society is exploding. However, while enjoying the convenience brought by data, how to ensure the privacy and security of data while maximizing its value has become a major challenge facing us. In this context, multi-party secure computing (SMPC) technology has emerged, providing strong technical support for data privacy protection. SMPC is a privacy computing technology based on cryptography, which can perform joint computation on multi-party data without leaking the original data, thereby ensuring the security and privacy of data. In order to further improve the efficiency and practicality of SMPC, this paper proposes an optimization algorithm and combines it with cloud computing. By adopting a distributed computing architecture, we can decompose and allocate computing tasks to multiple computing nodes, significantly improving computing efficiency. The experimental results show that our proposed SMPC optimization algorithm, when combined with cloud computing, not only significantly improves computational efficiency, but also demonstrates excellent performance in data privacy protection.

articleTitle: Design of Dynamic Interactive Simulation System for Ship Damage Management and Command Training
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the decision-making command and emergency response ability of ship damage control commanders is difficult to generate and slow to improve, a dynamic interactive damage control command training system is designed based on the facilities of port and shore damage control, and the technologies virtual and real combination and computer simulation are adopted, which has training functions such as damage perception, damage control plotting, information transmission and decision application. By clarifying the command and disposal process, the system effectively improves the efficiency of damage control command, has strong pertinence and expansibility, and provides an effective training means and a reliable training platform for improving the decision-making ability and level of damage control commanders.

articleTitle: Athletic Prediction and Momentum Study Based on LightGBM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate whether there are reliable metrics that can predict changes in state in competitive play. We constructed a score prediction model to assess performance. Firstly, principal component analysis (PCA) was used to distinguish between the score factor, process factor and skill factor; secondly, the LightGBM model was optimised using Bayesian optimisation to predict the score at a specific time, with a prediction accuracy of $82 \%$; then, using the predicted score results and the rest of the characteristics, a score factor evaluation system was established, and the indicators of the process and skill factors were weights, and established the evaluation system of process and technical factors respectively; the factor weights were obtained by AHP-TOPSIS method, and the performance scores were assessed by weighting the three factors. Finally, based on the score prediction model, we visualised and analysed the scores. These images demonstrate the correlation between the score and the performance score, and confirm that momentum significantly affects the change of the score.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Target Detection and Recognition Technology Based on Deep Learning in Industrial Automation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of industrial automation technology, target detection and recognition technology is playing an increasingly important role in modern manufacturing industry. This paper deeply discusses the application of target detection and recognition technology based on deep learning in industrial automation. Aiming at the task of target detection and recognition in industrial automation, this paper designs an innovative deep learning model-"industrial automation object detection network” (IAODN). The model is based on convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture, combined with feature pyramid network (FPN) and multi-scale feature fusion strategy to adapt to the changeable target size in industrial automation scenes. The model uses the pre-trained ResNet-50 as the backbone network and combines with FPN to construct a multi-scale feature map, and further improves the detection performance of the model for multi-scale targets through a multi-scale feature fusion module. The experimental results show that the IAODN model has excellent performance on public data sets (COCO and PASCAL VOC) and practical application data, especially in identifying small targets and multi-scale targets. By introducing deep learning technology, the production efficiency and safety in industrial automation scenarios have been significantly improved. In specific application scenarios such as production line monitoring, the IAODN model can monitor the status of parts on the production line in real time, find and identify defective parts in time, thus improving product quality and reducing the cost of manual inspection.

articleTitle: Research on Submarine Localization Based on K-means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the development of submarines and the increasing concern about the safety of this program, this study constructs a localization model and a search model for search and rescue after an accident. In addition, we provide a series of equipment recommendations and fundamentals to minimize the risk of accidents. We deeply analyze the influencing factors and obtain the key factors (ocean currents, seawater density, and seafloor topography), and then we process the obtained data related to the key factors, such as clustering, rasterization, and visualization. Using the processed data, we propose a three-dimensional physical model to analyze the impact on the submersible. Based on this physical model, we constructed a multilayer cross-location model (MLCL) to predict the positional trajectory of the submersible over time. To verify the accuracy of the model predictions, we propose a probability distribution model to comparatively validate the MLCL model. The final results show that the accuracy of the MLCL model is above 91%.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Efficient Detection Algorithm for Harmful Substances in Food
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With food safety becoming the focus of global attention, rapid and accurate detection of harmful substances in food has become the key to protect public health. In this study, the efficient detection algorithm of harmful substances in food is deeply studied, aiming at developing a hybrid model combining advanced machine learning technology and big data analysis to realize rapid and accurate identification of harmful substances in food. By constructing a hybrid model (CNN-LSTM) based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Long Short Term Memory Network (LSTM), this study fully utilizes the complementary information in food image and spectral data to improve detection accuracy and efficiency. The experimental results show that the proposed CNN-LSTM hybrid model shows excellent performance in the detection of harmful substances in food, with high accuracy and strong generalization ability, and can be applied to various types of food samples and harmful substances. This study not only provides an efficient and convenient detection method for food safety supervision, but also provides a new idea and method for the research of harmful substances detection algorithm in food.

articleTitle: Durability Simulation and Life Prediction Algorithm for Anti-corrosion Coatings
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of durability and life prediction of anticorrosive coatings in practical application, this article aims to propose a new method of durability simulation and life prediction by combining simulation technology with deep learning algorithm. In terms of methods, this article first constructs a durability simulation model of anti-corrosion coating based on the influence of many factors, and carries out accelerated aging experiments on the coating performance by simulating the actual use environment. Secondly, the deep learning algorithm is used to process and analyze a large number of data obtained from simulation experiments, and the mapping relationship between coating performance and service life is established, thus realizing the accurate prediction of service life. The results show that the method proposed in this article can evaluate the durability of anti-corrosion coatings and accurately predict their service life. Compared with other methods, this method has obvious advantages in prediction accuracy and generalization ability. In addition, through the comparative analysis of different coating samples, the practicability and reliability of this method are further verified. This method has broad prospects and social value in practical application.

articleTitle: Network Security Threat Prevention and Control System for Wind Farm Power Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Nowadays, with the development of network technology, the security of wind farm power monitoring systems is facing serious threats. This article presents the design of a wind farm power monitoring system, which utilizes IDS (Intrusion Detection System) to monitor network traffic in real-time, monitor abnormal behaviors in the network, and provide early warning for possible attack behaviors, as well as intercept and alert them. Multiple layers of protective devices can be deployed, such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems, intrusion defense systems, etc. This system refers to the monitoring of the stability of various systems and equipment in the production control area and information management area of wind farms, ensuring the normal operation of various links such as power generation, transformation, and transmission, and providing stable electrical energy for the power grid. This article helps guide grid connected power plants to carry out network security operation improvement work.

articleTitle: Application of Network Anomaly Detection Algorithm Based on Deep Learning in Information Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With more and more electronic devices connected to the Internet, the scale of the network continues to expand. How to ensure the security and stability of the network becomes critical.
