Network anomaly detection technology, as an important part of network security, is playing an increasingly important role. Network anomaly detection technology, by establishing benchmarks for normal network behavior, can accurately identify abnormal behaviors that deviate from these benchmarks, thereby detecting new types of network attacks and potential security threats. This technology has strong universality and can be applied not only to intrusion detection, but also to various fields such as botnet detection and malicious traffic identification. In this article, we propose a network anomaly detection algorithm based on deep learning (DL). DL, as a powerful machine learning (ML) method, can automatically extract complex feature patterns from massive network data, providing strong support for network anomaly detection. The experimental results show that the algorithm has significant application effects in the field of information and communication. It not only has high detection accuracy, but also can quickly respond to various network abnormal events, providing a solid guarantee for network security.

articleTitle: High Reliability Implementation of 5G Slicing Technology in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Communication System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This article is devoted to exploring the application of 5 G slicing technology in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) communication system. In view of the limitations of the existing technology, this article proposes an innovative and highly reliable algorithm design. This method mainly focuses on the optimal allocation of slicing resources and the formulation of fault recovery and redundancy strategy, aiming at meeting the needs of UAV communication system, maximizing the utilization of slicing resources and minimizing the delay, and ensuring the stable operation of UAV communication system when slicing fails. In order to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, a series of simulation experiments were carried out in the study, and the running efficiency, convergence and precision of the algorithm were comprehensively evaluated. The experimental results show that the algorithm in this article has high running efficiency, fast convergence speed, high precision and stability when dealing with a large number of UAV communication tasks. To sum up, the high reliability algorithm designed in this article provides strong support for the application of 5G slicing technology in UAV communication system, and is expected to promote the development of UAV communication technology.

articleTitle: Risk Prediction Model of Human Resource Management Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This paper aims to build a Human Resource Management (HRM) risk prediction model based on random forest algorithm to help enterprises identify and manage human resource risks more effectively. By collecting historical data related to human resource risks, preprocessing and feature extraction, a risk prediction model is trained by using random forest algorithm. The experimental results indicate that the model exhibits high prediction accuracy, approximately 0.96, and demonstrates exceptional predictive capability across various risk types, successfully identifying potential human resources risks. Comparative experiments with other prevalent machine learning algorithms further underscore the advantages of random forest in risk prediction. This study offers enterprises a practical risk management tool and introduces a novel perspective and methodology for applying data mining in HRM.

articleTitle: Optimization of Library Book Classification and Retrieval System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid growth of digital technology for book resources, the number of books in libraries has grown rapidly. Traditional book classification and retrieval methods are no longer able to efficiently meet the query needs of massive book data. The automatic classification of books is not only a fundamental task in book management and book recommendation algorithms, but also a key link in improving the efficiency of library services. Faced with this challenge, this article proposes a library book classification and retrieval system based on deep learning (DL). This system uses DL algorithm to deeply analyze and process book text data, automatically extract text features of books, construct efficient classification models, and achieve accurate classification of books. At the same time, the system also combines natural language processing (NLP) technology and user behavior analysis to provide personalized book recommendation services for users, accurately understanding their query intentions, and quickly retrieving book resources that meet their needs, greatly improving the accuracy and efficiency of retrieval. The experimental results show that compared with traditional book classification and retrieval methods, the system exhibits significant advantages in accuracy, efficiency, and user experience.

articleTitle: Visual and Language Information Fusion Algorithm in Multimodal Discourse Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology (IT), the Internet is full of multimodal data, including text, images, audio and video, which enriches information expression and challenges information processing technology. Multimodal discourse analysis, as an emerging field in this context, transcends a single text analysis dimension and delves into complex systems involving multiple sensory interactions such as vision and hearing. For machine translation (MT), traditional text-based methods are inadequate when faced with content containing rich visual elements. For this reason, multimodal MT has emerged, integrating visual and linguistic information, improving translation quality, and being close to the original context and emotions. This article innovatively proposes a visual and language information fusion algorithm in multimodal discourse analysis, which deeply integrates deep learning (DL) technology and can automatically capture key information in images as auxiliary clues in the translation process to optimize language generation models. The experimental results show that the algorithm integrates deep visual meanings while retaining the essence of language, significantly improving the naturalness and accuracy of translation, bringing new breakthroughs to the MT field.

articleTitle: Algorithm Design and Application of Intelligent Metering Device in Solving the Problem of Changing Households
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the improvement of the intelligent level of power system, the problem of changing households has become a key factor affecting the stability and economic operation of power grid. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes an intelligent metering algorithm based on neural network, which can effectively identify and deal with abnormal electricity consumption behavior by monitoring and accurately metering user electricity consumption data in real time. Firstly, this paper introduces the basic principle and technology of intelligent metering device, including data acquisition, transmission, processing and storage, and data display and control. The application of these technologies enables intelligent metering devices to monitor users’ electricity consumption data in real time, and quickly discover abnormal changes in electricity consumption behavior through advanced data analysis technology. In the part of algorithm design and implementation, this paper expounds the steps of data preprocessing, feature extraction, model construction, training and optimization in detail. Data preprocessing includes data cleaning, feature extraction and standardization to ensure data quality and consistency. Multi-layer feed-forward neural network (MFNN) is used to build the model, ReLU is used as the activation function, and the model is trained by the mean square error (MSE) loss function and Adam optimization algorithm, so as to realize the prediction and identification of abnormal electricity consumption behavior. The experimental results show that the intelligent metering algorithm based on neural network has achieved remarkable results in solving the problem of changing households. The accuracy of the model is $\mathbf{9 5. 8 \%}$ in the test set, with the average absolute error (MAE) of 5.3 kWh and the root mean square error (RMSE) of 7.1 kWh, which shows good prediction ability and stability. By real-time monitoring and predicting abnormal electricity consumption behavior, intelligent metering device provides a strong guarantee for the stable operation of power system. This research result provides a new idea and method for solving the problem of changing households in current power system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Emotional Tendencies In American Literature Quotes Based on Python
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Since the emergence of literature as an art form, people who love art have had literature to learn and understand. Now in the Internet era, people can quickly find their favorite literary and artistic works through the Internet, and the description language of these works of art also has the author's own emotional tendency. In order to assist people in understanding the emotional tendencies of famous quotes in their favorite literary works, this article proposes a Python based method for analyzing the emotional tendencies of American literary quotes. Firstly, some original English quotes from American literary classics are obtained from the internet (this article obtained the world classic “The Old Man and the Sea” by American author Ernest Hemingway); Then, Python language was used to analyze and visualize these 30 literary classic sentences using its powerful natural language processing ecosystem; Finally, the probability judgment of positive, neutral, and negative sentences in 30 literary classics was achieved, and the final judgment result was obtained. Through the above tests, it was found that the processing method proposed in this article is easy to operate and has a good effect on the analysis of emotional tendencies in literary quotes.

articleTitle: EMD-LSTM Based Demand Forecasting Research on Power Engineering Banded Framework Procurement Materials
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: More and more electric power enterprises apply the framework agreement procurement mode for procurement, and accurate power material demand forecasting is a key link to guarantee the material response speed and stable execution of the framework. The power material demand sequence usually contains both linear time series and nonlinear time series components, and the traditional time series analysis methods are not reasonable for non-smooth and nonlinear data. Based on this, the method of forecasting using LSTM network model on the basis of EMD algorithm decomposition of material demand dataset is proposed. The sequences are decomposed by EMD according to a certain law to extract different frequency features in the complex sequences; secondly, the LSTM model is used for the different frequency features to obtain the time-series information and make predictions. Finally, through the experimental analysis, it is proved that the established model has strong feature extraction ability and can predict the material demand better.

articleTitle: Simulation of Camera Visual Range Based on Three-dimensional Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This study proposes a camera visibility range simulation method based on 3D models, aimed at improving the accuracy of traditional 2D plane estimation methods to more realistically reflect the camera’s visibility range in three-dimensional space. The study employs various technical means to acquire 3D data and construct high-quality 3D models, including the use of professional 3D modeling software and laser scanning technology. At the same time, by setting and adjusting key parameters such as the camera’s focal length (FL), field of view (FOV), and installation position, the accuracy and authenticity of the simulation results are ensured. In the simulation calculation of visual range, an innovative method combining ray tracing and visual field analysis is adopted in this study, which realizes the accurate simulation and optimization of camera visual range. The ray tracing technology is used to simulate the propagation path of light in 3D model, and the dynamic visual field adjustment algorithm is introduced, which can automatically adjust the visual field of the camera according to the monitoring requirements, and improve the flexibility and efficiency of the monitoring system. In order to verify the effectiveness of this research method, 3D models of different scenes such as shopping malls, parks, office buildings and residential areas are selected for experiments. The experimental results show that this research method can achieve high accuracy and adaptability in different scenarios, and can achieve the best coverage of monitoring targets. Compared with the traditional manual calculation or simple software simulation, this research method has higher accuracy and stronger adaptability, which significantly improves the performance of the monitoring system. This research not only brings new breakthroughs and progress in the field of camera visual range simulation, but also provides support for the technical development in the fields of virtual reality and augmented reality.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Transportation Multi-target Recognition and Tracking Algorithm Combining YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The importance of intelligent transportation system in improving traffic efficiency and safety is increasingly prominent. In order to realize real-time and accurate identification and tracking of multi-targets in traffic scenes, this paper proposes an innovative algorithm fusion strategy, which combines the YOLOv8 target detection algorithm with the DeepSORT multi-target tracking algorithm. YOLOv8 can effectively identify traffic participants such as vehicles and pedestrians with its efficient and accurate target detection ability. DeepSORT, on the other hand, shows stable tracking performance in complex environment by combining deep learning features with traditional tracking algorithms. In order to further improve the robustness of tracking, this paper introduces a dynamic feature update strategy to update the feature representation in real time according to the appearance change of the target. At the same time, the tracking decision is optimized by using the confidence score output by YOLOv8, and the target with high confidence is given priority and the tracking is suspended when it is low. The experimental results show that the fusion algorithm performs well on traffic surveillance video data sets, which is significantly better than using YOLOv8 or DeepSORT alone, and shows higher accuracy, recall and F1 score compared with other advanced algorithms. This study provides strong technical support for intelligent transportation system and lays a foundation for realizing more efficient and safe traffic management.

articleTitle: Regional Weather Sensitivity Analysis and Power Outage Risk Assessment Algorithm Combining GIS and AI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Based on GIS (Geographic Information System) and AI (Artificial Intelligence), a regional meteorological sensitivity analysis method is studied. But in the existing research methods, the data acquisition is difficult, the consideration of spatial correlation is not enough, the model complexity is not enough, the prediction accuracy is not high. Aiming at the above problems, this article can adopt GIS technology to collect and process multi-source, multi-scale and multi-space-time meteorological and geographic information. On this basis, the sensitivity of meteorological elements is analyzed in real time, and the fault risk of power system is evaluated to provide accurate early warning and decision support. The purpose of this project is to enhance the recognition of regional weather sensitivity and power grid loss risk, and to provide scientific basis and technical support for relevant departments and policymakers. Experimental results show that the method is effective, and the sensitivity of artificial neural network based on artificial neural network to regional meteorological sensitivity can reach 0.87. This project can make up for the shortcomings of existing research methods and improve the accuracy and practicability of regional meteorological sensitivity analysis and failure risk assessment.

articleTitle: Underwriting Decision Analysis Based on Autoregressive Moving Average Models and Random Forest Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This paper presents an analysis of underwriting decisions based on autoregressive moving average models and random forest algorithms. To begin, we quantified the influencing factors using Poisson and log-normal distributions and established a risk prediction model using multi-objective linear programming for evaluation, ultimately reaching a decision. A comparison between the model’s decision results and those of the Japan North-West Mutual Aid Bank from 2010 to 2016 showed a consistency of 78.64%.Subsequently, we constructed an autoregressive moving average model for prediction. Comparing the model’s predictions with those of a three-year insurance plan in Chile in 2010, the model achieved an accuracy of 81.32%. Finally, to investigate whether customers would influence the insurance company’s decisions, we quantified customer-related factors and utilized a random forest algorithm to establish an evaluation model, determining the impact of customers on the insurance company’s decisions.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction and Reconnaissance Algorithm of Radar Signal Based on Support Vector Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Machine learning (ML) can automatically extract features from a large number of data, and accurately predict and classify unknown data by training models. This article focuses on the research of radar signal feature extraction and reconnaissance algorithm based on ML, and pays special attention to the application of fuzzy support vector machine (FSVM) in radar signal reconnaissance. By using FSVM algorithm, it aims to solve the limitations of traditional radar signal reconnaissance methods in the face of complex and changeable signals. This article introduces the principle of FSVM algorithm, and combines the characteristics of radar signal to construct an efficient feature extraction and reconnaissance algorithm. The experimental part focuses on the influence of kernel parameter selection on model performance, and verifies the effectiveness of over-fitting measures in improving accuracy. The research results show that compared with the traditional radar signal reconnaissance algorithm, the algorithm based on FSVM proposed in this article has achieved significant improvement in accuracy and response time, which proves the superiority of this method in radar signal feature extraction and reconnaissance tasks.

articleTitle: Networking and Information Security Algorithms of Industrial Automation Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Computer technology and network technology have deeply penetrated into various fields such as life, production, and learning, becoming indispensable technological cornerstones in the 21st century. Industrial automation control systems have rapidly advanced and gained widespread adoption, thanks to robust information exchange and computer technology. Yet, as the informatization level of these systems rises, security risks in industrial control networks have become increasingly prominent, jeopardizing system stability and data security. To tackle these challenges, this paper introduces a deep learning (DL) -based information security algorithm tailored for industrial control networks. This algorithm monitors and analyzes network traffic in real-time, leveraging DL models to thoroughly analyze extensive network data and precisely detect potential attack behaviors. Experimental results demonstrate the algorithm's high accuracy, real-time capabilities, and effectiveness in identifying various network attacks. In comparison to traditional security measures, our algorithm excels in detection rate and false alarm rate, offering a novel approach to safeguarding industrial control networks.

articleTitle: Real-Time Data Processing Strategy Based On Edge Computing In 5G Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the characteristics of high speed, large capacity, low delay and high reliability, 5G network provides unprecedented possibilities for data transmission and processing. At the same time, as a new computing mode, Edge Computing (EC) significantly reduces the data transmission delay and improves the processing efficiency by pushing the computing task to the edge of the network. This paper proposes a real-time data processing architecture based on 5G network and EC, which realizes real-time data acquisition, transmission, processing, storage and feedback through data acquisition layer, data transmission layer, EC layer, data center and application and service layer. This architecture not only reduces the data transmission delay, improves the processing efficiency, but also enhances the data security. In particular, this paper adopts dynamic resource allocation and data hierarchical processing strategy in data processing flow to optimize processing efficiency and energy consumption ratio. The experimental results show that the architecture proposed in this study has significant advantages in reducing delay and improving efficiency when dealing with large amounts of data. Compared with the traditional data processing methods, this research framework performs well in processing speed, especially when dealing with a large number of data, which can meet the needs of real-time data processing more effectively. In addition, by adopting advanced security mechanism, this research architecture shows good data security in simulated attack scenarios. This study not only provides valuable reference for the technical development in the field of real-time data processing, but also provides technical support for intelligent manufacturing, intelligent transportation, telemedicine and other fields.

articleTitle: Dynamic Response Characteristics and Control Strategies of Mechanical Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Compared to the mature research and application of static optimization technology, dynamic response optimization has always been a research hotspot and difficulty in the field of system optimization design due to its complex dynamic constraints and variable environmental factors. As an indispensable key component in modern engineering, mechanical systems (MS) have dynamic behavior characteristics that are directly related to the overall performance stability, response speed, and working accuracy of the system. This is particularly prominent in complex and ever-changing working environments. This article focuses on the dynamic response characteristics and control strategies of MS. Through a combination of theoretical analysis and experimental verification, the dynamic response laws of MS under different working conditions are systematically studied, and corresponding optimization control strategies are proposed. The experimental results show that the control strategy proposed in this article can effectively address the dynamic challenges of MS in complex working environments, significantly reduce vibration levels, improve system response speed, and enhance the overall stability and reliability of the system. This provides strong theoretical support and practical methods for optimization design and control practice in related fields.

articleTitle: Research on English Text Keyword Generation Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the advent of the “global village” era, the changes in domestic and foreign affairs have become increasingly frequent. As a result, there will be many English texts such as news newspapers, journals, magazines, dialogues, comments, etc. expressed in English. Among them, some English texts are even lengthy and difficult to understand quickly. In order to provide people with a quick way to grasp key information in English texts, this paper proposes a machine learning based research method for generating English text keywords. The first stage is to collect some English text data for analysis. This study randomly obtained some movie review text data online as the research text; The second stage is to learn and generate keyword information based on the principles of TDF-IDF and TEXTRANK machine learning algorithms (set to 5 in this article’s test), while separating the corresponding keywords, weight coefficients, and part of speech information and presenting them in a centralized comparative drawing. According to the research and testing in this article, it can be concluded that through the calculation of TDF-IDF and TEXTRANK algorithm models, any text can quickly extract the desired keyword information and has universality.

articleTitle: Research on Clothing Image Recognition and Classification Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of e-commerce and fashion industry, an efficient clothing image recognition system is very important for commodity recommendation and inventory management. Traditional image recognition methods have limitations in accuracy and efficiency when dealing with complex and changeable clothing images. In this paper, a clothing image recognition and classification algorithm based on deep learning is proposed. In this paper, the ability of Deep Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to learn image feature expression automatically is used, and the accuracy and efficiency of clothing image recognition are improved by designing optimized CNN model structure and training strategy. The model effectively improves the performance of clothing image classification through multi-scale feature extraction, spatial attention mechanism and appropriate data preprocessing and enhancement technology. Experiments show that this model has achieved high accuracy in clothing image classification tasks, and shows superior performance in comparison with other common image classification algorithms. This study not only promotes the application and development of deep learning in the field of clothing image recognition, but also provides practical technical support for related industries.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Mapping Mechanism of Energy Internet Information Model Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In recent years, as energy technology innovation has entered a highly active period, the energy Internet, which is characterized by complementary energy flows and deep integration of physical information, is gradually becoming a key force to promote the transformation of the energy industry to clean, low-carbon and efficient. However, in the process of building and operating the energy Internet, a significant challenge lies in the heterogeneity of its internal information models, that is, the information models are diverse, complex in structure and different in standards, which greatly hinders the seamless sharing and efficient use of data. To solve the above problems, this paper deeply studies the heterogeneous mapping mechanism of energy Internet information model based on big data technology. This mechanism aims to achieve effective mapping and deep fusion between heterogeneous information models by integrating advanced methods of big data storage, processing, and analysis, combined with theoretical tools such as ontology and semantic similarity calculation. The experimental results show that this mechanism not only significantly improves the sharing efficiency and interaction quality of data within the energy Internet, but also effectively promotes the optimization of energy scheduling strategies and the improvement of energy utilization efficiency.

articleTitle: Algorithmic Research on Cross-Border E-commerce Logistics Forecasting Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of globalization and e-commerce, cross-border e-commerce logistics has become a critical link connecting global markets. Effective logistics management is crucial for ensuring smooth supply chain operations and enhancing customer satisfaction. This research aims to develop an advanced algorithm-based cross-border e-commerce logistics forecasting model to improve logistics efficiency, reduce operational costs, and optimize resource allocation. The study employs various statistical and machine learning algorithms, combined with historical data and real-time market dynamics, to construct a comprehensive forecasting model. The model covers aspects such as predicting goods flow, estimating transportation times, and conducting cost analysis. Through comparative analysis, this research demonstrates the advantages of the proposed model in terms of accuracy and efficiency. The results indicate that the model significantly enhances the accuracy of cross-border e-commerce logistics forecasting, aiding businesses in better planning logistics resources and inventory management. Furthermore, the model provides crucial market insights for decision-makers, helping them navigate the complex and ever-changing international trade environment. This study is of great significance for understanding and optimizing cross-border e-commerce logistics operations, providing an effective decision-making tool for e-commerce companies and logistics service providers, and is expected to have a positive impact in practical applications.

articleTitle: Simulation of Environmental Damage Assessment Model in Mining Area Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The application of Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DCNN) in the field of environmental damage assessment in mining areas is increasingly attracting attention. This study aims to explore and develop a mining area environmental damage assessment model based on DCNN algorithm, and conduct simulation research. Through the comprehensive utilization of satellite images, geological data and meteorological data, we established a multi-source data-driven Mask R-CNN model to capture the details and trends of environmental changes in mining areas. The research results show that, compared with other Transformer networks, the vegetation identification accuracy of this method is the highest. IoU and F1 reached 94.976% and 96.273% respectively. Compared with traditional methods, the evaluation model based on DCNN realizes a higher degree of automation, thus improving the evaluation efficiency. The research results show that this model shows excellent performance in accuracy and accuracy, and can effectively evaluate the degree of environmental damage in mining areas. The simulation of environmental damage assessment model in mining area based on DCNN provides a new and powerful tool for environmental protection and is expected to play an important role in future mining activities.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Learning Based Inventory Optimization and Intelligent Demand Prediction in E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the booming development of e-commerce, enterprises are facing increasingly changing market environments, which have put forward higher requirements for inventory management and demand forecasting. Traditional methods have gradually shown limitations in dealing with these complex situations, thus requiring the introduction of more advanced technologies. This study is based on multi-layer feedforward neural networks in deep learning, aiming to improve inventory management efficiency, optimize inventory levels, and achieve intelligent demand prediction. Through experiments, it has been proven that the proposed method can effectively address inventory management and demand forecasting issues in the e-commerce environment, providing new ideas for improving enterprise operational efficiency and reducing costs.

articleTitle: Power System Reliability Analysis for Demand Response in Electricity Market Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the deepening of China’s power market reform and the rapid growth of the national economy, the shortage of power resources needs to be solved urgently, and the requirements for the reliability of the power system are getting higher and higher. Demand response can encourage users to change their electricity consumption behaviour through price or incentives, and cooperate with the power supply side to cut peaks and fill valleys, and its role in the electricity market is gradually highlighting. The rational design and effective implementation of demand response programmes bring more benefits to the user side and the power generation side, and are of great significance in improving the safe and reliable operation of the power grid. Therefore, this paper provides an in-depth study of demand response programmes and their impact on system reliability in the context of the electricity market.

articleTitle: Construction of Intelligent Grid Automation Dispatching System Based on SVG Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The power grid dispatch system is faced with challenges when dealing with the integration of a large-scale grid and distributed power generation resources. In this paper, we propose a construction method for an intelligent grid automation scheduling system based on SVG technology, and conduct an in-depth analysis of SVG technology. The application value of SVG technology in power grid automation scheduling is pointed out, and an automation scheduling framework that integrates SVG technology is designed. By introducing advanced control algorithms and data analysis techniques, both monitoring and optimized scheduling of the power grid operation status are achieved. Research shows that the intelligent grid automation scheduling system based on SVG technology can improve voltage stability and power quality, reduce harmonic effects, and improve the overall transmission capacity of the power grid. The maximum compensation efficiency of the system under SVG technology can reach 93%, the voltage recovery time is only 217ms, and the maximum harmonic distortion power is only 40W. These results prove the importance and practicality of SVG technology in intelligent grid automation scheduling.

articleTitle: Optimization of Artificial Intelligence Network Resource Allocation by Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of network technology, the problem of network resource allocation is increasingly prominent. The purpose of this study is to explore a more intelligent and efficient network resource allocation strategy by strengthening learning algorithms. In order to achieve this goal, this article first constructs a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) model for network resource allocation, and uses Actor-Critic algorithm to optimize it. In the experiment, a simulated network environment is built, and the validity of the model is verified by preparing relevant data sets. During the experiment, the state, action, reward and other information of the algorithm are recorded in detail, so as to evaluate the performance comprehensively. The results show that DRL algorithm performs well in network resource allocation and significantly improves the overall performance of the network. Compared with traditional methods, DRL algorithm shows its powerful learning and optimization ability. The convergence and stability analysis of the algorithm further confirmed the reliability of DRL in network resource allocation. In this article, the application potential of DRL in network resource allocation is verified by experiments, which provides a new idea for solving the resource allocation problem in dynamic network environment.

articleTitle: Research on a High Self-healing and High Interactive Active Distribution Network Construction Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As economic growth and living standards rise, there is an increased demand for the capacity, quality, and reliability of the distribution grid. However, the lack of intelligent management, outdated structure, and the difficulty of information interaction and data sharing in the traditional distribution grid, pose challenges for efficient complex collaborative work and regional power supply recovery. This study proposes a method to construct a highly interconnected and self-healing smart distribution grid. Following the national IEC61968/61970CIM standards, a primary equipment model is established. Through dynamic power flow analysis and network reconstruction technology, the grid framework is optimized to achieve high reliability and economy in grid operation. By utilizing the Internet of Things and 5G quantum intelligent switch technology and leveraging the full model advantage, we simulate automatic topology analysis in fault zones, generating one-click transfer supply strategies. This method not only addresses the deficiencies of the traditional distribution grid but also enhances intelligent management and operational efficiency of the grid with modern technology, ensuring efficient and reliable power supply.

articleTitle: Power Data Identification of Smart Grid: Application of Multi-source Semantic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As the basis of smart grid operation, power data contains rich system operation status information and user behavior characteristics. Traditional power data identification methods have limitations when dealing with multi-source, heterogeneous, massive and time-sensitive power data. Aiming at the challenge of power data identification in smart grid, this paper explores and proposes a technical scheme based on multi-source semantic analysis, constructs a power data identification model based on multi-source semantic analysis, and comprehensively evaluates its performance through experiments. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional methods, the model proposed in this paper has significantly improved the key indicators such as prediction accuracy, real-time, F1 score and mean absolute error (MAE), with the prediction accuracy increased by about $15 \%$, the prediction time reduced by about $30 \%$, the $F 1$ score increased by about $\mathbf{2 0 \%}$ and the MAE decreased by about $\mathbf{2 5 \%}$. These improvements fully verify the effectiveness of multi-source semantic analysis in power data identification. Finally, this paper summarizes the advantages of the model, and points out the existing problems and the future improvement direction, in order to provide reference for promoting the application of power data identification technology.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electrical Automation Transformation Model Based on Matra Offset Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the common problems of electrical engineering under automation environment are systematically analyzed, and some new solutions are put forward. First of all, this paper reviews the research status of this field both at home and abroad. Secondly, this paper introduces the application of Matra displacement model in the field of power system in detail, and summarizes the views of domestic and foreign experts on the development process and characteristics of this technology research. Then, starting from the theoretical basis and basic concepts, this paper expounds the important role of software in the modeling of computer simulation system and analyzes the impact on the system. Finally, the transformation of electrical automation is realized by MATLAB, and the corresponding results are given. The test results show that the static deviation data range is $0.084-0.096$, while the dynamic deviation data range is 0.089-0.097; communication compatibility is as high as $\mathbf{1 0 0 \%}$ and as low as 96%.

articleTitle: Implementation and Performance Analysis of Communication Encryption API in Distributed Database Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, distributed database systems play an important role in large-scale data processing and storage. However, along with it, there is an increasing concern about data security and privacy. In order to protect the confidentiality and integrity of data, the use of communication encryption in distributed database systems has become a necessary option. The aim of this paper is to explore the design, implementation and performance analysis of communication encryption APIs in distributed database systems. First, the design and implementation of encryption APIs are introduced by outlining various encryption methods and API design principles. Then, the application of encryption APIs in data transmission, storage and real-time communication is analyzed with practical examples. Then, the performance of encryption APIs is comprehensively analyzed through experimental settings and performance evaluation metrics, and performance optimization strategies are proposed. Finally, the main findings of the research are summarized and the directions for future research are discussed. The aim of this paper is to provide theoretical and practical guidance for secure communication in distributed database systems to meet the growing data security challenges.

articleTitle: Adaptive Adjustment Strategy of Train Attendant’s Control Guidance System Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to study the self-adaptive adjustment strategy of railway locomotive crew operation guidance system based on machine learning, so as to improve the efficiency and safety of train operation. In view of the complexity and diversity of flight attendants’ manipulation behavior in the field of railway transportation, the traditional fixed weight model is often difficult to meet the needs of different operation situations. Therefore, this study proposes an adaptive adjustment strategy based on ensemble learning, which can dynamically adjust the model weight according to real-time data and environmental changes, so as to achieve adaptive adaptability to different operating conditions. In this paper, a series of experiments are designed to verify the effectiveness of this strategy and compare it with traditional methods. The experimental results show that the operation guidance system with adaptive adjustment strategy has significantly improved the prediction accuracy and recall rate, which can guide the flight attendants’ operation behavior more accurately and improve the train operation efficiency and safety. In addition, the application value of the system in the actual scene is analyzed through an application case. To sum up, the results of this study show that the adaptive adjustment strategy of railway locomotive crew control guidance system based on machine learning has broad application prospects and important practical significance, which provides new ideas and methods for improving the intelligence and safety of railway transportation system.

articleTitle: Agricultural Automated Greenhouse Environmental Monitoring and Control Model Based on the Internet of Things and Intelligent Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Huizhou is adjacent to Hong Kong, connected with Shenzhen, Dongguan and Guangzhou, with convenient land and water transportation, and its unique geographical position provides favorable conditions for commodity agriculture, Intelligent computing technology is used to analyze and process information, so as to improve the perception of the real environment and realize intelligent decision-making and control, Agricultural Internet of Things is a combination of agricultural applications and Internet of Things technology, In many scenarios, actuators and sensors are relatively far away, As an object, it provides the most suitable growth environment such as temperature, humidity, light, water and fertilizer, so that crops can be in the best growth state, thus obtaining an efficient agriculture with high yield and high quality, However, compared with its application potential, Internet of Things technology still faces some important problems and challenges in agricultural automation, Comprehensive monitoring before and after planting has been achieved to make agricultural production increasingly efficient and high-quality, Agricultural greenhouse wireless sensor networks typically require the deployment of a large number of small sensor nodes, which are powered by small batteries with limited power, Therefore, in the new situation, reasonable adjustment of crop layout is the key to developing agricultural economy and cooperating with the construction of modern Huizhou.

articleTitle: Research on Insurance Decision-Making Model for Extreme Weather Based on ARIMA Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In the context of escalating global climate change, extreme weather events pose significant challenges to the insurance industry, necessitating robust decision-making models for risk assessment and policy underwriting. This study introduces an innovative insurance decision-making model leveraging the Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) time series forecasting method to predict extreme weather occurrences and inform insurance policy decisions. The model’s design incorporates a set of carefully selected meteorological indicators, enabling a nuanced analysis of the probability of extreme weather events in specific regions. By applying ARIMA to historical weather data from Zhengzhou and Basel, we demonstrate the model’s efficacy in estimating the required policy volume to achieve a break-even point, thus providing insurers with a data-driven strategy for risk mitigation. The model’s strengths lie in its adaptability to various climatic conditions, its ability to integrate complex time-dependent data, and its potential to enhance the insurance industry’s resilience against the financial impacts of extreme weather. The study underscores the model’s practical utility in optimizing insurance portfolios and contributing to the sustainable development of the insurance sector in the face of climate-related risks.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanical Equipment Fault Diagnosis and Prediction Technology Based on Vibration Signal Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This research delves into the field of fault detection and prognosis for mechanical systems, leveraging vibrational data analysis to enhance precision and efficiency in diagnosing issues within industrial machinery. By integrating sophisticated signal processing techniques like Wavelet Transform (WT) and Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD), we conduct an in-depth examination of vibrational data from mechanical equipment to discern pertinent fault-related characteristics. Leveraging these identified traits, the research employs machine learning methodologies, including Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Long Short Term Memory Network (LSTM), to develop models tailored for fault detection and forecasting. Experimental outcomes reveal that our devised model registers notable achievements in diagnosing and predicting defects in rolling bearings, boasting a diagnostic precision surpassing 97.0%. Remarkably, it can anticipate anomalous vibration patterns hours prior to fault onset, affording maintenance teams a crucial window for preventative measures. Beyond its scholarly merit, this investigation holds paramount practical relevance, offering insights to guide industrial operations and promising to bolster the secure and optimal performance of mechanical systems with innovative technological support.

articleTitle: Research and Applications of Autonomous Driving Technology Based on Mechanical and Electrical Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of technology, autonomous driving technology has gradually become a research hotspot in the automotive industry. This article proposes a new design scheme for an intelligent vehicle autonomous driving control system. The scheme involves modifying the steering, throttle, and braking systems of manned vehicles with appropriate mechanical structures, installing relevant automatic control devices, and establishing distributed connections between each system and the upper intelligent control computer through CAN. This article focuses on the autonomous needs of intelligent driving wire control system technology and completes the selection of various actuators for the chassis wire control system. Test experiments and vehicle integration tests have shown that this design scheme can achieve the goal of precise control of the underlying subsystems by the upper control computer. The system has high reliability, and the tracking error of the parking trajectory is within the allowable range. The parking path designed based on curves is effective. This article lays the foundation for further research on unmanned and intelligent control of vehicles based on electromechanical technology.

articleTitle: Design and simulation optimization of a new impedance composite muffler
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Mufflers are widely used to control pipeline noise in ventilation engineering. Substation noise belongs to low frequency noise, and the low frequency muffler effect is required to be higher. In this paper, a new structure of composite impedance muffler is proposed, and the sound field and flow field inside the muffler are simulated by COMSOL Multiphysics finite element method. The pressure loss and insertion loss of different structure mufflers are studied and analyzed, and a new impedance compound type of ventilation pipe muffler is designed and optimized, which can provide reference for substation muffler design and engineering application. The results show that the new impedance composite muffler has good muffling effect in low, medium and high frequencies; the muffling effect is better in $0 \sim 500 \mathrm{~Hz}$, and it is better than other types of mufflers by about 150%.

articleTitle: Research on Factors Related to the Development of New Energy Vehicles Based on ARIMA Time Series Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This paper analyzes factors and influences related to the development of new energy vehicles in China. First, wefound and analyzed factors related to the development of new energy vehicles in China, such as environmental pollution, policy subsidies, gasoline prices, and economic conditions. We conducted K-S tests, utilized Spearman correlation analysis, and employed multiple linear regression models in SPSS. Then, we observed strong seasonality in the monthlysales time series of new energy vehicles. Hence, we chose to use the ARIMA model for analysis to predict the development of new energy electric vehicles in China over the next decade. Subsequently, we collected variables such as new energy electric vehicle penetration rate, international oil prices, traditional energy vehicle sales, new energy electric vehicle sales, global new energy vehicle stock, and global traditional vehicle stock. Using the TOPSIS comprehensive evaluation model, we concluded that the development of new energy electric vehicles will become a dominant trend in the market, significantly impacting the traditional automobile market. Moreover, our team systematically collected-information on negative policies towards China each year, quantified the factors influencing the impact of policies on the development of new energy vehicles, and defined it as the Policy Sanctions Index. Finally, we collected nationwide data and scaled the vehicle ownership based on population. Using the carbon emission calculation formula, we established a mathematical model to analyze the impact of the electrification of new energy electric vehicles on the carbon emission index.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Image Recognition and Automatic Translation Technology in English Translation Software
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, image recognition and automatic translation technology are more and more widely used in English translation software. This paper aims to explore how the combination of these two technologies can improve translation efficiency and accuracy. First, the basic concept of image recognition and its main applications in translation software are outlined, including real-time image translation and optical character recognition (OCR) technology. Second, it analyzes the current status, advantages and challenges of the current automatic translation technology, and explores the potential opportunities brought by its deep integration with image recognition. Finally, it looks forward to the future development direction of this field, and believes that technological innovation and user experience optimization will be the key factors to promote the continuous progress of English translation software. Through this study, it is expected to provide reference and reference for academic research and practical application in related fields.

articleTitle: Development of Automotive Adaptive Cruise Control Algorithm Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of intelligent transportation system and autonomous driving technology, Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) system has become a key component of modern intelligent vehicles. However, the traditional rule-based ACC system shows the problem of insufficient flexibility in complex and changeable traffic environment. Therefore, a new ACC algorithm is designed by introducing reinforcement learning (RL) technology, especially hierarchical RL framework, in order to improve the adaptability and anthropomorphic driving style of the system. Firstly, this paper constructs a hierarchical RL framework, which includes high-level policy network (HPLN) and low-level execution network (LLEN). Secondly, in order to learn anthropomorphic driving strategy, this paper adopts the inverse RL (IRL) method. By collecting the driving data of human drivers in different road environments and traffic conditions, IRL algorithm is used to learn a reward function that can reflect human driving styles and preferences. Then, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm is used to train the strategy network to maximize the learned reward function, so as to realize anthropomorphic driving behavior. This study is verified by experiments on the CARLA simulation platform. The experimental results show that the algorithm has obvious advantages in safety, comfort and following, and can effectively adapt to the complex and changeable traffic environment and realize a more anthropomorphic driving style. Compared with other comparative algorithms, the algorithm proposed in this paper shows superior performance in key indexes such as collision times, sudden braking times, acceleration change rate and bump degree. The development method of automobile ACC algorithm based on RL proposed in this paper effectively improves the adaptive ability and anthropomorphic driving style of ACC system by introducing hierarchical RL framework and inverse RL technology, and provides new ideas and methods for the development of intelligent driving technology.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Operation and Maintenance System for Power Information Room Based on MR Hybrid Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Based on MR (Mixed Reality) technology, this article studies an intelligent operation and maintenance system for power information rooms. The system utilizes smart glasses and other devices to overlay virtual content onto the real environment, enabling operation and maintenance personnel to interact with virtual objects. It can be achieved through functions such as real-time monitoring and display, fault location and maintenance, training and knowledge transfer, as well as data analysis and decision support. By applying MR technology, the system displays real-time monitoring data in the computer room, helping operation and maintenance personnel understand the status of equipment; fault information is displayed in real-time in the view of maintenance personnel, and through virtual guidance and operation guidelines, it helps to quickly locate faults and carry out repairs; by simulating the computer room environment for virtual training, new employees can learn operation and maintenance knowledge in the virtual environment; a large amount of data can be visualized to assist operations and maintenance personnel in data analysis and decision-making. The experimental results show that the system can improve the work efficiency of operation and maintenance personnel (Max: 92.2%), reduce the error rate (Min: 6.2%), and improve the quality of fault handling and the scientificity of decision-making.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of a New Improved P&O Algorithm in Photovoltaic Controllers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In the context of escalating global energy demands and environmental challenges, renewable energy utilization has garnered significant attention. Among these, photovoltaic (PV) power generation stands out as a crucial form of renewable energy, profoundly influencing both energy utilization efficiency and economic benefits. Nonetheless, practical PV generation frequently encounters issues like uneven lighting and localized shading, phenomena that trigger array mismatches and hot spots, significantly diminishing the power generation efficiency and system safety. To tackle these challenges and enhance the speed and precision of Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) in complex shadowing scenarios, this study introduces an innovative MPPT control method that combines the strengths of the Improved Particle Swarm Optimization (IPSO) and Disturbance and Observation (P&O) algorithms. The performance of this method in PV controllers is then rigorously analyzed. The findings reveal that under challenging shadow conditions, our proposed IPSO-P&O algorithm significantly enhances MPPT tracking speed and accuracy, effectively mitigates the negative impacts of array mismatches and hot spots on power generation efficiency, and ultimately improves the overall performance and safety of PV power generation systems.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence Algorithms in Monitoring and Prediction of Four Rate Integration in Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In the current landscape of rapidly advancing smart grid technology, safeguarding the grid’s safety, efficacy, and reliability stands at the forefront of the power industry’s priorities. Central to this endeavor is the integration of four key grid metrics: line loss, trip frequency, complaint rate, and electricity fee recovery. This composite index serves as a pivotal yardstick for assessing the grid’s operational status. Monitoring and forecasting these metrics are crucial for enhancing grid efficiency, optimizing resource allocation, and minimizing operational expenses. This article explores the utilization of artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms in overseeing and anticipating the integration of these four grid metrics. Specifically, it introduces a prediction algorithm rooted in deep learning (DL). This approach excels at uncovering the inherent patterns and trends within grid operational data, enabling real-time monitoring of grid status and forecasting the future trajectory of the integrated four-rate index. The empirical findings demonstrate that the proposed algorithm not only elevates the intelligence quotient of grid management but also provides prompt alerts upon detecting abnormal grid conditions. This timely intervention significantly diminishes the incidence of failures, thereby bolstering the grid’s stability and reliability.

Author Keywords: integration of four power grid rates

articleTitle: Classification and Prediction of English News Text Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the emergence of news media and the continuous development of new technologies such as the Internet, the Internet of Things and 5G, in modern society, people can sit at home and know what is happening at home and abroad through news media and other means. Some people even watch English news directly. In order to help these people better read and understand the categories of English news they are reading; this paper proposes a machine learning based English news text classification and prediction method. Firstly, prepare the English news sample data (20Newgroups dataset); The second step is to preliminarily initialize and analyze the dataset; Then comes the modeling stage, which includes several small steps such as dataset splitting, TF-IDF analysis and processing, model training (training set score 0.951932, test set score 0.881306), and test set prediction, in order to achieve data mining; The final step is classification prediction, using the model to predict actual new data and verify the model’s generalization level. After a series of operational evaluations, the model performs well, responds quickly, and has strong stability, which can meet the research requirements of this article.

articleTitle: Power Load Forecasting and Accurate Early Warning Model Simulation of Power Theft Based on Data Mining Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Given the challenges posed to power system operation by the increasing global energy demand, traditional load forecasting methods struggle to meet contemporary requirements for accuracy and real-time performance. This article uses Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) as the basic model, combined with ensemble learning strategy, to construct an efficient power load forecasting model. By preprocessing data, extracting features, and conducting correlation analysis, significant features influencing power load are identified to enhance the model’s prediction accuracy. Experimental findings demonstrate that the ensemble learning LSTM model outperforms the single LSTM model significantly in terms of mean square error (MSE) and root mean square error (RMSE), validating the effectiveness of ensemble learning in improving prediction accuracy. At the same time, this paper also constructs an accurate early warning model of power theft based on LSTM, which can effectively identify power theft by mining abnormal patterns in historical power consumption data of users and combining external characteristics such as weather and holidays. The weighted average method is used to integrate the prediction results of several LSTM models, which improves the accuracy and robustness of early warning. In the simulation experiment, by artificially injecting the data of electricity stealing behavior, it is verified that the model can accurately identify and warn the electricity stealing behavior, and the accuracy and recall rate reach a high level. This study provides a new and more accurate load forecasting and early warning method for power industry. This helps ensure the stable functioning of the power grid, improves resource allocation efficiency, and minimizes economic losses.

articleTitle: Intelligent Accounting Cost Fusion Analysis and Prediction Model Based on Multi-source Heterogeneous Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore the intelligent accounting cost fusion analysis and prediction model based on multi-source heterogeneous data, so as to solve the challenges of traditional accounting cost analysis methods in dealing with complex business environment. By integrating multi-source data such as enterprise internal system, external data and public data, this study constructs a comprehensive data set, which provides sufficient support for the establishment and training of the model. In the model establishment stage, deep learning models were adopted in the study, especially models combining Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long Short Term Memory Networks (LSTM), to model and predict cost data. The empirical analysis results show that our intelligent accounting cost fusion analysis and prediction model shows good results in predicting costs, and it is found that there is a certain correlation between costs and market share of enterprises. This research provides important cost management and marketing decisions reference for enterprises, which has important theoretical and practical significance.

articleTitle: Intelligent Error Prevention and Security Algorithm for Power Dispatch Based on Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In today’s increasingly expanding and complex power grid, ensuring the safe and reliable operation of the power grid has become an important research direction facing the power industry. The traditional power dispatch method mainly relies on manual operation and experience for decision-making, which has the drawbacks of slow response speed, high risk of misoperation, and inability to be suitable for the operation of large power grids. In order to improve the automation and security of power dispatch operation, this article applies data analysis to intelligent error prevention and security algorithms, thereby improving the automation level and security of power dispatch. This article adopts advanced technologies such as data mining, pattern recognition, and machine learning to construct a comprehensive intelligent error prevention and security algorithm framework. The experimental results indicate that the application of data analysis can effectively identify potential risks in power grid operation and provide timely scheduling suggestions. The application of data analysis can enable algorithms to achieve faster response speed and accuracy, with a maximum scheduling accuracy of $\mathbf{9 7. 8 \%}$. It also has advantages in adaptability and distributed energy response.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Real-time Power Scene Action Recognition System Based on Edge Deployment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the improvement of safety and operation standardization requirements in power industry, real-time motion recognition technology has become the key to ensure the stable operation of power system. This paper presents a design and optimization scheme of real-time power scene action recognition system based on edge deployment. This research adopts deep learning technology, especially the hybrid model of convolutional neural network (CNN) and long short term memory networks (LSTM), and combines edge computing architecture to design an efficient and accurate action recognition system. By real-time monitoring and identifying the operation actions of the staff in the power scene, the system can find potential safety hazards in time and improve the safety and operation efficiency of the power system. In the aspect of algorithm research, this paper further improves the accuracy and real-time performance of motion recognition by introducing attention mechanism and lightweight network structure. In the strategy of edge deployment, model compression and pruning are used to optimize the model performance, and edge computing devices with high performance and low power consumption are selected to realize the efficient deployment and operation of deep learning models on edge devices. The experimental results show that the system has achieved high recognition accuracy on several public data sets and user-defined data sets, and is significantly better than the traditional methods. In addition, the system shows good stability and reliability in practical application, which provides strong support for the intelligent upgrade of the power industry.

articleTitle: Construction of Cloud Edge Integrated Data Model and Design of Efficient Processing Algorithm in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The purpose of this article is to build a data model of power distribution network (PDN) which adapts to the cloud edge integration architecture, and to design an efficient data processing algorithm. In order to achieve this goal, this study analyzes the characteristics of PDN data, including data source, structure, scale and dynamics. Based on these characteristics, a multi-level and modular data model is constructed to meet the data processing needs of cloud, edge and terminal. Furthermore, an efficient processing algorithm is designed to improve the data transmission efficiency and processing speed. The experimental results show that the data model and processing algorithm are excellent in prediction accuracy, real-time, F1 score and mean absolute error (MAE), which proves its effectiveness and superiority. The research results not only provide a solution for the unified representation and efficient transmission of PDN data, but also lay the foundation for the intelligent management of PDN. Through the integrated data processing architecture of cloud edge, it is expected to promote the development of PDN in a more intelligent and efficient direction.

articleTitle: Analysis Technology of Surface Characteristics of Archaeological Relics Fragments Based on Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As the witness of history, the surface features of archaeological relics fragments contain rich historical information and cultural connotation. The purpose of this article is to discuss the surface feature analysis technology of archaeological fragments based on image processing, especially the application of image enhancement technology in this field, and put forward an effective analysis framework. In this article, image processing technology is introduced, and the application of image enhancement technology in the analysis of the surface characteristics of archaeological debris is studied emphatically. This framework will be able to accurately extract and analyze various features on the surface of cultural relics fragments, such as texture, shape, color and so on. Through comparative experiments, it is found that compared with the traditional convolutional neural network (CNN) model, the proposed method shows significant advantages in image enhancement precision, task processing time and feature analysis recall. The results show that this method can extract and analyze the surface characteristics of cultural relics fragments more effectively, and provide archaeologists with more accurate and comprehensive research materials.

articleTitle: Fault Early Warning and Judgment System of Low-Voltage Substation Based on Deep Learning and Knowledge Map
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This article proposes a low-voltage substation fault warning and analysis system based on deep learning and knowledge graph, aiming to improve the safe operation level and fault handling efficiency of low-voltage substation power grids. Firstly, a prediction model was constructed using deep learning techniques, and features were learned and extracted from the data using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long Short Term Memory Networks (LSTM) models. Taking the time series data of current, voltage and other parameters as input, the temporal and spatial features of the data are extracted through multi-layer convolution and pooling operation, and then the time correlation of the data is captured through the LSTM model, and finally the high-dimensional feature representation is obtained, so as to make full use of the temporal and spatial information and time series information. Secondly, the equipment relationship model based on knowledge map is established, and the correlation between equipment is used to assist fault diagnosis and analysis. In the experiment, the system is verified by using real low-voltage data, and compared with the traditional method. The experimental results show that the proposed system can accurately predict the possible faults in the low-voltage area, and diagnose the faults with the help of knowledge map, with high accuracy and efficiency. Therefore, this system has great significance and application value in improving the operation safety and fault handling efficiency of low-voltage power grid.

articleTitle: Research on Sorting System of Industrial Robot Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In the process of material sorting, the traditional manual sorting method is not only inefficient, but also has huge security risks. Affected by the types, shapes, quality and other factors of different materials, its sorting method also has some limitations. In order to solve the above problems, a material sorting system based on industrial robot is proposed in this paper. The hardware part of the sorting system mainly comprises an industrial camera, an industrial computer for processing image data, a control system, a robot control cabinet, an industrial robot, a frequency converter, a driving device and an executing mechanism. The software part of the sorting system includes a main module, a motion control module, a data communication module and an intelligent sorting module. This paper takes metal workpieces as the sorting object, and compares manual sorting with sorting system sorting. The results show that the designed sorting system can complete the sorting tasks of different sizes of metal workpieces in a short time, and the sorting efficiency and error rate are far lower than those of manual sorting. The industrial robot sorting system based on machine vision designed in this paper improves the industrial production efficiency and reduces the working cost.

articleTitle: Design and Development of an Intelligent Advertising Placement Decision System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This paper puts forward the design and development scheme of Intelligent Advertising Placement Decision System (IAPDS), aiming at solving the pain points in the traditional advertising mode and improving the accuracy and effect of advertising. Through in-depth analysis of the research status and challenges in the field of advertising, this paper designs a set of IAPDS based on big data analysis, machine learning and deep learning technology. The system includes data collection, storage, processing, business logic and display modules, and realizes the functions of user portrait construction, advertising strategy formulation, advertising effect prediction and evaluation. Through the system function test and performance test, the accuracy and effectiveness of the system in user portrait construction, advertising strategy formulation and advertising effect prediction and evaluation are verified.
