The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional advertising system, the IAPDS designed in this paper can more accurately match users’ interests and needs, effectively improve the click-through rate and conversion rate of advertisements, and provide strong support for the digital transformation of the advertising industry. This study not only has theoretical value, but also has broad application prospects.

articleTitle: Research on Application and Algorithm Optimization of UAV in Agricultural Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of UAV technology, its application in agriculture has been paid more and more attention. UAV can be equipped with multi-spectral and hyperspectral cameras to monitor farmland with high precision and obtain key information such as crop growth, soil moisture, pests and diseases in real time. However, UAV faces challenges in agricultural monitoring, such as flight stability, endurance, data acquisition and processing speed. Therefore, this study uses Phantom 4 RTKUAV in DJI for agricultural monitoring, and optimizes the image preprocessing algorithm. Noise is removed by median filtering algorithm, and image edge information is retained. The histogram equalization method is used to enhance the contrast and clarity of the image. The experimental results show that the optimized algorithm can significantly improve the image quality and improve the accuracy and efficiency of data processing. In addition, the importance of parameter selection of the algorithm is discussed, and suggestions for future research are put forward.

articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis and Optimal Control Model of Information Flow for Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Energy Internet, as a key force to promote the transformation of the global energy system to a more green, efficient and intelligent direction, its core idea is to build an integrated energy network that seamlessly connects different regions and spans multiple energy forms. In the architecture of the energy Internet, information flow plays a crucial role. Like a nervous system, it realizes the deep integration and collaboration of energy flow, business flow and data flow. In order to further improve the operation efficiency and stability of the energy Internet, this paper innovatively proposes a quantitative analysis and optimization control model of information flow for the energy Internet. This model accurately captures and analyzes the complex and changeable information flow laws in the energy Internet, and combines advanced artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm and big data technology to carry out refined management and optimal scheduling of information flow. The experimental results show that the model can significantly improve the information processing speed of the energy Internet, optimize resource allocation strategies, reduce energy waste, enhance the system’s response to emergencies, and provide a strong technical support for the sustainable development of the energy Internet.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Intelligent Security Protection Algorithm for 5G Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the widespread deployment of 5G communication technology, it is facing severe security challenges while providing high-speed, large-capacity and low-delay communication services. Aiming at the security risks such as data leakage, network intrusion and denial of service in 5G network, this paper deeply studies the intelligent security protection algorithm for 5G communication. Firstly, by introducing advanced machine learning and deep learning technology, this study constructs an intelligent intrusion detection system (IDS) that can automatically detect and respond to various network threats. The system utilizes a combination of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long Short Term Memory Networks (LSTM) to capture the temporal and spatial characteristics of network traffic, achieving efficient and accurate classification of network traffic, and distinguishing between normal network behavior and abnormal or malicious behavior. In addition, through a large number of experiments and tests, the stability and generalization ability of the system under various attack types are verified. Secondly, in order to improve the adaptability of the system, an adaptive security protection strategy is designed in this study. This strategy can dynamically adjust security protection measures according to the real-time network environment and detected threats, and effectively deal with emerging security challenges. Through threat assessment and policy adjustment, strict defense against high-level threats and lightweight defense against low-level threats are realized, ensuring the normal operation of network services. The intelligent security protection algorithm designed in this paper is not only innovative and advanced in theory, but also shows good detection ability and protection effect in practice. Therefore, this research has important theoretical significance and practical application value for improving the security of 5G communication networks.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning-based Autonomous Driving Path Planning for Smart Connected Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This paper investigates a reinforcement learning-based autonomous driving path planning method for smart connected vehicles. As an important part of the future transportation system, the development of autonomous driving technology for smart connected vehicles has attracted much attention. Among many path planning methods, reinforcement learning excels because of its ability to learn and optimize strategies in complex and dynamic environments. In this paper, we first introduce the basic principles of reinforcement learning and its current application in autonomous driving, and then design a path planning model suitable for intelligent networked vehicles, describing the problem definition, algorithm selection and improvement, reward function design, and model training and optimization process in detail. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through experiments, and the experimental results show that the path planning model based on reinforcement learning is able to realize efficient and safe autonomous driving under complex road conditions. Finally, the paper discusses the application prospects and limitations of the research and looks forward to future research directions.

articleTitle: Discussion on Computer-aided Automatic Generation of Distribution Network Dispatching Operation Tickets for Load Transfer, Power Outage, and Power Restoration in Power Dispatch
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Due to the increasing complexity of the distribution network, manual writing methods are difficult to meet the requirements of speed and accuracy, especially in case of emergencies. In order to improve the efficiency and accuracy of scheduling work, this paper studies a scheduling job sequence generation method based on comprehensive power outage. On this basis, this article adopts a power system network modeling method based on the power system, and combines the equipment information, operation rules, and operation rules in the system to optimize the operation tasks. Power outage area A (equipment failure) response time of 2 seconds, operation ticket generation time of 4 seconds, and operation ticket accuracy of 95%; Power outage area B (natural disaster) response time is 3 seconds, operation ticket generation time is 5 seconds, and operation ticket accuracy is $\mathbf{9 8 \%}$. The research results indicate that this new control strategy can effectively reduce operational errors, shorten downtime, and is of great significance for enhancing the stability and safety of the power grid.

articleTitle: Analysis of Time Synchronization Technology of 5G Slice Based on TSN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of 5G technology, network slicing technology has become the key to meet diversified business needs. However, it is a great challenge to ensure the timing synchronization between slices. Therefore, this article proposes a timing synchronization scheme of 5G slices based on TSN, aiming at achieving high-precision time synchronization and deterministic transmission. Firstly, the specific requirements and technical indicators of timing synchronization of 5 G slices are defined. Then, the design of timing synchronization scheme based on TSN is introduced in detail, which uses the high-precision time synchronization and deterministic transmission characteristics of TSN technology to meet the timing synchronization requirements of 5G chips. By optimizing the network architecture, selecting the appropriate time synchronization protocol, and designing the isolation and timing control mechanism between slices. The experimental results show that the timing synchronization technology of 5G slices based on TSN can achieve microsecond time synchronization accuracy, effectively reduce the transmission delay between slices and within slices, and improve the efficiency and real-time performance of data transmission. Furthermore, the technology also shows good stability and reliability, and can quickly restore the synchronization state after the fault occurs. It provides new ideas and methods for the development of 5G slicing technology.

articleTitle: Research on the Assets Calculation Method of New Energy Vehicle Brand based on a hybrid model of projection tracking + computer simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As a crucial direction in the future development of the automotive industry, new energy vehicles have garnered significant attention from various automakers. Simultaneously, the assets of new energy vehicle brands are a key reflection of the strength of these enterprises. To accurately calculate the assets of new energy vehicle brands, this paper presents a calculation method. Initially, we construct a factor index set for calculating new energy vehicle brand assets based on the Web of Science and EI databases. This set includes three layers of factor indicators. Subsequently, we use weighted summation techniques and integer mapping methods to calculate the scores of third - level and second-level factor indicators. Next, computer simulation techniques are employed to calculate the initial parameters of projection tracking. Finally, based on the second-level factor indicators, we use projection tracking technology to calculate first-level factor scores. The results indicate that the scores of new energy vehicle brand assets align with reality. Thus, this paper provides an outstanding method for calculating the assets of new energy vehicle brands in the automotive industry, promoting the healthy development of China’s new energy vehicle sector.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence Computer 3D Image Reconstruction Technology in Ceramic Restoration System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: A constant shear force design method based on the principle of mechanical strength was proposed. The purpose is to improve the cutting performance and machining quality of ceramics. The sintering process of ceramics was controlled by STD bus microcomputer. It is composed of photoelectric isolation, low-pass filtering and industrial computer with high stability. According to the condition of equal load, a trajectory planning algorithm for five-axis milling under equal stress is presented. A program design platform of multi-axis CNC machine tool based on equal stress is developed to realize the tool path of five-axis CNC milling with reduced cutting depth and feed rate. The VERICUT softwareis used for numerical simulation to verify that the tool vector is correct. The cutting experiment was carried out byusing Micron high speed CNC machine tool. Small cutting depth and small feed can realize fast cutting and repair of ceramic materials at high speed. The system prevents ceramic cracks of $2-4 \mathrm{~mm}$. In this way, the complete processing and restoration of ceramic materials are achieved.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Extraction of Electricity Hotspots Based on Information Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Under the construction of new electric power system, research on how to promote the construction of electric power enterprise intelligence by improving the hotspot extraction and transformation ability of intelligence information and forming high-level enterprise intelligence results can help to promote the transformation and upgrading and high-quality development of power grid enterprises in the new era. Based on this, this paper firstly constructs a grid enterprise intelligence information mining, processing and analysis model based on TF-IDF technology, co-word analysis and other text analysis methods. Secondly, the news headlines and text information of China Power News website from October 2023 to April 2024 were crawled using Python. Finally, the proposed model was applied to analyze the news data to obtain the hot word cloud map and term frequency trend changes in each month, and the correlation between each keyword was discussed through co-word analysis. The results show that the proposed method thus forms a complete set of focus of attention and effective information acquisition process, which can help power grid enterprises to refine the key research direction and strategic layout from news intelligence information.

articleTitle: A New Optimization Method for Power Resource Allocation Based on Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: To improve the overall utilization rate of resources and carry out unified security management of resources, a method for predicting the future task volume and resource demand of users is proposed based on the long short-term memory network model. Firstly, the training model was established according to the initial sample set of sample data information. The prediction model in the long short-term memory network model is used to predict the amount of future tasks [1]. Resource requirements are then mapped based on the calculation of future task volumes. Based on the long short-term memory network model, the method comprehensively considers the user’s historical law, time, business characteristics and other latitudes, analyzes the mapping relationship between the user’s task volume and the required resources based on the correlation analysis technology, and establishes a mapping model from the task volume to the resource demand, to realize the accurate prediction of the user’s future task volume and resource demand.

articleTitle: Calculation of Neutral Grounding Method and Grounding Transformer Capacity for Photovoltaic Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: China is the world’s second largest economy and the country with the largest industrialization scale, as well as one of the world’s largest energy consumers. China uses fossil fuels such as coal as its main energy source, and fossil fuel combustion is the main source of air pollution in China. Therefore, the development of renewable energy sources such as solar energy, wind energy, and tidal energy has become a requirement of China’s 14th Five Year Plan, with the focus on internal circulation and the construction of domestic and international dual circulation. The grounding method of the neutral point directly affects the insulation level of electrical equipment and the safety, reliability, and power supply continuity of photovoltaic power plants. The installation scale, grid connection voltage level, single-phase grounding fault current, protection device sensitivity, and overvoltage level of solar photovoltaic power stations vary, and the grounding method of the neutral point varies. The article discusses the application of various neutral grounding methods in solar photovoltaic power plants, and then takes a photovoltaic power plant in Zhangbei County, Zhangjiakou City, Hebei Province as an example to study the capacity calculation method of grounding transformers for a 50 MW level large-scale solar photovoltaic power plant. This can provide reference for the selection of grounding transformer capacity for large-scale grid connected photovoltaic power plants.

articleTitle: Data Model Transformation Method for Distribution Network Management System Based on CIM
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the development of the energy industry and the increasing maturity of intelligent technology, the requirements for power supply in distribution networks are also increasing. The traditional distribution network management mode mostly uses modular methods for data processing, which is difficult to meet the needs of complex power grid topology and massive data processing. The data collection module of the distribution network management system based on CIM (Common Information Model) is responsible for collecting various types of data from the distribution system, such as power grid topology, equipment status, load, etc. According to the mapping rules of CIM, the original data can be transformed into a structure and semantics consistent with CIM. The transformed data can be integrated into CIM to generate a comprehensive data model, and on this basis, compatibility and stability with existing systems can be achieved. In order to improve the performance and efficiency of the system and sustainably optimize and adapt the conversion methods, this study found that when the dataset size is 100 KB, the conversion time is 5 seconds, CPU (Central Processing Unit) utilization is 20%, and memory consumption is 50 MB. When the dataset size is 500 KB, the conversion time is 10 seconds, CPU usage is $\mathbf{3 0 \%}$, and memory consumption is 100 MB. The research results of this article can have important theoretical significance and application value in promoting the sustainable development of China’s energy industry.

articleTitle: Dynamic Balance Detection Method of High-speed Cutting Tool Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the increasing demand for high-speed cutting technology in modern manufacturing industry, tool dynamic balance has become a key factor affecting cutting efficiency, machining quality and tool life. In this paper, a dynamic balance detection method of high-speed cutting tools based on computer vision is proposed to overcome the limitations of traditional dynamic balance detection methods and improve the detection accuracy and efficiency. This method achieves rapid acquisition and high-quality processing of tool images by constructing a computer vision system consisting of Panasonic LUMIX series high-resolution industrial cameras, Sigma high-definition industrial lenses, LR-LINK quad-port 5G PoE image acquisition cards, and dedicated LED light sources. In the research process, Gaussian filter and Canny edge detection algorithm are used to preprocess the image to improve the accuracy of feature extraction. Through ellipse fitting and centroid calculation, the unbalance of the tool is accurately obtained. Finally, according to the calculation results, suggestions for dynamic balance adjustment are given. In the experiment, three different types of tools, namely end milling cutter, drill bit and turning tool, were selected and verified under various cutting conditions. The results show that the detection error rate of this method is reduced by about $\mathbf{1 5 \%}$ to $\mathbf{2 5 \%}$ compared with the traditional dynamic balance detection method, and it has higher accuracy and stability. In addition, computer vision technology realizes automatic detection, avoids potential damage to the tool during the detection process, and significantly improves the detection efficiency. This study provides an efficient and accurate new method for dynamic balance detection of high-speed cutting tools, which has important application value.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Agricultural Automation Control System Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The development and application of Agricultural Automation Control System (AACS) based on Internet of Things (IoT) aims to promote the intelligent and automatic process of agricultural production by using IoT technology. Aiming at the limitations of traditional agricultural production methods, such as inaccurate data collection and inflexible control strategies, this study proposes and develops an AACS based on IoT. The system adopts reasonable system architecture design, including data acquisition layer, data transmission layer, data processing layer and application layer, so as to realize accurate data acquisition, intelligent control strategy and efficient agricultural production management. In the system development, the characteristics of IoT technology and the actual demand of agricultural production are fully considered, and suitable hardware devices such as sensors, controllers and actuators are selected to ensure that the system can monitor and adjust the farmland environment accurately and efficiently. At the same time, a stable and efficient data transmission mechanism and data processing software module are designed and implemented to ensure the accurate transmission and effective utilization of data. The system performance test results show that the system has good performance and stability under different load scenarios. Subsequently, a representative agricultural production scene-vegetable planting base in greenhouse was selected for systematic application demonstration. The practical application results show that the system can significantly improve agricultural production efficiency, reduce production costs and improve the quality of agricultural products. This study not only promoted the process of intellectualization and automation of agricultural production, but also provided strong technical support for the sustainable development of modern agriculture.

articleTitle: Design of Industrial Control Communication Encryption and Authentication System Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In this paper, based on artificial intelligence algorithms, an intelligent industrial control communication model is constructed. Firstly, the secret transmission of communication data is realized by establishing encryption nodes between sensor network sensing nodes and convergence points. Then the network key is encoded to automatically generate asymmetric key, in order to complete the communication model authentication, and finally the model is analyzed in practice. The results show that the decryption time of the intelligent industrial control communication model is only 3.39 s, and the data transmission time is all within 15 ms. The functions of information encryption, digital signature and authentication in the communication system are realized.

articleTitle: Study on the Planning Scheme of DC Outgoing Power with a High Proportion of Renewable Energy Sources and the Formulation of DC Delivery Curves
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In order to evaluate the safety, reliability, economy, adaptability and environmental friendliness of power planning decisions in detail, a detailed operation simulation of the future power system is required. Through the establishment of mathematical models of various types of unit scheduling methods and simulation models of future power system scheduling and operation, and research and development of the corresponding calculation methods, to achieve the expected scheduling and operation pattern of the power system as well as the planning of the project’s expected economic benefits of the prejudgement of the system’s potential operational risks, and to realize the closed-loop power planning decision-making calibration and adjustment, to lay the foundation of the lean and intelligent power planning work. Lay the foundation for lean and intelligent power planning. In this paper, the method of DC transmission curve formulation is given, the system operation simulation model reflecting the intermittency and stochasticity of renewable energy output is established, and the GOPT5.0 software is used to simulate the large-scale renewable energy DC transmission scheme.

articleTitle: Development of Intelligent Analysis and Visualization Software Tools for Environmental Monitoring Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the increasingly severe environmental pollution problem, the widespread deployment of environmental monitoring stations has generated massive and complex environmental data. Traditional data processing methods seem inadequate in the face of such a large amount of data, while the introduction of big data technology has brought revolutionary changes to the processing and analysis of environmental monitoring data. Through big data analysis, not only can the accuracy and completeness of monitoring data be significantly improved, but also the efficiency and quality of environmental monitoring can be greatly improved, providing solid data support and scientific decision-making basis for environmental management departments. This article focuses on developing an efficient and intelligent software tool for analyzing and visualizing environmental monitoring data, aiming to meet the high requirements for data processing and display in current environmental protection work. This software deeply integrates big data analysis and deep learning (DL) technology, and achieves intelligent mining and deep analysis of environmental monitoring data by constructing advanced algorithm models. The experimental results show that the software can accurately identify environmental change trends, predict potential pollution events, evaluate environmental quality levels, and present the analysis results to users in an intuitive and understandable visual form.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Application and Optimization in Autonomous Driving Environment Sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of autonomous driving technology, environment perception becomes a key link to ensur vehicle safety and decision effectiveness. Deep learning technology, with its powerful data processing and pattern recognition capabilities, has been widely used in automatic driving environment perception. This paper systematically explores the basic applications of deep learning in environment perception, including image recognition, target detection and semantic segmentation. In addition, this paper also analyzes in depth the strategies to optimize the application of deep learning technology in environment perception, which mainly include data enhancement and preprocessing, model architecture optimization, and multi-sensor fusion technology. For the application challenges of autonomous driving in complex environments, such as dynamic scenes, uncertainty and extreme weather, this paper proposes a series o solutions, including reinforcement learning, transfer learning and simulation training. Through the research in this paper, we aim to provide reference and guidance for the future development of autonomous driving environment perception technology, and promote the realization of more efficient and safe autonomous driving systems.

articleTitle: Traffic Analysis and Optimal Control Technology in Computer Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the explosive growth of network traffic brings great challenges to the stability and performance of the network. The purpose of this paper is to deeply analyze the new characteristics of network traffic and explore more general and efficient optimal control technology to cope with the ever-changing network environment and demand. The study first uses clustering analysis in data mining techniques to deeply explore the inherent laws and changing trends of network traffic. Then, the time series prediction model Long Short Term Memory Neural Network (LSTM) is used to predict the future trend of network traffic, providing important basis for the rational allocation of network resources, prevention of congestion control, and optimization of network performance. In addition, an optimal control strategy based on flow prediction is proposed, and a corresponding optimal control system is designed and implemented. The system collects network traffic data in real time, uses advanced LSTM prediction algorithm to predict future traffic, and formulates and optimizes control strategies based on the prediction results, so as to improve network performance. The experimental results show that the optimized control system can significantly improve the network throughput and reduce the delay under different network loads, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Planning of Transfer Capacity Distribution System Based on ESGA Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the unremittingly growth of power demand and the increasing complexity of the power system, the optimization of the transferring capacity of the distribution system is becoming more and more important. As a key element to ensure the stability and reliability of the power system, the optimization of transferring capacity is particularly important, especially when dealing with emergencies or power demand fluctuations. However, existing studies have limitations in multi-objective planning of distribution system transferring capacity, which is difficult to fully meet the actual needs of the power system. To address this problem, this paper presents a multi-objective optimization method for distribution system transfer capacity based on an progressd ESGA (Evolutionary Strategy Genetic Algorithm) genetic algorithm. The method realizes the multi-objective optimization of the switching capacity of the distribution system by introducing the ESGA algorithm and using its powerful global search capability and the flexibility of the fitness function. Through simulation experiments on real cases, this paper verifies the effectiveness and practicality of the proposed method. The experimental results show that when the power factor is lower than the preset threshold, the system parameters need to be adjusted or technical means need to be taken to progress the power factor; while when the energy loss is too high, it may be necessary to reduce the system energy loss by optimizing the current distribution and reducing the line loss.

articleTitle: Research on the Algorithm for Detecting Appearance Defects of Automotive Precision Parts Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Various defects are inevitably generated during the manufacturing process of parts, such as size deviation, scratches, cracks, scratches, surface pollution, etc. These defects are important factors leading to system operation failures, and are more serious in high-precision systems, such as some precision parts in automotive engines. Appearance defect detection is an indispensable part. Traditional detection relies on manual means, with low detection accuracy and multiple influencing factors. Therefore, improving the accuracy of precision component detection is imperative. This article introduces a deep learning-based method to identify and classify defects in automotive precision parts, which is significantly superior to traditional machine learning methods. Our deep learning model has an accuracy of 92.5%, an accuracy of 89.6%, a recall rate of 91.2%, an $F 1$ score of $\mathbf{9 0. 4 \%}$, and a significant average detection time of $\mathbf{0. 5}$ seconds. The implementation of this method can greatly improve manufacturing efficiency and product quality, ensuring higher safety standards and customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Motor Fault Diagnosis Algorithm Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The increasing degree of industrial automation makes electric motors play an important role as key power sources in various production lines, so their health monitoring and fault diagnosis are particularly important. The aim of this study is to develop a neural network-based motor fault diagnosis algorithm to accurately identify and predict potential motor faults through deep learning techniques. In this paper, we first collect the operation data of the motor under normal operation and various fault states, including multiple parameters such as current, voltage and temperature, and then use these data to train the deep neural network model so that it can learn the characteristics and patterns of motor faults. Techniques such as Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) are used for model training to enhance the processing capability of time series data and the efficiency of fault feature extraction. In the model validation stage, the advantages of the neural network model in fault detection accuracy and diagnostic speed are demonstrated by comparing it with the traditional fault diagnosis methods. The diagnostic performance of rotor imbalance is the best, with a test accuracy as high as 0.95 and a fault detection rate of 0.93, while the false alarm rate is only 0.04. The neural network-based fault diagnosis algorithm adopted in this paper not only improves the diagnostic accuracy and efficiency, but also facilitates the effective support of the intellectualization and automation of industrial maintenance, reduces the unplanned downtime, and guarantees the safety of production and economic benefits.

articleTitle: Development of a Performance Evaluation Model for Tennis Players Using Event-based Scoring and Non-linear Regression with Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This paper introduces the development of a model aimed at capturing the progression of scoring events in single or multiple tennis matches. The model serves the purpose of evaluating player performance within specific time intervals and determining their progress. To achieve this, we have created an evaluation model with relevant features and considered the use of data dimensionality reduction techniques to consolidate or enhance these features. Utilizing these problem-specific features, we can calculate performance scores for each player at different time points in every match. Subsequently, a non-linear regression model is established, using event time points as independent variables and performance scores as dependent variables. The parameters of this model are then determined using the differential evolution algorithm.

articleTitle: Construction of Computer Mathematical Model Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a computer mathematical model that addresses the issue of data redundancy in a genetic algorithm. The model combines an enhanced genetic algorithm with mobile computing. A MATLAB program that relies on a least square approach to solve equations, ascertain the parameter range, and address estimate parameter range and identification issues will be used in the paper. Integrating an enhanced genetic algorithm with mobile computing and the least square approach resulted in a significant expansion of the individual search area and a 90% gain in operational efficiency compared to the basic genetic algorithm or mobile computing alone. The findings demonstrate that the enhanced genetic algorithm and mobile computing can discern the ideal solution and significantly improve job efficiency.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Health Monitoring Software for Smart Pension System Based on Collaborative Recommendation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the change of China’s population structure, the problem of population aging has become increasingly prominent. With the emergence of the intelligent pension system, the elderly can better enjoy caring pension services. As the elderly are facing more health problems, health recommendation service is closely related to the health of the elderly, so it is particularly important. This paper analyzes and studies the health information recommendation algorithm combining user preference and trust relationship. In order to improve the accuracy of recommendation algorithm, this paper mines the user preferences and trust relationships of the elderly from their historical behaviors and social relationships. The combination of direct trust and indirect trust leads to social trust. Finally, the dynamic fusion method is adopted to adjust the weights of user preference similarity and social trust to obtain the mixed similarity among users. According to the software engineering specification process, the design of the software and each functional module is described in detail, and the function and performance of the software are tested by making test cases. The test results show that the elderly health information service recommendation software meets the expected functional requirements and performance requirements, and achieves the expected goal.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Technology of Large Electromechanical Equipment Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Modern mechanical and electrical equipment is prone to failure due to its complex structure, force condition and large-scale influence of environmental factors. At present, these problems have been studied at home and abroad. In this paper, the traditional experience summary method and Bayesian network method are used to model and simulate a large mechanical equipment, and the conclusion is drawn. At the same time, this paper proposes an algorithm to solve the above problems, and verifies the rationality and accuracy of the model. The feasibility and effectiveness of the algorithm are verified by the experimental results. The results are as follows: as time goes on, the response time increases gradually, which are $0.8,1.2,0.9,1.5$ and 0.7 respectively. At the fourth time point, the response time reached the highest value of $\mathbf{1. 5}$. These changes illustrate the trend of increasing failure response time over time. The low response time indicates that the system can quickly detect and diagnose faults, improve the reliability and availability of the equipment, and provide a reference value for the future application of artificial intelligence technology in electromechanical equipment.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Driven Optimization Management Algorithm for User Side Multi-source Data in Digital Electric Rooms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The swift technological advancement has led to the widespread adoption of intelligent collection devices in electrical power systems (EPS), ushering EPS into a new era of deep coupling within the “physics information society.” Consequently, harnessing this valuable information to craft precise user electricity behavior profiles and deliver personalized services has emerged as a focal research area in the power sector. To address this need, this paper introduces an innovative AI-powered optimization management algorithm tailored for user-side multi-source data in digital electrical rooms. This algorithm emphasizes the application of multi-source data fusion in EPS intelligent operation and maintenance, leveraging the strengths of deep learning (DL) technology. Its aim is to optimize and manage user-side multisource data, enhancing the accuracy of energy scheduling and fault warnings. Experimental findings demonstrate that the proposed algorithm not only accurately captures user electricity consumption patterns but also robustly supports EPS energy scheduling and fault detection, thereby paving the way for EPS intelligent operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Diagnosis System in Fault Prediction and Maintenance of Vacuum Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Traditional fault prediction methods often rely on manual experience and rules, which has some shortcomings. The intelligent diagnosis system combines advanced data analysis technologies, such as machine learning, artificial intelligence and signal processing, and can find hidden fault patterns from a large amount of data and improve the accurate prediction ability of faults. Firstly, the vibration signals during operation are obtained at two different positions of the high voltage vacuum circuit breaker by electromagnetic repulsion mechanism. Then, the improved S-transform is used for time-frequency analysis of the vibration signal, and the feature quantity is extracted based on normalized energy entropy, and the dimension of the feature vector is reduced by principal component analysis. Finally, the eigenvalues are input to SVM training model for fault classification and compared with wavelet packet decomposition. In addition, compared with other methods, the proposed method also shows superiority in accuracy. In summary, the fault diagnosis method based on improved S-transform and support vector machine has high accuracy and superiority in fault prediction and maintenance of HV vacuum circuit breaker.

articleTitle: Research on Safety Analysis and Prediction Technology for Crane Operation Based on Intelligent Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of China’s construction industry, various safety accidents caused by it have occurred frequently, causing huge losses to people’s lives and property. In order to reduce the probability of crane accidents, the advantages of intelligent algorithms were applied to stratify and decompose the causes of accidents, and identify key triggers. By utilizing deep learning and data mining techniques, combined with crane operation data and accident cases, a safety analysis model based on neural networks was established, and this model was used for accident risk prediction and warning. In the data validation of real crane construction sites, the model has shown high accuracy and effectiveness. The research results indicated that intelligent algorithms had significant effects in crane safety management. The crane safety prediction model established based on this method had good prediction ability for disasters such as collapse and high-altitude falls, with recall rates of up to 0.95 and 1, and accuracy in predicting comprehensive accidents of 0.884. Overall, it is in a good state. The research results of this article can provide new ideas and approaches for the study of safety control issues during on-site construction, and provide new methods for improving safety during the construction process.

articleTitle: Research on Autonomous Detection Algorithms for Spoofed Interference in Civil Aircraft Airborne Navigation Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the wide application of civil aircraft on-board navigation system, the demand for its safety and stability is increasing. In this paper, the aircraft navigation state data is acquired by GNSS and INS sensors, and the navigation state model is constructed. Through Kalman filtering algorithm, any abnormal or inconsistent navigation state is detected to monitor the real-time performance of the navigation system. When potential deceptive interference is detected, the algorithm is able to take appropriate decisions autonomously, such as switching to an alternate navigation system, sending warning notifications to the flight crew, and so on. In the simulated spoofed interference scenario, the algorithm successfully detected more than 95% of the interference events with an average response time of less than 5 seconds. When the on-board GNSS spoofing causes a position deviation of 250 m or more, the designed algorithm is able to realize a more accurate acquisition of the spoofing duration. The reliability and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in spoofed jamming scenarios are verified, and the anti-jamming capability of the civil aircraft airborne navigation system is improved.

articleTitle: Industrial Power Flexible Load Scheduling for Demand Side Management Considering Machine Buffer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In order to fully exploit the flexible potential of industrial power load, with the goal of minimizing the energy cost of industrial production and maximizing the achievable peak cutting amplitude, this paper proposes a multi-objective scheduling model for industrial power load considering machine buffer based on the state-task-network (STN) with machine buffer to represent the production process. An empirical case study based on a cement production line with a daily production capacity of 5,000 tons in Yunnan Province was used to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results show that the daily electricity cost is reduced by $14,716.39$ yuan and the difference rate between peak and valley load is also lowered by ${0 . 2 7 \%}$. The scheduling model proposed in this paper could be applied to the optimization management of other types of industrial power loads, which will produce greater economic benefits and more significant reduction effect of difference between peak and valley load.

articleTitle: Mechatronics Integration Technology for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Flight Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) flight control system, electromechanical integration technology is the key to ensure flight stability and safety. Data fusion technology, as an important part of mechatronics, plays a vital role in improving the flight performance of UAV. This article discusses the application of data fusion technology in UAV flight control system and its optimization method. By fusing data from different sensors, an efficient data fusion model is constructed in this study, aiming at improving the accuracy of UAV attitude estimation and location. Experimental results show that, compared with the traditional support vector machine (SVM) algorithm, the method proposed in this article is excellent in reducing the prediction error, and the average absolute error is reduced by $\mathbf{4 0. 1 1 \%}$, and the stability of the model is significantly enhanced. This research not only optimizes the flight control system of UAV, but also provides more solid technical support for the safe flight of UAV in a changeable and complex environment.

articleTitle: Optimization and Evaluation of Highly Reliable Data Transmission Strategies in 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development and wide application of 5 G technology, high-reliability data transmission becomes one of the crucial research topics in 5G networks. The purpose of this paper is to conduct a systematic research on the optimization and evaluation of high-reliability data transmission strategies in 5G networks. First, the data reliability requirements of various application scenarios are analyzed, and the limitations of existing technologies in meeting these requirements are pointed out. Second, a series of optimization strategies are proposed, including the selection and optimization of data transmission protocols, data redundancy and error correction mechanisms. Finally, the performance of different strategies is compared and analyzed in detail by designing and implementing performance evaluation experiments. The experimental results show that the proposed optimization strategies significantly improve the reliability and efficiency of data transmission. The research results in this paper provide a theoretical basis and practical reference for the further development of highly reliable data transmission strategies in 5G networks.

articleTitle: Intelligent Algorithms and Real-Time Monitoring Systems in Social and Psychological Crisis Intervention
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the acceleration of social pace and the increase of competitive pressure, people’s mental health problems have become increasingly prominent, and psychological crises have occurred frequently, posing a serious threat to social stability and personal well-being. Psychological crisis, as a serious state of psychological imbalance, not only affects an individual’s quality of life, but may also trigger a series of social problems. Therefore, how to effectively prevent and guide psychological crises has become an urgent problem to be solved in current social psychological crisis intervention work. This article proposes a real-time monitoring system for social and psychological crisis intervention. This system is based on advanced machine learning (ML) algorithms and can capture and analyze individual psychological changes in real time, providing timely and effective support for psychological crisis intervention. This system integrates multiple technologies such as big data analysis, natural language processing, and emotional computing. By deeply mining text information on social media, online forums, and other platforms, it can accurately identify potential psychological crisis signals. The experimental results indicate that through real-time monitoring and data analysis, the system can promptly identify potential individuals with psychological crises and provide them with personalized psychological assistance.

Author Keywords: Intervention in social and psychological crises

articleTitle: Research on Artificial Intelligence-based Energy Management and Optimization Algorithms in Energy-Saving Buildings
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The building energy-saving information system monitors the implementation progress, real-time energy consumption intensity and abnormal conditions of the city's building energy consumption monitoring system online. As a modern architectural form integrating information technology and building technology, energy-saving building can greatly improve the level of building energy management by collecting and analyzing building operation data and implementing refined building monitoring and operation and maintenance. Moreover, an energy management system has been established to support the adjustment of energy supply and demand, which has greatly rationalized and improved the work of the energy sector. Energy consumption data APP tool is a smart energy-saving tool for building owners, from the perspective of building energy-saving management. But if there is a need for creative labor, increasing the technical content of design, balancing various schemes, and goal oriented performance-based design, these still require human leadership, and machines can only play an auxiliary role. In recent years, artificial intelligence technology has made significant progress in image recognition, speech recognition, predictive modeling, and other fields, providing new ideas for the intelligence and optimization of energy-saving building energy management. This article mainly analyzes the optimization algorithm of energy-saving buildings for artificial intelligence energy management.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Analysis Enabled Proactive Fault Risk Assessment of Electricity Power Distribution Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This paper establishes a probabilistic operational scenario forecasting (POSF)-based method to obtain the actual operational state profile and probabilistic map for power distribution system reliability analysis (PFRA) tasks. The proposed POSF forecasts various probabilistic scenarios with multi-scale lead times based on Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Networks (WGAN), and the developed WGAN model is further incorporated into a stochastic constrained optimization framework to establish the conditional confidence interval and risk assessment index based on past observations. The POSF-based method is extensively evaluated through a range of power outage events in power distribution system transformers’ daily operation realistic measurement records. The simulation outcomes confirm that the developed method can well adaptively forecast operational scenarios under uncertainties along with outage risk assessment compared with the existing benchmarks.

articleTitle: Prediction of Emotional Tendency In English Movie Reviews Based on Python
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the development of the economy and society, people’s living standards are getting better and better. At the same time, the pursuit of entertainment is also increasing. For example, movies are one of the entertainment methods pursued by some people. Some people will even watch English original movies from abroad directly. In order to help these English soundtrack movie enthusiasts, choose suitable English movies to watch based on the emotional tendencies of movie reviews, this paper proposes a Python based emotional tendency prediction method for English movie reviews. The method first obtains 20 comment data from the first page of the English movie “The Shawshank Redemption"; Next is the visualization analysis of raw data, which illustrates the key information of the data; Finally, there is the prediction of emotional tendencies, using Python’s machine learning module ecosystem to analyze and predict the movie comments and comment titles. For example, the negative emotional tendency of the first comment of the movie is 0.16, the neutral emotional tendency is 0.574, the positive emotional tendency is 0.267, and the overall score is 0.9932. The final overall emotional prediction is neutral. The above experiments demonstrate that this method performs well in prediction and is feasible for promotion.

articleTitle: Fault Identification Method for Power Measurement Terminal Communication under Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The proposed communication fault identification method for power metering terminals, utilizing the ant colony algorithm (ACA), presents a robust approach. By simulating the foraging behavior of ant colonies in nature, search for the optimal solution in the search space. In the process of identifying communication faults, ACA gradually approaches the real communication fault mode by continuously adjusting the search strategy. At the same time, combining the powerful learning ability of BP neural network. Experimental results validate the method’s effectiveness, achieving an impressive accuracy rate of $\mathbf{8 6 . 3 \%}$ in identifying communication faults. Leveraging ACA, the model is adeptly trained to pinpoint faults with precision. Furthermore, convergence and stability analyses underscore ACA’s superiority over genetic algorithms and particle swarm algorithms, particularly evident in its median standard deviation of errors (0.0089) across 10 runs. This underscores ACA’s exceptional performance and reliability in fault identification tasks, affirming its practical value and potential for widespread application.

articleTitle: Collaborative Filtering Recommendation Algorithm for Artificial Intelligence E-Commerce Platforms Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In the past few years, the rapid development of big data and artificial intelligence technology has brought unprecedented opportunities and challenges to e-commerce. How to predict the future purchase intention of users according to the past behavior data, so as to achieve accurate recommendation, is an important issue that e-commerce enterprises need to solve. The e-commerce platform recommendation algorithm based on collaborative filtering has become an effective means to solve this problem. The research results have indicated that the artificial intelligence e-commerce platform based on big data could achieve a recommendation accuracy of up to 95.8%. The artificial intelligence e-commerce platform based on big data can improve user satisfaction and retention rate, with obvious advantages in recommendation accuracy compared to traditional algorithms.

articleTitle: Security Transmission Control Strategy for End-to-end Network Link Layer of Medical IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the deepening of healthcare reform and the rapid development of Internet of Things (IoT) technology, the Internet of Things (IoMT) has become a key force in improving the efficiency and quality of medical services. However, this trend is also accompanied by severe challenges to the security and integrity of medical data. As a core resource, the secure transmission of medical data is directly related to the protection of patient privacy and the quality of medical services. For this purpose, this article delves into the secure transmission control strategies from IoMT devices to the network link layer. In response to the widespread application of wireless sensor networks (WSNs) in IoMT, this article proposes an energy-saving security strategy, which is implemented at the link layer. By optimizing encryption algorithms and key management mechanisms, it not only ensures the security of data transmission, but also effectively reduces computational complexity and energy consumption, improving the overall practicality and efficiency of the system. The experimental results show that this strategy significantly reduces energy consumption during data transmission while maintaining sufficient security capabilities, prolongs the service life of IoMT devices, and provides medical institutions with more economical and environmentally friendly data security solutions.

articleTitle: Design of Real-time Industrial Communication System Based on TSN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The traditional industrial communication system can’t meet the increasing demands of low delay, high reliability and accurate time synchronization. Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) technology, with its unique timing synchronization and traffic scheduling mechanism, can ensure data transmission within a certain time, thus reducing communication delay and improving the reliability and certainty of the system. This paper puts forward a design scheme of real-time industrial communication system combining TSN technology, which includes physical layer, data link layer, network layer, transmission layer, application layer and management layer. It aims to achieve low delay, high reliability and accurate time control through efficient time synchronization, traffic scheduling and queue management mechanisms, and meet the strict requirements of industrial automation for data transmission. In addition, the characteristics of TSN technology and its application potential in industrial communication system are analyzed in detail, and the feasibility and superiority of the proposed scheme are verified by practice, which provides theoretical basis and technical support for promoting the progress of industrial automation and intelligent manufacturing.

articleTitle: Simulation of an Artificial Intelligence Behavior Analysis Model Based on Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: AI (Artificial Intelligence) behavior analysis is a powerful tool, which can help us better understand and predict human behavior and provide support for decision-making in various fields. This paper aims to design an efficient and accurate user behavior analysis model by combining NN (Neural Network) algorithm module and behavior analysis module. In order to achieve this goal, this paper adopts CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) as the core algorithm, and combines with specific business needs and scenarios to formulate behavior analysis strategies. After a series of experiments, the proposed algorithm can quickly identify and classify different user behaviors, and has high accuracy in identifying user behaviors. Its MAPE value is only 0.251, which is significantly better than other comparison algorithms. At the same time, the algorithm shows high efficiency in different scale data sets. In addition, sensitivity analysis and scene test are carried out to verify the adaptability and stability of the model under various conditions and scenarios. By studying the application of NN algorithm in the field of user behavior analysis, we can further enrich and perfect the theoretical system in the field of AI, and promote the improvement and innovation of related algorithms.

articleTitle: Transformer High Voltage Equipment System Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Online monitoring and fault diagnosis of high-voltage power equipment in the power system is an important part of achieving the development of intelligent power systems. However, there are a wide variety of insulation faults in the power system that are not universally applicable, making existing detection technologies difficult to adapt to the development needs of smart grids. Therefore, this article is based on a convolutional neural network (CNN) method for monitoring the status of transformer high-voltage equipment. By extracting features from the voltage and current signals of transformer high-voltage equipment during operation and inputting them into the CNN network for classification, real-time monitoring of the operating status of transformer high-voltage equipment is achieved. The experimental results show that the method applied in this article can quickly and accurately classify the operating status of transformer high-voltage equipment, and the fault recognition accuracy based on CNN model can reach over $\mathbf{9 7. 9 \%}$. This method is superior to traditional methods in terms of accuracy, detection speed, and cost consumption in fault identification, and the effectiveness and potential of CNN in transformer fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on Application and Optimization of Intelligent Algorithms in Digital Reservoir Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This study focuses on the application and optimization of intelligent algorithms in digital reservoir management, aiming at meeting the efficiency and cost challenges faced by reservoir management under the global energy demand growth. Traditional reservoir management methods are limited by data processing ability and prediction model accuracy, and it is difficult to meet the needs of modern oilfield refined management. In this paper, a Hybrid Ensemble Transfer Learning (HETL) is proposed, which combines the advantages of integrated learning and transfer learning, and improves the prediction accuracy, stability and model interpretability by optimizing the algorithm structure and introducing a new learning mechanism. The model trains a high-performance machine learning model on the source oil field data set, and migrates to the new oil field data set for fine adjustment to adapt to the geological characteristics and production conditions of different oil fields. Case analysis takes Shengli Oilfield as an example. The results show that HETL model is significantly superior to traditional methods in predicting oilfield production, optimizing water injection strategy and determining production scheme. The prediction accuracy is improved to 95%, oil recovery is improved by 5%, and operating cost is reduced by 10%. The application of HETL model not only improves the production and oil recovery of Shengli Oilfield, but also shows the superiority and practicability of intelligent algorithm in reservoir management. The research emphasizes that in the future, reservoir management should pay more attention to regional differences, formulate personalized management strategies, and continuously monitor and optimize intelligent algorithm models to ensure long-term and efficient oilfield development. This study provides a new idea and solution for the application of intelligent algorithm in digital reservoir management, and promotes the sustainable development of petroleum industry.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise Financial Risk Early Warning System Model Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In the era of economic globalization and continuous reform of China’s political, economic, and cultural systems, China’s financial markets have rapidly aligned themselves with the pace of global developments. Financial innovation has emerged as a dominant trend in the current economic and social landscape, meeting the demands of a market-oriented economy’s development. However, this innovation acts as a double-edged sword. On the one hand, it yields economic benefits, but on the other, it introduces potential risks to the global economic environment and disrupts the orderly flow of international financial capital. Furthermore, it exposes global enterprises’ financial capital to a wider array of influencing factors. Recognizing the limitations of discriminant analysis within traditional statistical methods for assessing enterprise finances, this paper breaks free from conventional risk early warning models. It highlights the advantages and untapped potential of neural networks in financial assessment applications. Specifically, it employs an enhanced Back-Propagation (BP) neural network method to construct an early warning system for enterprise financial risks. This approach represents a novel paradigm shift in addressing financial risk in the modern business landscape.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis and Recovery of Transmission Networks Using Improved Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm (ACO)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In response to the problems of low diagnostic accuracy and low recovery efficiency in current research on fault diagnosis and recovery in transmission networks, this paper used an improved ant colony optimization algorithm to study it and improve the accuracy of fault diagnosis and recovery efficiency. It updated the pheromones of traditional ant algorithms and calculated the transition probability to find the optimal solution. The parameters of transmission line components are calculated and various parts of the system topology to quickly find the optimal recovery path and improve recovery efficiency are analyzed. Through experiments, it was found that the fault diagnosis accuracy of the method studied in this article was above $\mathbf{9 2. 4 7 \%}$. After 10 experiments, the average fault diagnosis accuracy was $\mathbf{9 4. 2 9 \%}$. The method studied in this article has achieved significant results in fault diagnosis and recovery of transmission networks, effectively improving the reliability and stability of the power grid.

articleTitle: Consumer Behavior Analysis Model of Cross-border E-commerce Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to build a cross-border e-commerce consumer behavior analysis model based on big data, so as to deeply understand consumers’ preferences, habits and decision-making process in the purchase process, and provide accurate market insight and strategic suggestions for cross-border e-commerce platforms. Through the application of big data technology, this study successfully collected the consumer transaction data of the “The global purchase” platform for nearly one year, and carefully processed and analyzed the data, and extracted key features including purchase frequency, product category preference, payment method selection and so on. In the process of model construction, this study adopts an innovative ensemble learning method, which combines random forest, gradient boosting decision tree (GBDT) and support vector machine (SVM) algorithms, and uses stacking generalization strategy to effectively improve the accuracy of consumer behavior prediction. The empirical analysis results show that the model has high accuracy in predicting consumers’ purchasing behavior and consumption habits. The model analysis shows that electronic products, fashion clothes and household goods are the goods categories with high consumer preference, and most consumers tend to shop on weekends or holidays, and the shopping peak period is from 8: 00 pm to 10: 00 pm. In addition, the model also identifies significant differences among different consumer groups in terms of purchasing preferences and payment methods, which provides a basis for e-commerce platforms to achieve refined market positioning. The consumer behavior analysis model of cross-border e-commerce based on big data constructed in this study not only provides in-depth market insight for cross-border ecommerce platforms, but also provides valuable reference for enterprise inventory management, logistics distribution and marketing strategy formulation.

articleTitle: Optimization of Human Resource Recruitment Efficiency Based on Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the application of information management systems has penetrated into various aspects of enterprise operation, becoming a key factor in promoting continuous innovation and development of enterprises. In this context, human resource management has also ushered in a wave of digital transformation, among which online recruitment, as an important way to acquire talent, has received widespread attention for its efficiency and accuracy. Although online recruitment provides job seekers and recruiting units with a broader platform and convenient channels, in practical operation, it still faces many challenges such as low efficiency in personnel position matching and imbalanced matching results. How to accurately and quickly complete job matching has become an urgent problem in the field of human resources. In response to this situation, this article proposes a human resources recruitment system based on machine learning (ML) algorithm. This system integrates advanced ML technology to deeply analyze and mine massive recruitment and job search data, in order to achieve precise matching between job seekers and recruitment positions. The experimental results show that the system has achieved significant results in improving the efficiency of personnel position matching.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Image Recognition Algorithms Based on Optical Sensors and Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This paper presents the design of an intelligent image recognition algorithm based on optical sensors and Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN). In today’s digital era, the growth of image data is increasing exponentially, which puts higher requirements on image recognition algorithms. Optical sensors, as an important data acquisition tool, play an important role in the field of image processing. Generative Adversarial Networks, on the other hand, is a powerful deep learning model that can learn and generate images with realistic features. In this paper, an intelligent image recognition algorithm is designed by combining optical sensors with GAN, which realizes efficient recognition and classification of images by taking full advantage of data acquisition and feature learning. This study first introduces the basic principles of optical sensor technology and its application in image recognition. With the development of technology, optical sensors have continuously improved the accuracy and speed of image acquisition, and have been widely used in industrial, medical and other fields. Then, this paper elaborates the working principle of Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) and its importance in image processing.GAN realizes the ability of learning from data and generating realistic images by means of competitive learning, which brings new breakthroughs in the field of image recognition. An intelligent image recognition algorithm design based on optical sensor and GAN is proposed. The algorithm realizes the effective extraction and learning of image features through the steps of data preprocessing, optical sensor feature extraction and GAN feature learning. In the process of algorithm design, the features and advantages of optical sensors and GAN in image processing are fully considered, which makes the algorithm have high recognition accuracy and robustness. Finally, this paper verifies the performance of the proposed algorithm in image classification and recognition tasks through experiments, and the results show that the algorithm achieves better recognition results on different data sets. It is of great significance for promoting the development of intelligent image recognition technology, and also provides new ideas and methods for the application of optical sensors and generative adversarial networks in the field of image processing. In the future, the design and implementation of the algorithm can be further optimized to expand its application in a wider range of fields.

articleTitle: Application and Effectiveness Evaluation of Bayesian Optimization Algorithm in Hyperparameter Tuning of Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Hyperparameter tuning is a crucial step in the development of machine learning models, as it directly impacts their performance and generalization ability. Traditional methods for hyperparameter optimization often involve exhaustive search or random search, which can be computationally expensive and inefficient. In recent years, Bayesian optimization has gained prominence as an effective method for hyperparameter tuning due to its ability to efficiently explore and exploit the search space. This paper provides a comprehensive overview of the application of Bayesian optimization algorithms for hyperparameter tuning in machine learning models. We begin by introducing the theoretical foundations of Bayesian optimization, such as Gaussian processes and acquisition functions. Next, we explain how Bayesian optimization can be applied to optimize hyperparameters by iteratively selecting the most promising configurations based on the observed performance of the model. Finally, we assess the effectiveness of Bayesian optimization compared to traditional hyperparameter tuning methods through experimental studies on various datasets and machine learning models. We demonstrate the superior performance of Bayesian optimization in terms of convergence speed and final model performance. The significant role of Bayesian optimization in enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of hyperparameter tuning for machine learning models. The significant role of Bayesian optimization in enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of hyperparameter tuning for machine learning models. We also discuss potential avenues for future research, such as further optimization of Bayesian optimization algorithms and exploration of their applications in other domains. We also discuss potential avenues for future research, such as further optimization of Bayesian optimization algorithms and exploration of their applications in other domains. Overall, this research contributes to advancing the field of machine learning by providing insights into the practical application and performance evaluation of Bayesian optimization algorithms in hyperparameter tuning.

articleTitle: Intelligent Financial Decision Support System Based on RPA Financial Robot and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
