abstract: This paper studies the construction and application of intelligent financial decision support system (DSS) which combines RPA (Robotic Process Automation) financial robot and artificial intelligence (AI) technology. This paper expounds the functional module design of intelligent financial DSS in detail, including financial data automatic processing, intelligent data analysis and prediction, risk early warning and management, decision support and system management module. Through the system architecture design, the system is divided into data layer, business logic layer and presentation layer to ensure the stability and efficiency of the system. In the process of system implementation, advanced technologies such as Windows 10 operating system, Visual Studio Code development environment, Python back-end development language, Flask Web framework and PostgreSQL database are adopted. RPA financial robot realizes the automatic collection and arrangement of financial data through UiPath tools, while AI technology uses TensorFlow and other libraries for in-depth analysis and prediction of data. The system testing stage includes functional testing and performance testing, which verifies the stability and reliability of the system. The research results show that the combination of RPA financial robot and AI technology can provide enterprises with more efficient and accurate financial management and decision support services. Through the functions of automatic processing of financial data, intelligent analysis and prediction, risk early warning and decision support, the system has significantly improved the financial management level and decision efficiency of enterprises. The research in this paper not only enriches the application theory of RPA and AI in the financial field, but also provides useful reference for the financial management practice of enterprises.

articleTitle: Application of machine learning algorithm in structural safety assessment of building engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The structural safety of construction engineering is an important topic in the construction industry, but the traditional structural safety assessment method has limitations. In this study, machine learning is used as a powerful data analysis tool, and support vector machine (SVM) algorithm is used to evaluate the structural safety of building engineering. The algorithm has the advantages of high efficiency, strong generalization ability, suitable for small sample learning and dealing with nonlinear problems. In order to reduce the complexity of the model, the feature selection method based on mutual information is studied to optimize the SVM algorithm, and the optimal parameter combination is determined by grid search and cross validation. Data sources include open data sets and field surveys, covering key information such as building structure design, material properties and use environment. After data preprocessing such as data cleaning, feature extraction and normalization, SVM model shows high prediction accuracy in identifying buildings with different damage degrees. Compared with logistic regression and random forest algorithm, the optimized SVM model shows superiority in accuracy, recall and F1 value. This model can help engineers to evaluate the structural safety of construction projects more quickly and accurately, and provide timely safety warning and risk assessment. This study not only provides an efficient and accurate method for structural safety assessment of construction projects, but also lays a foundation for the wider application of machine learning in the construction industry.

articleTitle: Development and Verification of a Machine Learning Based Motor Energy Consumption Prediction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The popularization of smart home in people’s daily life makes motor energy consumption prediction one of the key technologies for energy saving and emission reduction. In order to improve the prediction accuracy and efficiency, this paper proposes a motor energy prediction technology based on Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network. This paper introduces the motor energy prediction, emphasizes its significance in the field of industrial energy efficiency and smart home, and puts forward an intelligent tool to deal with this big data problem through machine learning technology. The paper also introduces data acquisition and preprocessing, feature engineering, model design, iterative training and estimation test strategy. The experimental results show that, compared with the autoregressive moving average model (ARMA) and the autoregressive fractional integrated moving average model (ARFIMA), the proposed LSTM model has a higher determination coefficient, with a maximum of 0.98, which is beneficial to the prediction of motor energy consumption. This paper also tests the robust performance of the LSTM model and its application under different loads, and discusses the performance conclusions of the LSTM model, the intrinsic value of its types and its possible application in the creative field.

articleTitle: Short Term Prediction of Wind Power Generation Power Based on Variable Time Scales
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The short-term prediction effect of wind power generation power is not entirely the same at different time scales. Considering that the annual statistical cycle cannot reflect the changes in wind power generation at different time scales, a short-term wind power prediction method based on variable time scales is proposed by combining the physical model of wind power generation and relevant historical data. By comparing the similarity based interpolation and linear interpolation power prediction methods through experiments, the superiority of the similarity based interpolation method in short-term power prediction is determined. On the basis of similarity interpolation research, short-term prediction of wind power generation based on variable time scales is carried out. The results show that this method can adaptively change the prediction cycle according to actual control requirements, and achieve variable time scale generation power prediction.

articleTitle: Design of a Facial Recognition System for Power Grid Video Surveillance Based on Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the extensive application of deep learning methods, face recognition technology has been greatly developed. Aiming at the problem of video surveillance in power network, a video surveillance method based on image processing is proposed. In this paper, an intelligent decision model based on knowledge automatic extraction is studied and optimized. In power network monitoring, face detection and recognition technology based on deep learning is a commonly used face detection and recognition technology, including: face detection, face alignment, face size alignment. Aiming at video surveillance image in power system, a new technology with strong robustness is studied. This new algorithm can solve this problem well. On this basis, a power network monitoring system based on computer vision technology is adopted. Experimental results show that the proposed method can achieve $\mathbf{9 5. 9 \%}$ accuracy and $\mathbf{9 4. 7 \%}$ stability, and can be used in real environment.

articleTitle: Research on data privacy protection and identity verification mechanism in smart power system
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As an important part of the contemporary energy field, intelligent power system is facing the challenges of data security and user privacy protection. In this paper, the problems of data privacy protection and authentication in smart power system are studied, and a joint data privacy protection and authentication mechanism based on deep learning is proposed. The mechanism comprehensively uses encryption technology, biometric identification and deep learning model to improve the security and user experience of the system. The effectiveness and performance of the mechanism are verified by experiments. The results show that the encryption model achieves high accuracy on the test set and protects the privacy of users’ electricity consumption behavior data. In addition, the paper also analyzes the influence of threshold on authentication performance, and discusses the future research direction. This study provides some theoretical guidance and technical support for the safe operation of smart power system and the protection of users’ privacy, and has certain practical application value.

articleTitle: Real-time Application of Intrusion Detection Algorithm Based on Machine Learning in Security System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The purpose of this article is to design and implement an intrusion detection system (IDS) based on machine learning to improve the network security protection ability. In order to achieve this goal, the advanced model in deep learning is adopted, and an efficient intrusion detection model is constructed through training data sets, and the model parameters are carefully optimized and adjusted by using the verification set. After the model is successfully built, the system performance is comprehensively evaluated by using an independent test set. The results show that compared with the traditional IDS, the deep learning model proposed in this article has obvious advantages in key performance indicators such as accuracy, recall and $F 1$ value. In addition, the detection time of the system is much better than that of the traditional methods, and it can quickly respond to potential network threats. IDS based on deep learning has a significant effect in improving network security protection. It can not only detect intrusion more accurately and comprehensively, but also greatly shorten the detection time, providing a strong guarantee for network security.

articleTitle: Neural Network Prediction and Sensitivity Analysis of Concrete Compressive Strength: Sensitivity and Feature Importance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In engineering practice, the measurement of concrete compressive strength is often very troublesome, time-consuming and laborious, so a method that can predict the strength of concrete is very important, this paper designs a BP neural network based on the prediction of the compressive strength of concrete, by means of the neural network constantly training for the prediction of the compressive strength of concrete, the prediction results can be reasoned, and the results of the actual value of the comparison of error The prediction results are rationalized, and the error of comparison with the actual value results is small, and the accuracy is high. At the same time, this paper calibrates the parameters of the neural network when predicting the compressive strength of concrete, which provides guidance for the selection of super-parameters. At the same time, this paper analyzes the importance of the features when the concrete is condensed and hardened, and obtains the importance index of each feature.

articleTitle: Research on the 3D Reconstruction Method of Structural Landforms by Combining Airborne LiDAR and Photogrammetry
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a 3D reconstruction method of structural landforms based on airborne light laser detection and ranging (LIDAR) and photogrammetry technology is studied. Aiming at the limitation of traditional single data source in 3D reconstruction, this study combines these two technologies to improve the accuracy and detail expression of 3D landform model. Firstly, this study introduces the basic principles of airborne LiDAR and photogrammetry technology and their application status in 3D reconstruction of landforms. Then, the methods of data acquisition, preprocessing, filtering and geomorphic feature extraction are described in detail. In the data registration stage, the method based on feature point matching is used to align airborne LiDAR data with photogrammetry data to ensure the consistency of spatial position. In the data fusion stage, a more accurate and informative 3D landform model is generated by combining the elevation information of airborne LiDAR data and the texture information of photogrammetry data. The experiment selects the Dongdian Hou Fault on the Shandong Peninsula as an example for the study area. Through comparative analysis, compared with the traditional 3D reconstruction method with a single data source, this research method has improved in model accuracy, terrain complexity accuracy, building density accuracy, model detail richness and texture authenticity. The experimental results show that the 3D reconstruction method combining airborne LiDAR and photogrammetry data can significantly improve the accuracy and visual effect of 3D landform model, which provides a new idea and method for 3D reconstruction research in the field of geographic information technology.

articleTitle: Multi-Microgrid Distribution Network Hierarchical Collaborative Scheduling Strategy Under Network Intelligence Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In recent years, microgrids, as an important component of distributed energy access distribution networks, have become a key strategy for promoting the evolution of traditional distribution networks towards active distribution networks. However, the economic issues caused by the integration of microgrids into distribution networks still need to be further addressed. This article takes active distribution networks and microgrids as research objects, and constructs an innovative hierarchical optimization model by analyzing the interest relationship between the two. The model aims to minimize the total cost of microgrids and distribution networks, including energy storage, distributed generators, distributed loads, and distributed solar panels. It takes the safety constraints of node voltage, power balance constraints, and power interaction constraints of the superior power grid during distribution as the constraint function. This article obtains the scheduling strategy with the minimum cost that satisfies the constraint conditions through the economic operation and hierarchical collaborative scheduling strategy of multi-microgrids and distribution networks. In order to solve this multi-level problem, this paper introduces genetic algorithms and linear programming methods to achieve the overall optimization solution of the system. The experimental data shows that the investment cost of scheduling optimization based on genetic algorithm is $\mathbf{6 8 1. 7 2}$ million yuan, which is 0.4502 million yuan less than the investment cost of particle swarm algorithm. The power outage loss of scheduling optimization based on genetic algorithm is 892.8709 million yuan, which is 409.1635 million yuan higher than the power outage loss of PSO (PSO) algorithm.

articleTitle: Built in Power Status Detection Component Based on Deep Learning in Multi source Data Acquisition Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Today, multi-source data acquisition devices play an increasingly important role in industry, environmental monitoring and health surveillance. However, the long-term stable operation and reliability of these devices rely heavily on the stability and continuity of the built-in power supply. Therefore, it is particularly important to accurately and efficiently monitor and predict the status of power supplies. In this study, we propose a deep learning-based built-in power supply state detection method to automatically learn and extract key features of power supply performance from data collected by multiple sensors by designing and implementing an end-to-end neural network model. This paper combines a convolutional neural network (CNN) and a long short-term memory network (LSTM) in order to process time-series data and predict the immediate state of the power supply in real time. The system also contains an adaptive learning mechanism that automatically adjusts the prediction model according to environmental changes and equipment aging to maintain high sensitivity and accuracy of detection. Even in the case of $\mathbf{2 5 \%}$ data loss, the accuracy of the model remains around 93.5%, which indicates the robustness of the model in dealing with incomplete data. This study not only optimizes the power state detection of multi-source data acquisition devices, but also provides a valuable empirical foundation and theoretical support for the application of deep learning technology in the field of energy management, demonstrating its wide application prospects and practical value.

articleTitle: Motion analysis of the combined linkage mechanismauxiliary assembly system for the Space Station
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Spacecraft assembly is the final stage and the key link in the realization of functionality and performance of aerospace products. There are many large-scale products used for on-orbit operation and scientific investigation in the assembly process of the space station. Aiming at the layout and structural form of products in the space station cabin, the combined linkage mechanism auxiliary assembly system is introduced to achieve intelligent assembly of large products in the sealed cabin. In this paper, based on three elements, those are the spacecraft, the product to be installed and the combined linkage mechanism auxiliary assembly system, a motion model of the combined linkage mechanism auxiliary assembly system is established. The movement trajectory of the combined linkage mechanism auxiliary assembly system is analyzed in detail. According to the principle of inverse kinematics, path planning of the combined linkage mechanism auxiliary assembly system is carried out. Through the simulation software, the trajectory and path of the combined linkage mechanism auxiliary assembly system are simulated, and the assembly path of the product in the sealed space of the space station is obtained. Finally, by constructing the virtual environment of spacecraft assembly, the theoretical model and the calculation results are verified. Through analyzing the path planning of the combined linkage mechanism auxiliary assembly system in the space station, intelligent assembly of spacecraft products is achieved.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Monitoring and Early Warning System of Elevators Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the acceleration of urbanization, the number of elevators continues to increase, and elevator safety issues are becoming increasingly prominent. In order to improve the safety and reliability of elevators, this paper proposes an elevator fault monitoring and early warning system based on the Internet of Things. The system utilizes IoT technology to monitor the real-time operation status of elevators and provide early warning for elevator malfunctions. The hardware part includes a microcontroller, sensors, buzzer alarm module, and display module. The system software is divided into local software, communication software, and monitoring software. The monitoring software is the top layer in the Internet of Things, providing a monitoring interface for fault monitoring personnel. Local software is the control program of the local controller, responsible for data collection, processing, storage, and uploading in case of faults. Communication software is responsible for the communication of information. The feasibility and effectiveness of the system were verified by analyzing the hardware design, software design, and testing results of the system.

articleTitle: Detection and Identification of Abnormal Topology Relationships in Three-Phase Power System Transformers Using ResNet Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The power industry is a key foundational energy industry for socio-economic development. In recent years, with the rapid development of the national economy, the electricity consumption has sharply increased, the power supply scale has rapidly expanded, and the demand for electricity services has also been increasing. With the construction of smart grids, the electricity information collection system has achieved full coverage and can obtain a large amount ofbasic electricity information data. In the actual production process, higher requirements have been put forward for the accuracy of various indicators for stable system operation and electricity customer information. To this end, we introduce a new method based on the ResNet (Residual neural network, hereinafter referred to as ResNet) model. This method extracts features directly from raw data through end-to-end learning, and performs anomaly detection and recognition through deep residual networks. We conduct extensive experiments on actual three-phase power system datasets, and the results show that the proposed method has higher accuracy and better generalization ability compared to traditional methods. It can effectively detect and identify anomalies in the topology relationship of three-phase power system transformers, providing strong support for the safe and stable operation of the power system.

Author Keywords: abnormal topology relationship of variable users

articleTitle: Research on optimal size routing operation scheme based on multi-objective programming model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the planning problem of the operation scheme of large and small interroute trains, this paper establishes a mathematical model based on multi-objective nonlinear integer programming, entropy weight TOPSIS and the strategy of “selecting the best among the best”, and solves the optimal operation scheme for the enterprise to minimize the operating cost and maximize the service level. Furthermore, the model is optimized according to the solution results, and specific suggestions are provided for the enterprise. First of all, passengers are classified, and the six categories of passengers are divided into two categories of passengers, so that all types of passengers are naturalized into the same system. Then, by establishing the objective function and constraint conditions, the multi-objective nonlinear integer programming model pair model is established. Then genetic algorithm was used to solve the optimal scheme and found that its effect was not ideal. According to the characteristics of the solution set, 48 schemes satisfying the constraint conditions were enumerated by enumeration method. Then, the TOPSIS method based on entropy weight is used for comprehensive evaluation of 48 schemes. After eliminating the inferior solutions with obvious low scores, the entropy weight method is used for secondary weight determination of the remaining 12 schemes. Then TOPSIS method is used to classify the $\mathbf{4}$ objective functions into a dimensionless evaluation system for evaluation, and the optimal opening scheme is solved. The objective function is modified, the definition of retention rate is introduced. A new model is established, the optimal running scheme is obtained when the number of trains is just reduced by one group by decreasing value, and the parallel running diagram with equal intervals is formulated. In this paper, the change rate of train time and the number of trains are calculated by considering multiple objectives. The following suggestions are given to enterprises: on the basis of reducing the minimum parking time standard, a certain “reaction time” is increased; we need to increase the train capacity to a certain extent to reduce the frequency of departures; The starting and terminating stations of minor trains shall be located at stations with a large number of passengers on and off.

Author Keywords: TOPSIS method based on entropy weight

articleTitle: Research on Rural Landscape Feature Recognition and Classification Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the acceleration of urbanization, the protection and research of rural landscape is particularly important. Traditional rural landscape feature recognition methods rely on manual observation, which is inefficient and easily influenced by subjective factors. This study uses machine learning technology, especially the convolutional neural network (CNN) in deep learning, to improve the accuracy and efficiency of rural landscape feature recognition. By constructing a transfer learning model based on VGG16 and proposing a multi-scale feature fusion CNN (MSF-CNN) model, this study has achieved high-precision identification and classification of rural landscape features. A large number of rural landscape images were collected by combining aerial photography with ground photography, and the images were carefully marked and preprocessed. The performance of the original CNN model, the fine-tuned VGG16 model and MSF-CNN model in the task of rural landscape feature recognition was studied and compared. The results show that MSF-CNN model has achieved the best performance in accuracy, recall, precision and F1 score, which proves the effectiveness of multi-scale feature fusion strategy. In addition, the stability and generalization ability of the model are verified by K-fold cross-validation method. In this study, a new method of rural landscape feature recognition and classification is proposed based on machine learning technology, and its effectiveness is verified by experiments. This method not only improves the accuracy of identification, but also provides a scientific basis for the protection and development of rural landscape.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Modeling of Demand Response with Bilateral Uncertainty of Source and Load
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart grid and renewable energy, source-load bilaterally uncertainty puts higher requirements on the stability and reliability of power systems. In this paper, a demand response model with source-load bilateral uncertainty is constructed based on a deep learning method, aiming to improve the responsiveness of the power system in an uncertain environment. First, a training set containing multi-dimensional data such as historical load, weather and market price is established through data collection and preprocessing. Second, a deep learning model was designed to model the source load uncertainty using its powerful nonlinear fitting capability. Through model training and optimization, a high-precision demand response strategy is obtained. The experimental results show that the proposed model has significant advantages in reducing power system operation cost and improving demand response flexibility. Finally, this paper also discusses the practical application scenarios and promotion value of the model, which provides an important reference for the future power market reform.

articleTitle: Hierarchical and Partitioned Collaborative Scheduling Strategy for Virtual Power Plants Based on Network Intelligence Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the development of the times, how to rationally distribute energy resources and provide efficient support for them is a key problem that needs to be solved urgently. In this paper, a resource hierarchical optimal scheduling device based on a virtual power plant is utilized and applied to the resource hierarchical optimal scheduling of a virtual power plant. Relying on the distributed scheduling of VPP (virtual power plant) based on Leader-Follower, the flexible load resources are inputted into the flexible resource hierarchical partitioning model of a constructed virtual power plant, and the results are obtained. Obtain setup data by setting up the operational data of the transmission network and distribution network system. The traditional scheduling method has an operating cost of 10,000 yuan per hour, while the method in this paper has an operating cost of 5,000 yuan per hour, and the use of this paper’s method helps to reasonably allocate the resources of the virtual power plant.

articleTitle: Uncertainty Risk Assessment of Virtual Power Plants Using Bayesian Network Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: During the operation of a virtual power plant, many uncertain factors such as fluctuations in renewable energy supply, market prices, and equipment performance increase its operational risks. In response to the above issues, this paper takes the operational risk of virtual power plants as the research object, based on Bayesian networks and combined with various uncertainty factors, establishes a Bayesian network model to effectively analyze and assist in the operation risk of virtual power plants. By conducting statistical analysis on historical meteorological data, transaction data, and equipment operation status during the operation of virtual power plants, a Bayesian network is constructed and trained. This paper adopts a fault diagnosis method based on expert knowledge. This paper analyzes the impact of multiple uncertain factors on the operation of virtual power plants in multiple operating scenarios, including the impact of new energy consumption on the stable operation of the power grid, and the impact of electricity price fluctuations on the economic benefits of the power grid. Virtual power plants can quickly respond to high-risk weather such as typhoons (15 minutes) and tornadoes (20 minutes), reducing losses caused by disasters. Through this study, new theories and methods will be provided for risk assessment of virtual power plants, and reference and guidance will be provided for risk management in other industries.

articleTitle: New Power System Energy Storage Cost Compensation Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The rapid development of new energy(NE) sources has brought us new economic growth opportunities. In order to improve the economics of power system operation, various types of power generation must be compensated. The cost compensation mechanism of energy storage (ES) technology is one of the important issues facing the current power system and is directly related to the promotion and application of NE. The core issue of the ES cost compensation mechanism is how to balance the return on investment of ES technology and the supply and demand(SD) relationship in the power market. At present, ES technology is mainly used in renewable energy fields, such as wind energy, solar energy, etc. These areas are characterized by instability in power supply and uncertainty in demand, resulting in SD imbalances in the power market. Therefore, this article will study the ES cost compensation mechanism of new power systems. Through the analysis of the power ES system and the discussion of ES technology, a cost compensation mechanism is proposed. From the three aspects of the compensation mechanism, the advantages are analyzed and the key points are discussed. Subsequently, through data investigation, a scale analysis of China’s current new power system was conducted, and the economics of pumped hydro storage, lithium-ion batteries and compressed air energy storage(CAES) were compared. Survey data shows that hydropower generation capacity is 1.35 trillion kilowatt hours, which is 15.3% of the total power generation capacity.

articleTitle: Research on Asset Valuation of Power Grid Data Based on Optimizing Multi factor Cost Correction Model - Taking Huzhou Company as an Example
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This article summarizes relevant literature on data assets both domestically and internationally, and concludes that foreign research mainly focuses on theoretical research, while domestic research tends to lean more towards the three traditional methods. Based on the characteristics of data assets in power grid enterprises, this paper summarizes three valuation models for power grid data assets: cost, revenue, and market, and explores the applicability of these methods to derive a data asset management framework. Based on the inherent value and application value of data, analyze the factors affecting the value of power grid data assets, construct a power grid data asset valuation model, quantify data assets, and verify their effectiveness and feasibility. Select relevant data application scenarios, sort out business models, data objects, and algorithm models, conduct data traceability analysis, and conduct valuation and development cost measurement collection analysis.

articleTitle: Research on the change of new energy vehicle indicators based on ARIMA algorithm and machine learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In recent years, new energy electric vehicles have been developing rapidly and are well known in the world for their low pollution and low energy consumption. This study establishes a mathematical model to analyze multiple factors related to electric vehicles. A multiple linear regression model and a gray correlation analysis model are used to calculate the coefficients of correlation between the sales of electric vehicles, the price of fuel and the number of charging piles using data related to the number of charging piles, the price of fuel and the sales of new vehicles in China’s energy-electric vehicle market for the period of 2014-2022, and the results illustrate that the number of charging piles and the price of fuel will contribute to the development of the sales industry of electric vehicles; these data show a gradual increasing trend in the last nine years. Data showed a trend of gradual increase. Subsequently, an ARIMA model was developed to predict that the future sales volume and other indicators are also expected to show a positive trend. Global market share data for electric vehicles was collected. As a result, the size of the Chinese electric vehicle market occupies a significant position in the global scale. Therefore, the global market share data with the stock and the market penetration of electric vehicles in China with the impact of conventional cars to infer the development of electric vehicles globally. The growth of electric vehicles has a strong negative correlation with conventional automobiles, indicating a competitive relationship. This indicates that the growth of electric the automobile industry will inhibit the growth of the traditional automobile industry. Gather information about policies and relevant data. The development of new energy vehicles in China comes from the United States, Japan, and Germany. Using the random forest model, determine the impact of development among the three. Among them, the policies of the United States and Germany have a more significant impact on China thus affecting the development of China’s new energy electric vehicle industry. The Ridge regression model, combined with logarithmic transformation, is used to obtain the changes of the three main indicators. The results show that when all gasoline-fueled vehicles are replaced by new energy electric vehicles, there is a general decrease in carbon emissions and the level of pollutants in the environment. This indicates that the promotion of new energy electric vehicles is conducive to the protection of the ecological environment.

articleTitle: Efficient Optical Character Recognition based Text Detection Method in Robotic Process Automation in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The scale of dispatch automation systems is constantly expanding due to the large-scale integration of new power system entities, and the operation and maintenance requirements of power grid automation systems are increasing. The challenges faced by automation personnel are also increasing. The combination of Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and Robotic Process Automation (RPA) provides powerful technical support for automated processing of documents containing text information. To this end, this paper develops an efficient optical character recognition-based text detection method in robotic process automation in power systems. The numerical results confirmed the effectiveness of the proposed solution for text detection in the RPA in the context of the power system operation.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Sustainable Engineering Technology in the System of Smart Grid Construction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Intelligent networks are an important trend in the development of the energy industry today. Based on new energy technologies and advanced control technologies, improving energy systems can achieve efficient, safe, reliable, and sustainable energy supply. The use of digital technology in the power system can help to improve production efficiency and quality. Existing studies have confirmed the importance of digital sustainable engineering technologies for smart grid construction systems. However, these studies mainly focused on the specific application of technology, while in-depth study of the comprehensive efficacy and performance indicators of technologies is still insufficient. Therefore, this article used digital sustainable engineering technology to study the power grid system. This article mainly applied experimental testing and data analysis methods to study the construction of smart grids. The experimental results indicated that the cost value was the highest at a load of 1.3. The digital sustainable engineering technology, scheduling strategies, and solution methods proposed in this article can lay the foundation for the construction of smart grid systems.

articleTitle: Research on Agricultural and Animal Husbandry Ecological Evolution in North China Based on Computer Machine Learning and GIS Spatial Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The agro-pastoral ecotone is an ecologically fragile and sensitive area. Based on multi-source data, this research analyzes the Geo-Informatic tupu and forecasts of the ecological evolution of Ordos city in the agro-pastoral zone from 1990 to 2020. The findings reveal that: (1) Fractional vegetation cover(FVC) has been in a tendency to decrease first and then continue to increase in the last 30 years, with a total of 85% of regions with medium or higher cover by 2020.(2)The Land-Use and Land-Cover Change(LUCC)has remained relatively stable over the last 30 years, with unused land dominating the stable areas $(43.38 \%)$ and unused land changing to woodland dominating the changing areas ($\gt14 \% / 10 a$), and ecological restoration measures being effective, with farmland forecast being turned mainly to grassland $\mathbf{(9 . 5 6 \%}$) and unused land to woodland $(9.20 \%)$ between 2020 and 2030.(3)In the last 30 years, the average annual temperature and annual equivalent precipitation have been fluctuating upwards, and the annual equivalent precipitation line has been moving in and out widely, with extreme drought (200mm) in 2000 and 2005, and the forecast indicates that temperature and humidity will continue to rise slowly in the future. It is found that the ecological quality of Ordos has fluctuated and improved over time due to the positive and negative effects of climate change and human activities. Therefore, ecological restoration and governance play a pivotal role, and scientific measures to deal with climate change in the future are essential to prevent ecological risks.

articleTitle: Domestic Solar Photovoltaic Generation Prediction Based on Hybrid Machine Learning Models in the Presence of Uncertain Weather
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: To provide effective data support for the operation and scheduling strategies of the power grid, and reduce the harm caused by large-scale grid connection of new energy generation, accurate prediction of power generation is crucial. This paper proposes a domestic solar photovoltaic generation prediction based on hybrid machine-learning models in the presence of uncertain weather. The proposed solution is assessed through experiments and the numerical results confirmed the effectiveness of the proposed solution. The hybrid model designed in this work has stronger robustness and information extraction ability compared to other single network models, which can produce better prediction results.
